# 1.Change inventory

This inventory displays feature changes of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console by default. For changes related to cloud services, refer to the corresponding documentation for each Cloud Service.

**v3.18.6sp-2607**

**Enterprise**

| Feature | Change description |
| --- | --- |
| <strong>Users</strong> &gt; <strong>Users</strong> | Users are categorized as console or non-console users based on their access method. |

**Configurations**

| Feature | Change description |
| --- | --- |
| Resource pool settings | The system adds the AI Service Token tab, which allows you to set and manage quotas on a monthly basis. |

**Operations**

**Feature**

**Change description**

You can search for application forms by submission time and

**Application Forms**

export data from the past year.

You can allocate and manage quotas for AI service tokens by organization and resource set.

**Quotas**

**Tags** > **Policy**

Policy scenarios support binding resources to specific tag

**Library**

values.

**Resource Operation s**

- The public cloud platform supports quota management configuration.

**Product**

- The product list includes a tag column where you can add

**Management**

custom tags.

- You can edit manually imported specifications after import.

<table>
  <tr>
    <td rowspan="4">Service Operation s</td>
    <td>Service Catalog</td>
    <td>• Service Catalog is upgraded to support the integration of services such as agents and models.<br>• Service Catalog optimizes specification pool configuration, which is subject to the control of the parent service catalog. Validation fails when a child parameter configuration conflicts with the parent configuration.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Orders</td>
    <td>• You can cancel orders in the Pending or Processing Failed states.<br>• For manually delivered orders, the system adds a To Be Claimed node. After claiming an order, you can execute the delivery.<br>• For manually delivered orders, operations administrators can dispatch orders by default to delivery roles and users within the scope defined by the product settings.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><strong>Pricing</strong> &gt; <strong>Billing</strong> Rules</td>
    <td>You can disable the last enabled subscription billing configuration, including preset configurations.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Token Plan Management</td>
    <td>The system adds Token Plan management, which includes the following features:<br>• Token Plan: Manage Token Plan subscription plans and view usage statistics.<br>• Order Management: Manage subscription plans for token plans and purchase records for shared usage plans.<br>• Token Plan Configurations: Configure credit conversion rules, version specifications, and pricing rules for token plans.</td>
  </tr>
</table>

**v3.18.6 sp-2605**

**Products**

| Feature | Change description |
| --- | --- |
| <strong>Product</strong> &gt; <strong>Essential</strong> <strong>Storage Service</strong> &gt; PanguStor | The system adds a PanguStor management entry under the Products menu to integrate PanguStor for unified management in the Enterprise Edition. |

**Enterprise**

| Feature | Change description |
| --- | --- |
| <strong>Resources</strong> &gt; <strong>Resource</strong> Search | • The system adds expiration reminder rules.<br>• You can set an expiration date, extend the expiration date, or manually renew resource instances.<br>• The system adds resource analysis to provide panoramic resource insights. |
| <strong>Resources</strong> &gt; Organizations | If the user role management scope is not a global role, the system hides the root organization from the top navigation bar, Resource Search, Organizations, Regions, Changes, Data Permissions, and all filters that contain organization options. |
| <strong>Resources</strong> &gt; <strong>Resource</strong> Sets | • When you authorize resource set members, the system enforces a quantity limit on the number of users and user groups that you can select at a time.<br>• When you authorize resource set members, you can revoke authorizations in batches. |
| <strong>Users</strong> &gt; <strong>Users</strong> | The system adds a Temporarily Lock User tab. When the system locks a user account due to multiple incorrect password attempts, an administrator can unlock the account. After the administrator unlocks the account, the user can log on normally. |
| <strong>Permissions</strong> &gt; <strong>Role</strong> Permissions | • The system adds role filtering to the operations on the Authorized Personnel tab. You can filter by "Not current role" and grant the current role to multiple users at a time.<br>• When you create a role, you can specify an applicable organization. |

**Configurations**

| Feature | Change description |
| --- | --- |
| Region Settings | Region settings support a world map. |
| Native Hybrid Cloud &gt; Multi-Cloud Management | • Public cloud resource pool access supports the resource directory management account type.<br>• Custom cloud platform types support adding resource pools. |
| Native Hybrid Cloud &gt; Cloud Platform Type Management | The system adds cloud platform type management. You can configure and manage cloud platform types in the cloud management platform. |
| Security Policies | • On the Password Policy tab, the Account Freezing Duration parameter is changed to the Temporary Account Lock Duration parameter.<br>• MFA Binding Instrcutions is added to the Login Control tab. You can customize the instrcutionss. |
| Menu Settings &gt; Redirection Page Configuration | You can set the authorization order. |
| Custom Configurations &gt; Platform Settings | You can customize the navigation background color and the navigation drop-down panel background color. |
| Message Gateway | • The Enable SMTP Authentication switch is added to the Mail Gateway tab. If you enable it, you must set Sender Mailbox Password.<br>• The system adds Webhook as a message channel. |

<a id="section-2"></a>

# 2.What is the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console?

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console is provided by Apsara Stack to help organizations perform cloud deployment. The platform improves IT management and operations, aiming to provide large-scale, cost-efficient end-to-end cloud computing and big data services for customers in sectors like public service, education, healthcare, and financial services.

**Overview**

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console simplifies the management and deployment of physical and virtual resources, facilitating application development, improving resource utilization, and reducing O&M costs. The console is an integral part of the ecosystem built around cloud computing.

**Procedure**

Operations in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console are classified into the following parts:

- Basic configurations for system initialization, such as creating organizations, resource sets, and users, creating basic resources such as virtual private clouds (VPCs), and creating contacts and contact groups in CloudMonitor.

- Creation of cloud resources (performed by administrators).

- Resource management, such as starting, using, and releasing resources, and changing resource configurations and resource quotas.

**Emergency mode**

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console is switched to the emergency mode when faults occur to Apsara Stack.

In this mode, only emergency features are available.

**Apsara Stack faults**

When faults occur to Apsara Stack and Apsara Uni-manager Management Console enters the emergency mode, the following features become unavailable.

# 3.Getting started

## 3.1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console

This topic describes how to log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

**Prerequisites**

- The URL of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console is obtained from the deployment personnel.

- A web browser is available. We recommend that you use Google Chrome.

**Procedure**

1. Enter the URL of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console in the address bar and press the Enter key.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/687f6d006b35a4552292b1f7b3755914.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can click the current language in the upper-right corner to switch to another language.

2. Enter your username and password.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Obtain the username and password from an operations administrator.
   >
   > - If you log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console for the first time, you must follow the on-screen instructions to change the password of your account. For security purposes, the password must be 10 to 32 characters in length. It must contain all of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special characters are supported: ! @ # $ %

3. Click **Log In**.

4. If multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled for your account, perform the corresponding operations in the following scenarios:

   - **This is the first time that you log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console after MFA is forcefully enabled by the administrator.**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     On the Bind Virtual MFA Device page, follow the instructions to bind an MFA device.

     </li>

     <li>

     Enter the username and password again as in Step 2 and click **Log On**.

     </li>

     </ol>

     <ol type="i" start="100">

     <li>

     Enter a 6-digit MFA verification code and click **Authenticate**.

     </li>

     </ol>

   - **You have enabled MFA and bound an MFA device.**

     Enter a six-digit MFA verification code and click **Authenticate**.

     > **Note**
     >
     > For information about how to enable MFA and bind an MFA device, see Manage MFA.

**What to do next**

**Forget password**

1. If you forget the login password, click **Forgot Password** below the Password field.

2. On the Forgot Password page, configure the **Account Name** and **Email Address** parameters, specify the verification code, and then click **Confirm**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ac6a60f6a1f8edfafab7d3f08d294c4b.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can use the username of your account and the email address that was used to create the account.
   >
   > - The system sends a link for resetting the password to the email address that you specify.

## 3.4. Organization and permission models

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console allows you to efficiently manage resources. The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console introduces organizations and resource sets for resource management. This allows enterprises to manage the resources of multi-level organizations and projects.

**Organizational structure**

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console provides the following features based on the multi-level organization structure of enterprises:

The organizational structure is a tree structure that consists of a root organization and multiple organizational units. The root organization is automatically generated by the system and is at the top of the tree structure. An organizational structure can have multiple organizational units, which indicate the subsidiaries or departments of an enterprise. Organizational units are parallel.

> **Note**
>
> An organizational unit has only one level-1 organization. A level-1 organization can have multiple subordinate organizations. By default, an organizational unit can have up to five levels of organization.

In the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, cloud resources and users belong to Apsara Stack tenant accounts and each level-1 organization corresponds to an Apsara Stack tenant account. The subordinate organizations of a level-1 organization and the related users belong to the Apsara Stack tenant account to which the level-1 organization belongs.

After a level-1 organization is created, the system automatically generates an AccessKey pair for the organization. An AccessKey pair consists of an AccessKey ID and an AccessKey secret. AccessKey pairs are used to authenticate request senders. The AccessKey ID is used to identify a user. The AccessKey secret is used to encrypt a signature string.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e7251c4c4cdb66c2d936961cca01c1a8.jpeg)

**Relationships between items**

- **Organization**: Resources and accounts belong to organizations. An organization does not manage resources. Instead, the organization classifies resources into resource sets that belong to the organization. Organizations are similar to the subsidiaries or departments of enterprises.

- **User**: Users are user accounts associated with roles. When you create a user, you must associate the user with a role to grant the permissions of the role to the user. User accounts are used to log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

- **User group**: A user group contains a group of users who have the same permissions. User groups can be associated with roles in the same way as users. This allows you to grant permissions to all users in a user group at a time.

- **Role**: A role specifies a set of access permissions. When you create users, you need to associate different roles with the users to grant various access permissions to the users based on your business requirements.

- **Resource set**: Similar to a project of an enterprise, a resource set allows you to manage resources in a centralized manner. All resources are added to resource sets. Users or user groups can manage resources in a resource set after they are added to the resource set.

| Items | Relationshi p type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Organization and resource set | One-to-many | An organization can have multiple resource sets, but a resource set can belong to only a single organization. |
| Organization and user | One-to-many | An organization can have multiple users, but a user can belong to only a single organization. |
| User and resource set | Many-to-many | A user can be added to multiple resource sets. A resource set can also be assigned to multiple users in the level-1 organization to which the resource set belongs. |
| User and role | Many-to-many | A user can have multiple roles. A role can be assigned to multiple users. |
| Resource set and resource | One-to-many | A resource set can have multiple resources, but a resource can belong to only a single resource set. |

**Role permissions**

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console supports fine-grained permission management. This allows you to grant write and read permissions on various cloud resources to different users.

A user can have multiple roles. However, you need to switch to one role to manage resources.

- **Management permissions**: allow a role to perform specific operations in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. For example, you can grant management permissions to a role to authorize the role to perform operations on organizations, users, or resource sets.

- **Application permissions**: allow a role to perform operations on cloud services. You can grant application permissions to a role to allow the role to perform specific operations on specific cloud services. For example, if you want to authorize the role to only view Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances, you need to only select the ECS instance view permissions in the Application Permissions step.

- **Menu permissions**: allow a role to view specific menus. This implements menu access control. If you grant management permissions on the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and application permissions on cloud services to a role, you must grant menu permissions on the console to the role. This prevents the role from being unable to see corresponding menus.

- **Custom policy**: You can attach a custom Resource Access Management (RAM) policy to a role to allow or prohibit the role from performing specific operations on specific resources. When you configure a custom policy, you must specify the Allow and Deny parameters in the Set RAM Action for Application section. Enter the name of an action that you want to allow for the Allow parameter and enter the name of an action that you want to deny for the Deny parameter. If you specify both the Allow and Deny parameters, the deny authorization takes precedence over the allow authorization.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f4adbe99f812f32e0dde230ceea30f16.jpeg)

**Account permission model**

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console provides a system that integrates accounts with permissions based on the permission and account system of Apsara Stack. In this system, accounts and roles are separately managed. You can flexibly control the permissions in Apsara Stack by associating accounts with roles.

In the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, you can associate accounts with roles to grant or remove the permissions on corresponding resources.

The following figure shows the account permission model in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/afc93cf08212855cb6bfa1d71ca975a6.jpeg)

You can use one of the following three methods to grant permissions to users in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console:

- **Associate a preset role, custom role, or RAM-based batch authorization role with a user** You can associate a preset role or a custom role with a user. This is a common authorization method.

  - Preset roles are a set of roles that are preset by the system and have specific permissions. These roles have permissions for common operations and can be directly assigned to users. This simplifies the process of permission configuration.

  - Administrators can configure custom permissions for custom roles based on their business requirements. This ensures that the user permissions match their responsibilities and prevents excessive or insufficient permissions.

    ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c45eeb0ccd909568a9593d5726be98d8.jpeg)

- **Grant permissions to multiple users by using a user group**

  To grant the same permissions to multiple users, you can add these users to a user group and associate the user group with a role that has the corresponding permissions. This way, users in the user group are granted the same permissions.

  ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f8a63e969ac6f694da6e6baa9cfd276e.jpeg)

- **Grant data permissions to users**

  You can grant data permissions to users, which is a critical permission management method. On the Data Permissions page, you can accurately grant access, operation, or management permissions to users on specific resources based on the business requirements of the users. This way, users can efficiently use the required data within their scope of responsibility. You can grant data permissions on resource instances to users. This enhances fine-grained management.

  ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9f57818bb107e84e4de4653e99bbb61e.jpeg)

**Benefits**

- Clear hierarchical relationships

  Hierarchical relationships between enterprise organizations are clearly displayed.

- Easy management Administrators can clearly understand and easily manage various departments and teams.

- High flexibility

  Organization and permission models can be adjusted based on the business requirements of enterprises.

<a id="section-3-5"></a>

## 3.5. Initial configuration

<a id="section-3-5-1"></a>

### 3.5.1. Preset roles and their permissions

To implement separation of privilege, the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console provides several preset roles based on common use cases on cloud platforms. Each role has a collection of permissions that fit its definition.

Before you use the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, make sure that you are familiar with the preset roles and their permissions. This way, you can use the preset roles to properly manage the cloud platform.

| Preset role | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Platform administrator (preset user: super) | This role has the permissions to initialize the configurations of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, such as the technical component configurations, language configurations, and custom settings. |
| Operations administrator (preset user: admin) | This role has the permissions to create and manage organizations and resource sets, add and manage users, assign and manage roles, and activate and manage resources in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. |
| Organization administrator | This role has the permissions to manage the specified organization, create and manage subordinate organizations, create and manage resource sets, add and manage users, assign and manage roles, activate and manage resources, assign administrators and quotas to subordinate organizations and resource sets, and approve resource applications based on service process settings. |
| Resource set administrator | This role has the permissions to manage the specified resource set, add and manage users, activate and manage resources, and approve resource applications based on service process settings. |
| Resource user | This role has the permissions to use the cloud resources that are created and allocated by an operations administrator. |
| Resource auditor (preset user: auditor) | This role has read-only permissions on all resources in Apsara Stack. |
| Organization resource auditor | This role has read-only permissions on all resources in the organization to which it belongs. |
| Security auditor | This role has the permissions to audit the security of Apsara Stack. |
| Platform security administrator | This role has the permissions to use Security Operations Center (SOC) to manage the security of Apsara Stack. |
| Global organization security administrator (default user: yundunadmin) | This role has the permissions to use SOC to conduct security management for Apsara Stack and all tenants and manage security services related to Elastic Compute Service (ECS). |
| Organization security administrator | This role has the permissions to use SOC to manage the security of hosts, applications, and networks for an organization. This role also has the permissions to manage security services related to ECS. |
| Security system configuration administrator | This role has the permissions to configure system security features, such as the upgrade center and global configurations. |
| Platform security auditor | This role has the permissions to use SOC to check the security conditions of Apsara Stack. |
| Global organization security inspector | This role has the permissions to use SOC to check the security conditions of all organizations. |
| Platform security configuration administrator | This role has the permissions to configure security services in Apsara Stack, such as Server Guard and Web Application Firewall (WAF). |

> **Note**
>
> - The preset roles and their permissions cannot be modified or deleted.
>
> - The management scope indicates the scope in which the role permissions take effect.
>
>   - All Organizations: The role has permissions on all organizations.
>
>   - Specified Organization and Subordinate Organizations: The role has permissions on an organization and its subordinate organizations.
>
>   - Resource Sets: The role has permissions on the resource sets of the associated user.
>
> - The permission list describes the permissions of the roles to perform management operations in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and the permissions to call API operations. The basic permissions in the permission list are a set of encapsulated permissions to perform basic operations, such as viewing the homepage and managing user information.
>
> - Application permissions include the cloud products and product permissions authorized for the role.
>
> - Menu permissions include the menus authorized for the role.

<a id="section-3-5-2"></a>

### 3.5.2. Configuration description

Before you use the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, you must complete a series of basic configuration operations as an administrator, such as creating organizations, resource sets, users, and roles and initializing resources. This is the initial system configuration.

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console manages the organizations, resource sets, users, and roles of cloud data centers in a centralized and service-oriented manner to grant different resource access permissions to different users.

- Organization

  After the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console is deployed, a root organization is automatically generated. You can create other organizations under the root organization.

  Organizations are displayed in a hierarchical structure. You can create subordinate organizations under each organization level.

- Resource Set

  A resource set is a container used to store resources. Each resource must belong to a resource set.

- User

  A user is a resource manager and user.

- Role

  A role is a set of access permissions. You can assign different roles to different users to implement system access control to meet a variety of different requirements.

The following table describes the relationships among organizations, resource sets, users, roles, and cloud resources.

| Relationship between two items | Relationsh ip type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Organization and resource set | One-to-many | An organization can have multiple resource sets, but each resource set can belong to only a single organization. |
| Organization and user | One-to-many | An organization can have multiple users, but each user can belong to only a single organization. |
| Resource set and user | Many-to-many | A user can have multiple resource sets, and a resource set can be assigned to multiple users under the same level-1 organization. |
| User and role | Many-to-many | A user can have multiple roles, and a role can be assigned to multiple users. |
| Resource set and resource | One-to-many | A resource set can have multiple resources, but each cloud resource can belong to only a single resource set. |

<a id="section-3-5-3"></a>

### 3.5.3. Procedure

Before you use the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, you must complete the initial system configurations as an administrator based on the process shown in the following figure.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/fa1ac660df8cf93cf62e13adc270c7d6.png)

1. Create an organization to store resource sets and their resources.

2. Create users and assign them different roles to meet different requirements for system access control.

3. Create a resource set before you apply for resources. Add users to the resource set so that they can use the resources in the resource set.

4. Create instances as cloud resources in the consoles of cloud services. For more information about how to create cloud service instances, see the user guide of each cloud service.

<a id="section-4"></a>

# 4.Portal homepage

The Home page displays the usage and monitoring status of system resources in different regions from different dimensions by using a card-based layout. This helps you understand the overall resource status and provides supporting data for refined operations and statistical analysis.

> **Note**
>
> The Home page displays data that you have permissions to access.

**Procedure**

By default, the card-based layout of the Home page varies based on roles. You can add or remove cards to change the layout based on your business requirements.

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Home**.

3. Switch roles in the upper-left corner of the page. You can perform this operation if you are assigned multiple roles.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bc09527a120a6f5fa167ed0abbe43b4f.jpeg)

4. In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Add Card**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > If multiple tabs are displayed on the Home page, you can click a specific tab, and then add cards on the tab.

5. In the **Add Card** panel, switch between the **Preset Cards** and **My Cards** tabs, select or clear cards on the **Preset Cards** and **My Cards** tabs to adjust the cards displayed on the Home page.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can select or clear cards to add the cards to or remove the cards from the Home page. After you add a card, you can click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a203e0285c4c8a9278b840704b63c464.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the upper-right
   >
   >   corner of the card and then click **Remove from Workbench** to remove the card from the Home page.
   >
   > - You can click and drag the
   >
   >   icon in the lower-right corner of a card to resize the
   >
   >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/43ec03fa5d30491fffe1181580ddefd0.png" width="11" alt="">
   >
   >   card. You can click and drag the
   >
   >   icon in the upper-left corner of a card to
   >
   >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8f3a2b758a031cecd5317b6a337e67a6.png" width="17" alt="">
   >
   >   change its position on the Home page.
   >
   > - You can click **Restore to Default Layout** at the bottom of the **Add Card** panel to restore the default layout of the Home page.
   >
   > - If the cards on the **My Cards** tab do not meet your requirements, you can click **Customize** in the lower part of the tab to customize a card. To go to the card configuration page, you can also choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis** in the top navigation bar and then choose **Custom Analysis** > **My Dashboard** in the left-side navigation pane.
   >
   > - After you add a custom card on the Home page, you can click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a203e0285c4c8a9278b840704b63c464.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the
   >
   >   upper-right corner of the card and then click **Edit** to go to the card configuration page.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/81f4a7ff1e436ceab8dbb59497372d54.jpeg)

**Preset cards**

Preset cards are classified into the following categories: commonly used information, resource alerts, resource health analytics, resource statistics and analysis, resource bills, and intelligent computing operations. Different roles have different permissions. Different cards are displayed based on roles.

**Commonly used information**

The commonly used information category contains the following cards: **Quick Navigation**, **Organization Overview**, **Announcements**, **To-do Center**, **Services and Support**, **Resource Overview**, **Resource Search**, and **Resource Pool Overview**.

**Quick Navigation**

This card provides multiple shortcuts for quick navigation to the corresponding pages. In the **Quick entry** and **Recent visit** sections, you can click the displayed shortcuts to go to the corresponding pages.

> **Note**
>
> In the Quick Entry section, you can add shortcuts based on your business requirements. You can add up to 12 shortcuts to cloud services and modules. To add a shortcut, perform the following operations: Click **Add Entry** in the Quick Entry section. In the dialog box that appears, click a product in the left-side navigation pane, move the pointer over the
>
> name of the cloud service whose shortcut you want to add, and then click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bdff702e5416f8b38ec988053e453b02.png" width="11" alt=""> icon.
>
> After you add a shortcut, the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/2bf26f66e7730e665bf42ace88f2a2e3.png" width="12" alt=""> icon is displayed to the right of the cloud service name.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a810589b721fbd0c324eb6a50f794def.jpeg)

**Organization Overview**

This card displays the overall information about organizations, resource sets, and users. You can click the sections in the card to go to the corresponding pages.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/205aeac296426e77a6961b57e7be6ef6.jpeg)

**Announcements**

This card displays the announcement list and details. You can click **View more** to view more announcements in the **Announcement** panel.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5dc76341789262f888f518ab3ffdd48d.jpeg)

**To-do Center**

This card displays the to-do list of the current role, including application forms, orders, and tickets to be handled. You can click **View More** to view more to-do lists in the **To-do Center** panel.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/48aeb7f598015b0cb81da5223170f996.jpeg)

This card provides links to technical support. You can click the links to go to the corresponding pages.

This card displays global resources. You can perform the following operations to quickly create resources: Click **Create resources**. In the dialog box that appears, find the resource type that you want to create and create resources.

**Resource Search**

This card allows you to search for resources in a global manner. You can search for resources by resource pool, resource type, organization, resource set, region, tag, and expiration time.

> **Note**

> The resource pool drop-down list is displayed only in multi-cloud environments.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9c83fb58cc7a2404045c46efb441950a.jpeg)

This card displays the overview of resource pools in a map in multi-cloud and multi-region scenarios.

**Resource alerts**

The resource alerts category includes the following cards: **Resource Load**, **Monitoring and Alerts**, and **Alerts**.

**Resource Load**

This card displays the resource load of the current account. You can click the Region drop-down list above the resource list to change regions.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/2f9b3ed72c85394b833a77cd4d6a74dd.jpeg)

**Resource health analysis**

The resource health analytics category includes the following cards: **Resource Health Overview**, **Resource Health Analytics**, **Idle Resource Ranking**, and **Resource Bottleneck Rankings**.

**Resource Health Overview**

This card displays the health status of the resources of the current organization. You can click **Improve** to go to the Overall Health Score page in the Operations menu to view details.

> **Note**
>
> - The overall health score is calculated based on resource usage, idle resource analytics, and resource compliance analytics.
>
> - The health score levels are as follows:
>
>   - 0 to 50 points: poor
>
>   - 51 to 70 points: medium
>
>   - 71 to 90 points: good
>
>   - 91 to 100 points: healthy

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/02547512d8991b3b60e2e9f76bd06eb9.jpeg)

> **Note**
>
> - You can click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9f4a3df63078b32b4c7acd3848604bc6.png" width="18" alt=""> to change the display order of resources based on your business
>

>

>

# 5.Enterprise

<a id="section-5-1"></a>

## 5.1. Resource management

<a id="section-5-1-1"></a>

### 5.1.1. Use resource retrieval

The resource retrieval feature provides a unified search capability for multi-region resources in multi-level organizations and multi-cloud services, and supports custom filter conditions.

**Prerequisites**

Your role is a preset role other than the platform administrator. The Resource Retrieval menu permissions are granted to your role on the Role Permissions page if you use a custom role.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Retrieval**.

4. View the resources within the current account.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f6d8b2f76037bf9978d608b6171e18f2.jpeg)

   - **View global resources**

     By default, the page displays all the resources that the role assumed by the current user has the permissions to view.

   - **View resources by organization and resource set**

     In the left-side organization list, select one or more organizations and resource sets to view the corresponding resources.

   - **View resources by filter conditions**

     In the upper part of the page, specify filter conditions to view the resources that meet the specified filter conditions.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - You can search for resources based on the following conditions:
     >
     >   - Cloud Platform: displays the cloud platforms visible to the current user. They are displayed only in multi-cloud environments instead of single-cloud environments.
     >
     >   - Resource Type: displays the types of deployed resources.
     >
     >   - Region: displays the regions that are visible to the current user.
     >
     >   - Label: displays the tags added to the resources on the central cloud platform and managed cloud platforms in multi-cloud environments. Managed cloud platforms include managed Apsara Stack platforms and managed Alibaba Cloud platforms.
     >
     >   - General search: Select Keyword, Resource ID, Resource Name, or Resource IP from the drop-down list and enter a keyword for fuzzy search.
     >
     > - You can save the filter conditions that you specify. This way, you can directly select the saved filter conditions from the **My Filters** drop-down list next time and view the resources that meet the selected filter conditions. You can also delete a set of saved filter conditions from the **My Filters** drop-down list by clicking the
     >
     >   icon next to the filter conditions.
     >
     >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0a1b14e8aa23641bd620b003e6cc85f9.png" width="14" alt="">
     >
     > - You can click **Reset** to clear the specified filter conditions.

5. Optional. Click **Create Instance** above the resource list. In the Create Instance panel, select a resource that you want to create and go to the resource creation page.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can search for resources by cloud platform and cloud service name.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a213bbcf48fdc361241713b405663356.jpeg)

6. Optional. Click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5052693bc87db251c50d1f5c627e61cc.png" width="18" alt=""> icon above the resource list and click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/61cc449a20c0ea748c4b261805753c9d.png" width="14" alt=""> , <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3edcc1158955b61fe73e9cacfdd54c28.png" width="14" alt=""> , or <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3955d7e1d4dea555813be4f98623eddc.png" width="14" alt=""> icon to adjust

   the display items and their orders in the resource list based on your business requirements.

   > **Note**
   >
   > <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/61cc449a20c0ea748c4b261805753c9d.png" width="14" alt=""> : refreshes the resource list. You can refresh the information displayed in the
   >
   > resource list while retaining the specified filter conditions.
   >
   > <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3edcc1158955b61fe73e9cacfdd54c28.png" width="14" alt=""> : displays information in default or compact mode.
   >
   > <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3955d7e1d4dea555813be4f98623eddc.png" width="14" alt=""> : shows or hides specific items in the resource list. You can click and hold the
   >
   > icon in front of a display item and then drag it upward or downward to adjust
   >
   > <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/69f9d2ba6d10a20cfa22408d1326e4dc.png" width="11" alt="">
   >
   > the order of the item. By default, the **Resource IP** column is not displayed in the resource list. You can select Resource IP to show it in the resource list as required.

7. Perform resource-related operations.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Some resources can be viewed. You can find the resource that you want to view and click **View** in the Operation column to go to the resource console and manage the resource.
   >
   > - Some resources support other quick operations. You can directly select an option in the Operation column to perform the related operation.

8. Optional. Add tags to or remove tags from one or more resources.

   > **Note**
   >
   > In multi-cloud environments, you can add tags to and remove tags from resources on the central cloud platform or managed cloud platforms.
   >
   > - The tags of managed Apsara Stack platforms can be added to and removed from the resources of all supported cloud services. To manage tags, you must have the tag management permissions of the roles of managed Apsara Stack platforms.
   >
   > - For more information about cloud services that support the tag management of managed Alibaba Cloud platforms and the required user permissions, see the Cloud services that support the tag management of managed Alibaba Cloud platforms section of this topic.

<a id="section-5-1-1-1"></a>

#### 5.1.1.1. View the resource list

View resources centrally on the Resource Search page.

**Prerequisites**

By default, the operating user is any preset role other than the platform administrator. Custom roles can be granted the Resource Search menu permission as needed in role authorization.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resource Management** > **Resource Search**.

4. View the resource list under the current account permissions.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0f6e21b2463d931ea6886fc37ca954aa.jpeg)

   - **View the global resource list**

     The page displays, by default, the full list of resources accessible to the current user under the current role.

   - **View resources by organization and resource set**

     In the organization tree on the left side of the page, select the target organization and resource set to view the corresponding resource list.

   - **View resources by query conditions**

     Set filter conditions above the list on the right side of the page to view the resource list that matches the specified conditions.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - You can filter by resource pool, resource type, region, tags, expiration time, and general search (keywords, resource ID, resource name, resource IP).
     >
     >   - Resource pool: Displays the list of resource pools visible to the current user. This option appears only in multi-cloud scenarios and is hidden in single-cloud scenarios.
     >
     >   - Resource type: Displays the list of deployed resource types.
     >
     >   - Region: Displays the list of regions visible to the current user.
     >
     >   - Tags: In multi-cloud scenarios, you can view tags bound to resources in the central cloud and subordinate clouds (including multiple private clouds and public clouds)..
     >
     >   - Expiration time: Set a start time and end time for expiration to query resources by expiration time.
     >
     >   - General search: Switch as needed to keywords, resource ID, resource name, or resource IP, then enter keywords for fuzzy search.
     >
     > - After setting filter conditions, you can save them. Next time, you can quickly select from **My Filters** to view the target resource list. You can also hover over a saved filter condition in **My Filters** and click
     >
     >   to delete it.
     >
     >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0a1b14e8aa23641bd620b003e6cc85f9.png" width="14" alt="">
     >
     > - Click **Reset** to clear all set filter conditions.

5. (Optional) Above the list, select <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/61cc449a20c0ea748c4b261805753c9d.png" width="14" alt=""> , <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3edcc1158955b61fe73e9cacfdd54c28.png" width="14" alt=""> , or <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3955d7e1d4dea555813be4f98623eddc.png" width="14" alt=""> to adjust displayed items and their order

   according to your needs.

   > **Note**
   >
   > <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/61cc449a20c0ea748c4b261805753c9d.png" width="14" alt=""> : Refreshes the list. You can refresh resource information while preserving
   >
   > existing filter conditions.
   >
   > <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3edcc1158955b61fe73e9cacfdd54c28.png" width="14" alt=""> : Choose between default or compact display for list information.
   >
   > <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3955d7e1d4dea555813be4f98623eddc.png" width="14" alt=""> : Configure which columns to show or hide. Hover over any column, then drag
   >
   > the
   >
   > icon next to it to adjust display order. The **Resource IP** column is hidden
   >
   > <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/69f9d2ba6d10a20cfa22408d1326e4dc.png" width="11" alt="">
   >
   > by default; you can check it to display as needed.

<a id="section-5-1-1-2"></a>

#### 5.1.1.2. Bind or unbind tags for resources

The resource retrieval page allows you to bind or unbind tags for resources.

> **Note**
>
> In multi-cloud scenarios, you can bind and unbind tags for central cloud and subordinate cloud resources.
>
> - The product scope for tag operations in the multi-enterprise edition covers all products that support tags. The operating user must have tag operation permissions assigned through a mapped role in the subordinate cloud.
>
> - For the product scope and user permission details of public cloud tag operations, see Cloud services in the public cloud that support tag operations.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resource Management** > **Resource Search**.

4. Bind or unbind tags for resources.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Operation</td>
       <td>Description</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Bind tags to a single resource</td>
       <td>i. In the resource list, click<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bba26a793b21fa01adba7a1dd308e569.png" width="14" alt="">in the <strong>Tag</strong> column of the target resource.<br>ii. In the <strong>Edit Tag</strong> dialog box, add tag keys and tag values.<br>Note<br>You can bind up to 20 tags to each resource.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/70b5eddb03de4c3071af30c5ec3431a2.jpeg" alt=""><br>iii. Click OK.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Bind tags to multiple resources at once</td>
       <td>i. In the resource list, select the resources to which you want to bind tags.<br>ii. Click <strong>Batch Add Tags</strong> below the list.<br>iii. In the <strong>Batch Add Tags</strong> dialog box, add tag keys and tag values.<br>Note<br>• This setting applies to all selected resources and may result in new tags being added or existing tags being replaced. To manage tags uniformly, go to tag management.<br>• You can operate on up to 50 resources at a time. Each resource can have up to 20 tags.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0ef7a41b49de881149184ed3b371f7ba.jpeg" alt=""><br>iv. Click OK.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Unbind tags from a single resource</td>
       <td>i. In the resource list, click<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bba26a793b21fa01adba7a1dd308e569.png" width="14" alt="">in the <strong>Tag</strong> column of the target resource.<br>ii. In the <strong>Edit Tag</strong> dialog box, click<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9a175c2d5713642b53b64775c5026893.png" width="18" alt="">next to the tag value and tag key.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a9956b46b0298aefed524cd7c66b0683.jpeg" alt=""><br>iii. Click OK.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Unbind tags from multiple resources at once</td>
       <td>i. In the resource list, select the resources from which you want to unbind tags.<br>ii. Click <strong>Batch Remove Tags</strong> below the list.<br>iii. In the <strong>Batch Remove Tags</strong> dialog box, select the tags to unbind.<br>Note<br>You can select all tags or specific target tags. If you select target tags, any other tags with the same tag key as the target tags are automatically selected.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cf2f03ddec707b934b5c9f312597b47d.jpeg" alt=""><br>iv. Click OK.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

#### 5.1.1.5. View and configure an expiration reminder rule

You can view and configure expiration reminder rules on the Resource Retrieval page. After you configure an expiration reminder rule, the system notifies the specified notification objects of resource expiration once a day before the resource expires.

> **Note**
>
> Only the system operations administrator and custom operations administrator have the permissions to view and configure expiration reminder rules. Therefore, the Expiration Reminder Rule button is visible only to the two roles. Other roles cannot view or use this feature.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Retrieval**.

4. On the Resource Retrieval page, click **Expiration Reminder Rule** above the resource list.

5. In the **Expiration Reminder Rule** dialog box, view and configure an expiration reminder rule.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Active | Specifies whether to enable the rule.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b38c4eb74f08967146accf9fd2bd64e5.png)<br>: disables the rule.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/58c24e9f7e3597775d6a6b940485f14e.png)<br>: enables the rule. |
   | Trigger Time | The number of days before the resource expires when the rule is triggered.Valid values: 1 to 30. |
   | Notification Object | The role to be notified when the rule is triggered. You can select one or more roles. You can select up to five roles.<br>The system sends expiration notifications of resources at a level only to the roles of the corresponding level. For example, if the organization administrator and resource set administrator are specified as the notification objects, the system sends expiration notifications of level-2 organization resources only to the level-2 organization administrator and resource set administrator. |
   | Notification Time | The time when the notification is sent. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f964c897542244edc588dea903082d32.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-1-2"></a>

### 5.1.2. Organization management

<a id="section-5-1-2-1"></a>

#### 5.1.2.1. Create organizations

Organizations reflect the organizational structure of an enterprise. An organization can be defined as a company or department, and is the core of personnel and resource management. Organizations meet requirements for hierarchical management and resource isolation. You can build a resource management system that meets the requirements of your enterprise by using organizations based on the business environment of your enterprise. This helps you establish hierarchical relationships among resources.

**Background information**

- In the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, resources and resource sets belong to organizations. By default, a root organization is created. It does not accommodate any resources.

- The root organization contains level-1 organizations, and the level-1 organizations contain level-2 organizations. The same method applies to subordinate organizations.

- When you create an organization, the system creates a resource set for the organization by default.

- After a level-1 organization is created, an AccessKey pair is automatically generated for the level-1 organization. The AccessKey pair consists of an AccessKey ID and an AccessKey secret, which are used for identity authentication and authorization to access cloud service resources. To enhance security, you can change the AccessKey pair on a regular basis based on your business requirements. The system records AccessKey pair logs. You can also check the AccessKey pair logs for abnormal activities to track and identify potential security threats at the earliest opportunity.

**Limits**

- You can create at most five levels of organizations.

- You can create at most 500 organizations at a time.

**Plan an organizational structure**

Before you create an organization, you need to plan an organizational structure based on the business requirements of your enterprise. You can plan an organizational structure based on the following methods:

- Plan the organizational structure by department and responsibility

  In most cases, an enterprise is divided into different departments based on their business requirements and responsibilities. The departments include the human resources department, the sales department, and the research and development (R&D) department. Each department has different responsibilities and provides different services.

- Plan the organizational structure by business unit and geographical distribution

  Large enterprises generally divide their business into different units. Each business unit may be responsible for a specific product line or region.

**Create organizations**

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Organizations**.

4. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, select a parent organization and click **Create Organization** in the upper-right corner of the right-side page.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If you select the root organization, the organization that you create is a level-1 organization.
   >
   > - If you want to create a level-2 organization, you must select a level-1 organization. The same method applies to subordinate organizations. You can create at most five levels of organizations.
   >
   > - An operations administrator can create level-1 to level-5 organizations. An organization administrator can create only subordinate organizations under the organization to which the organization administrator belongs.

5. In the **Add Organization** dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Name | The name of the organization. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and cannot start or end with a space.<br>Note<br>The organization name must be unique in the organizational structure. |
   | Description | The description of the organization. |
   | Associate Third-party Authenticatio n | If no global identity provider (IdP) is configured in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, you can select <strong>Set Now</strong> or <strong>Set Later</strong>.<br>• If you select <strong>Set Now</strong>, you must select a local IdP name from the <strong>IdP Name</strong> drop-down list. You can associate only one IdP with the organization.<br>• If you select <strong>Set Later</strong>, third-party authentication is not associated.<br>Important<br>• The <strong>Associate Third-party Authentication</strong> parameter is displayed only when you create a level-1 organization.<br>• If a global IdP has been configured in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, third-party authentication cannot be associated with level-1 organizations. In this case, <strong>Set Now</strong> and <strong>Set</strong> <strong>Later</strong> are dimmed. |

6. Click **OK**.

7. In the **Create Resource Set** dialog box, click **Cancel** or **Create Resource Set**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > For more information about how to configure the parameters when you create a resource set in an organization, see Create a resource set.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8505767c718fbe123fcddb39bb920b8b.jpeg)

**Create multiple organizations at a time**

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, click **Batch Create**.

2. In the **Create Organizations** dialog box, click **Create Organization Templates** to download the template file in the **XLSX** format to your local computer.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/376f1c09245291dc049f4c02da881a03.jpeg)

3. Fill the template file with the information about the organizations to be created and save the file. The following figure shows an example of the information.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e84e18efde843f2cb816cd5263080a7e.png)

4. Click **Next** in the **Create Organizations** dialog box.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4d13a5f103c11cddda7df2af25dccfdd.jpeg)

5. In the Import Step, click **Upload Template** and select the template file that you filled. After the template file is verified, click **Next**.

   > **Important**
   >
   > When the template file is uploaded, the system automatically checks the validity of parameter values. If invalid values exist, the organizations cannot be created. In this case, you must modify the template file and click **Re-upload**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9fb038b036d77b4e2e0cd809e6303ad0.jpeg)

6. Confirm the organization information and click **OK**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/36a19a33bfb747f7542d430887269406.jpeg)

7. Optional. Click **Task List** in the dialog box to view the organizations that you created.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cce7871ca270853f5ab5500df096b5ad.jpeg)

#### 5.1.2.5. Manage the AccessKey pairs of an organization

You can regularly change the AccessKey pairs of an organization based on your business requirements. This enhances security.

**Limits**

Each level-1 organization can have up to two AccessKey pairs. By default, only operations administrators and level-1 organization administrators have the permissions to manage the AccessKey pairs of organizations.

- Operations administrators can manage the AccessKey pairs of all level-1 organizations.

- Level-1 organization administrators can manage only the AccessKey pairs of their respective level-1 organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Organizations**.

4. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the level-1 organization that you want to manage and click its name.

5. In the **Basic Information** section, click **Manage AccessKey Pairs**.

6. In the **Manage AccessKey Pairs** dialog box, manage the AccessKey pairs of the organization.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3104162c4fbe3a6bce35479103e0130e.jpeg)

   | Operation | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Create an AccessKey pair | Click <strong>Create AccessKey Pair</strong> above the list to create an AccessKey pair.<br>Note<br>If two AccessKey pairs already exist in the list, no more AccessKey pairs can be created. A message appears indicating that the limit has been exceeded. |
   | Show an AccessKey secret | Find an AccessKey pair whose AccessKey secret is hidden and click the<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/55d297eb9948ea1b89d90631d3d94ddc.png" width="19" alt=""><br>icon to show the AccessKey secret. |
   | Hide an AccessKey secret | Find an AccessKey pair whose AccessKey secret is shown and click the<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/55d297eb9948ea1b89d90631d3d94ddc.png" width="19" alt=""><br>icon to hide the AccessKey secret. |
   | Disable an AccessKey pair | i. Find an enabled AccessKey pair and click <strong>Disable</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column.<br>ii. In the dialog box that appears, view the information about the AccessKey pair and the impacts after you disable the AccessKey pair. After you evaluate the impacts, select <strong>I have known the risks and confirm this</strong> <strong>operation</strong>.<br>Important<br>• When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose <strong>Enterprise</strong> &gt; Permissions &gt; <strong>AccessKey Logs</strong>.<br>• After you disable an AccessKey pair, the services or applications that use the AccessKey pair become unavailable.Proceed with caution when you perform this operation.<br>iii. Click <strong>Disable</strong>. After you disable the AccessKey pair, the AccessKey pair changes to the <strong>Disable</strong> state. |
   | Enable an AccessKey pair | Find a disabled AccessKey pair and click <strong>Activate</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column.After you enable the AccessKey pair, the AccessKey pair changes to the <strong>Enabled</strong> state. |
   | Delete an AccessKey pair | i. Find the AccessKey pair that you want to delete and click <strong>Delete</strong> in the Actions column.<br>ii. In the dialog box that appears, view the information about the AccessKey pair and the impacts after you delete the AccessKey pair. After you evaluate the impacts, select <strong>I have known the risks and confirmed</strong> <strong>this delete operation</strong>.<br>Important<br>• When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose <strong>Enterprise</strong> &gt; <strong>Permissions</strong> &gt; <strong>AccessKey Logs</strong>.<br>• After you delete an AccessKey pair, the applications that use the AccessKey pair become unavailable. Proceed with caution when you perform this operation.<br>iii. Click <strong>Delete</strong>. |

<a id="section-5-1-2-6"></a>

#### 5.1.2.6. Configure third-party authentication

This topic describes how to associate an identity provider (IdP) with an organization. After you associate an IdP with an organization, the identities of users of the organization and subordinate organizations are verified by the IdP when the users log on to the system.

**Prerequisites**

IdP settings are configured by the platform administrator. To configure IdP settings, choose **Configurations** > **Authentication by Third Party**.

**Limits**

You can associate IdPs only with level-1 organizations. Each level-1 organization can be associated with only one IdP, including a global IdP.

- If a global IdP is configured in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, the global IdP is displayed and cannot be changed.

- If a level-1 organization is associated with a local IdP, other level-1 organizations can still be associated with the same local IdP or other local IdPs.

- When an organization is associated with a local IdP, the button for authorization-based logon is unavailable on the logon page of the system. In this case, users can be navigated to the system only after they log on to the local IdP.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Organizations**.

4. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the level-1 organization that you want to manage and click its name.

5. In the **Basic Information** section, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a4236870dbe0215be8b8ce75c3c94e76.png" width="13" alt=""> icon and select **Third-**

   **party Authentication**.

6. In the **Third-party Authentication** dialog box, configure the **IdP Authentication Type** and **Associate IdP** parameters.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/281788ec058a9526dc1a180db3ab77b5.jpeg)

   - **IdP Authentication Type**: **Local IdP** and **Global IdP** are supported.

     > **Note**
     >
     > If the platform administrator has configured a global IdP, the IdP authentication type is set to **Global IdP** by default.

   - **Associate IdP**:

     - If the **IdP Authentication Type** parameter is set to **Global IdP**, the name of the global IdP is displayed in the **Associate IdP** field by default.

     - If the **IdP Authentication Type** parameter is set to **Local IdP**, select a local IdP from the **Associate IdP** drop-down list.

       > **Note**
       >
       > To change the local IdP, click **Modify** and select another IdP from the **Associate IdP** drop-down list. You can also disassociate the local IdP.

7. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-1-2-7"></a>

#### 5.1.2.7. Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization

The proxy administrator feature on the Organizations page allows you to authorize a user to manage organizations as a specific role. You can use this feature to enable a user to manage multiple level-1 organizations. After you specify a proxy administrator for an organization, a proxy user that maps to the proxy administrator is created. The proxy user can manage the organization as the assigned role. For more information about how to specify a proxy administrator for a resource set, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.

**Specify a proxy administrator**

**Limits**

- Only users of other level-1 organizations can be specified as proxy administrators.

- You can select only one role whose permission scope is Specified Organization and Subordinate Organizations as the proxy role.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Organizations**.

4. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

5. In the **Basic Information** section, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a4236870dbe0215be8b8ce75c3c94e76.png" width="13" alt=""> icon and select **Set Proxy**

   **Administrator**.

6. In the **Set Proxy Administrator** dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Current Organizati on | The name of the current organization. This parameter cannot be modified. |

   | Configurati on Method | Only <strong>Assign</strong> is supported. |
   | --- | --- |
   | Select User | The user who is specified as the proxy administrator. You can select only one user from another level-1 organization. You can search for a user by organization and username above the user list. |
   | Proxy Role | The role assigned to the proxy user. |
   | Proxy Scope | The permission scope of the proxy administrator, which is the same as the permission scope of the selected proxy role. This parameter cannot be modified. |
   | Proxy Period | The start time and end time of the proxy. The proxy administrator cannot perform proxy operations outside the specified time period. |
   | Description | The description of the proxy administrator. |

7. Click **OK**.

**View the details of a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for an organization. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

2. On the right side of the page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. View the proxy administrator information in the list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1d1f4e4032eeb625ccb4e19bb01792af.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Proxy Administrator: a proxy user of the organization. A proxy user is automatically created after a proxy administrator is specified for an organization. The user who is specified as the proxy administrator performs proxy operations as the proxy user.
   >
   > - Proxy Status: the proxy status. A proxy administrator can be in the Activating, Disabled, or Expired state. If a proxy administrator is in the Disabled or Expired state, the corresponding proxy user cannot log on.
   >
   >   - Activating: The proxy is within the validity period, and the proxy administrator is not disabled.
   >
   >   - Disabled: The proxy administrator is disabled.
   >
   >   - Expired: The proxy period expires, and the proxy administrator cannot perform proxy operations.
   >
   > - Owner: the user who is specified as the proxy administrator. After the user logs on, the user can switch to the proxy user in the user center. For more information, see Enable the proxy mode as a proxy administrator for a proxy user.

5. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click its name.

6. On the User Details page, view the details of the proxy administrator.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/abcfaa46074cf92dd8daa92fdf52ab55.jpeg)

**Modify a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for an organization. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

2. On the right side of the page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Change** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

5. In the **Edit Proxy Administrator** dialog box, select a proxy role, specify a proxy period, and then enter a description.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b833e4c2a5d8c417e7656e3f1ad8a853.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

**Disable a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

- A proxy administrator is specified for an organization. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

- The proxy administrator is in the Activating or Expired state.

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

2. On the right side of the page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Disable** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Enable a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

- A proxy administrator is specified for an organization. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

- The proxy administrator is in the Disabled state.

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

2. On the right side of the page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Enable** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Delete a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for an organization. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

2. On the right side of the page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Delete** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

#### 5.1.2.8. Manage the resource sets of an organization

5. On the right side of the Organizations page, click the **Resource Sets** tab.

6. On the **Resource Sets** tab, click **Create Resource Set**.

7. In the **Create Resource Set** dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

       <th>Description</th>
     </tr>

To enable this feature, choose <strong>Configurations</strong> &gt; <strong>Security Policies</strong> &gt; <strong>Security Level</strong> <strong>Based Access</strong>.</td>

8. Click **OK**.

**View resource sets and details**

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Sets** tab, view the resource sets in the current organization. You can search for a resource set by resource set name or tag above the resource set list.

   >
