<a id="section-5-1-2-9"></a>

#### 5.1.2.9. Manage the users of an organization

On the Users tab of the Organizations page, you can manage the users of an organization and its subordinate organizations.

**Create a user**

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Organizations**.

4. In the left-side Organization Structure pane of the **Organizations** page, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

5. On the right side of the **Organizations** page, click the **Users** tab.

6. On the **Users** tab, click **Create User**.

7. In the **Create User** dialog box, configure the parameters. For more information, see Create users.

8. Click **OK**.

**View users and user details**

**Procedure**

1. On the **Users** tab, view the users in the current organization. You can search for a user by username above the user list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1ed16362251069e69f465ed151869f4e.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > If you select the root organization, the users of all organizations are displayed.

2. Find the user that you want to view and click its name to go to the **User Details** page.

   | Section or tab | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Basic information | In the upper part of the User Details page, you can view the basic information about the user, including the following parameters: <strong>User Name</strong>, <strong>Display Name</strong>, <strong>Password</strong>, <strong>Organization</strong>, <strong>UID</strong>, <strong>Mobile Phone Number</strong>, <strong>Landline</strong>, <strong>Email</strong> <strong>Address</strong>, <strong>Most Recent Login</strong>, <strong>External System Association</strong>, <strong>DingTalk Token</strong>, <strong>Remarks</strong>, <strong>User Role</strong>, <strong>User Group Role</strong>, <strong>Access Method</strong>, and <strong>Multi-Cloud</strong> <strong>Role</strong>.<br>Note<br>The valid value of the <strong>Access Method</strong> parameter is Console Access. |
   | Resource Set | This tab displays the resource sets to which the user is added. For more information, see Manage the resource sets to which users belong. |
   | User Group | This tab displays the user groups to which the user is added. For more information, see Manage the user groups to which a user belongs.<br>You can search for a user group by user group name above the user group list. |
   | Role Permissions | This tab displays the information about the preset, custom, and Resource Access Management (RAM)-based batch authorization roles that are assigned to the user.<br>• In the <strong>Preset Roles &amp; Custom Roles</strong> section, select a role from the drop-down list to view the permissions of the role.<br>• In the <strong>RAM Authorization</strong> section, view the RAM-based batch authorization roles that are assigned to the user. |

**Disable a user**

**Prerequisites**

A user is in the **Enabled** state.

**Limits**

You cannot disable proxy administrators on the Users tab. To disable a proxy administrator, go to the Organizations or Resource Sets page, find the organization or resource set that you want to manage, go to its Proxy Administrator tab, and then disable the proxy administrator. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Users** tab, find the user that you want to disable and click **Disable** in the Actions column.

2. In the dialog box that appears, view the information about the associated AccessKey pairs and the impacts after you disable the user. After you evaluate the impacts, select **I have known the risks and confirm this operation**.

   > **Important**
   >
   > - When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose **Enterprise** > Permissions > **AccessKey Logs**.
   >
   > - After you disable a user, the user is forbidden from logging in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, the AccessKey pairs of the user are disabled, and the user login status becomes invalid. After an AccessKey pair is disabled, the services or applications that reference the AccessKey pair may not run as expected. In this case, enable the user to restore the services or applications.

3. Click **Disable**. After the user is disabled, the user enters the **Disabled** state.

**Enable a user**

**Prerequisites**

A user is in the **Disabled** state.

**Limits**

You cannot enable proxy administrators on the Users tab. To enable a proxy administrator, go to the Organizations or Resource Sets page, find the organization or resource set that you want to manage, go to its Proxy Administrator tab, and then enable the proxy administrator. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Users** tab, find the user that you want to enable and click **Enable** in the **Actions** column.

2. In the message that appears, view the information about AccessKey pairs and click **OK**. After the user is enabled, the user enters the **Enabled** state.

   > **Note**
   >
   > After a user is enabled, the associated AccessKey pairs are also enabled.

**Delete a user**

**Limits**

You cannot delete proxy administrators on the Users tab. To delete a proxy administrator, go to the Organizations or Resource Sets page, find the organization or resource set that you want to manage, go to its Proxy Administrator tab, and then delete the proxy administrator. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Users** tab, find the user that you want to delete and click **Delete** in the Actions column.

2. In the dialog box that appears, view the information about the associated AccessKey pairs and the impacts after you delete the user. After you evaluate the impacts, select **I have known the risks and confirmed this delete operation**.

   > **Important**
   >
   > - When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose **Enterprise** > Permissions > **AccessKey Logs**.
   >
   > - After you delete a user, the user is forbidden from logging in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, the AccessKey pairs of the user are deleted, and the user login status becomes invalid. The deleted user data cannot be restored. After an AccessKey pair is deleted, the services or applications that reference the AccessKey pair may not run as expected. Before you delete a user, we recommend that you disable the user first and troubleshoot issues.

3. Click **Delete**.

<a id="section-5-1-2-11"></a>

#### 5.1.2.11. Manage multi-cloud organizations

On the Multi-Cloud Organizations tab of the Tenant Management page, you can manage multi-cloud organizations.

**Constraints**

- The Multi-Cloud Organizations tab appears only in level-1 organizations.

- On the **Public Cloud** tab of the **Multi-Cloud Management** page under **Native Hybrid Cloud** > **Configuration**, platform administrator users can enable Allow Binding to Multiple Level-1 Organizations for resource pools of the independent primary account type. This switch is disabled by default. After you enable it, the setting takes permanent effect and requires O&M operations to disable.

  - When the switch is on: Multiple level-1 organizations can bind to the same public cloud primary account.

  - When the switch is off: Existing mappings where multiple level-1 organizations bind to the same public cloud primary account remain intact. You can manually unbind them. Simultaneously, binding multiple level-1 organizations to the same public cloud primary account is prohibited.

- A level-1 organization can bind to only one resource account. A resource account can bind to only one level-1 organization.

**Bind multi-cloud organizations**

**Prerequisites**

- The platform administrator user has completed multi-cloud access in **Configuration** > **Native Hybrid Cloud** > **Multi-Cloud Management**.

- You are an operations administrator user. You have either bound the operations administrator role of a secondary Apsara Stack or bound a RAM role with the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, click **Resources** > **Tenant Management**.

4. On the **Tenant Management** page, click the name of a level-1 organization in the left-side organizational structure.

5. On the right side, click the **Multi-Cloud Organizations** tab.

6. On the **Multi-Cloud Organizations** tab, click **Bind Multi-Cloud Organization**.

7. In the **Bind Multi-Cloud Organization** dialog box, select the resource pool information that you want to bind.

   - **Bind Apsara Stack organization**

     | Configuration item | Description |
     | --- | --- |
     | Organization | Shows the name of the current organization. You cannot modify it. |
     | Resource pool | Select the resource pool that you want to bind. |
     | Organization | If the resource pool that you bind is of the Apsara Stack type, select an organization for the resource pool. |

   - **Bind public cloud organization**

     | Configuration item | Description |
     | --- | --- |
     | Organization | Shows the name of the current organization. You cannot modify it. |
     | Resource pool | Select the resource pool that you want to bind.<br>If the bound resource pool is of the resource directory management account type, select a child resource pool, which is a resource account. If no resource account is available, click <strong>Create Resource Pool</strong> and add a resource account in the dialog box. |
     | Alibaba Cloud Account ID | If the bound resource pool is of the public cloud type, shows the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You cannot modify it. |

     **Bind standalone primary account**

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4fd0de1fef6562a53fad80ecd3af8b87.jpeg)

     **Bind resource account under resource directory management account**

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/afb89bc14005df58cd9176ae2c5a9f03.jpeg)

8. Click **Confirm**. The multi-cloud organization binding is complete.

9. In the **Bind Multi-Cloud Organization** dialog box, click **Cancel** or **Bind Resource Set**.

   - Click **Cancel**: Return to the multi-cloud organization management list. You can view the bound resource pools in the list.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a63bdc4e855d5fe2281ee63954a4b352.jpeg)

     > **Note**
     >
     > - When the bound multi-cloud organization is of the Apsara Stack type, the **Apsara Stack organization name/Aliyun account name** column displays the organization name of the Apsara Stack.
     >
     > - When the bound multi-cloud organization is of the public cloud type, the **Apsara Stack organization name/Aliyun account name** column displays the primary account of the public cloud.

   - Click **Bind Resource Set**: Go to the **Resource Sets** page. Bind multi-cloud resource sets for resource sets under this organization.

**Unbind a multi-cloud organization**

**Prerequisites**

- The level-1 organization has been bound to a multi-cloud organization or primary account.

- You are an operations administrator. You have either bound the operations administrator role of a secondary Apsara Stack, or bound a RAM role with the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Tenant Management** page, click the name of the level-1 organization in the left-side organizational hierarchy.

2. On the **Multi-Cloud Organizations** tab, click **Unbind** in the **Actions** column of the resource pool.

3. In the dialog box, click **Unbind**. The multi-cloud organization is unbound successfully.

   After unbinding, the system also unbinds all resource set bindings within the scope of the current organization and deletes all users or RAM roles created under this organization that were mapped to the corresponding resource pool and central cloud.

**Create and bind a multi-cloud resource set**

**Prerequisites**

- The level-1 organization has been bound to a multi-cloud organization or primary account.

- To create and bind an Apsara Stack resource set, you must be an operations administrator who has bound the operations administrator role of a secondary Apsara Stack or a level-1 organization administrator who has bound the organization administrator role of a secondary Apsara Stack.

- To create and bind a public cloud resource set, you must be an operations administrator who has bound a RAM role with the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level or a level-1 organization administrator who has bound a RAM role with the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Organization Management** page, click the name of a level-1 organization in the left-side organizational structure.

2. On the **Multi-Cloud Organizations** tab, click **Create Resource Set** in the **Actions** column of the resource pool.

3. In the **Create and Associate Multi-cloud Resource Set** dialog box, configure the resource set or resource group.

   - **Create and associate an Apsara Stack resource set**

     | Configuration Item | Description |
     | --- | --- |
     | Organization to Associate | Select the central cloud organization to which you want to bind this new resource set. |
     | Resource Set to Associate | Select the central cloud resource set to which you want to bind this new resource set. |
     | Destination Resource Pool | The system displays the selected Apsara Stack of the subordinate cloud.You cannot modify it. |
     | Destination Resource Set Name | Enter a name for this new resource set. |
     | Destination Organization | Select the organization in the destination resource pool to which this new resource set belongs. |
     | Security Level Based Access | Select a security level for this new resource set.<br>Note<br>This option appears only when security level-based access is enabled for the destination resource pool. |

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9b0fd73c062709cb39db30cf5366bce6.jpeg)

   - **Create and associate a public cloud resource group**

     | Configuration Item | Description |
     | --- | --- |
     | Organization to Associate | Select the central cloud organization to which you want to bind this new resource set. |
     | Resource Set to Associate | Select the central cloud resource set to which you want to bind this new resource set. |
     | Destination Resource Pool | The system displays the selected public cloud. You cannot modify it. |
     | Destination Resource Group ID | Enter an identifier for this new resource group.<br>Note<br>• The identifier must be 3 to 50 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.<br>• You cannot modify the resource group identifier after the resource group is created. |
     | Destination Resource Group Name | Enter a name for this new resource group.<br>Note<br>The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length, and can contain letters, Chinese characters, or digits. |

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6ff79adc274be301c15d050f83996b98.jpeg)

4. Click **Confirm.**

**Related operations**

Operations and documentation related to multi-cloud access:

1. Multi-Cloud Management.

2. Manage multi-cloud resource sets.

3. Modify multi-cloud roles.

4. Manage the resource sets to which users belong.

5. In the **Basic Information** section, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a4236870dbe0215be8b8ce75c3c94e76.png" width="13" alt=""> icon and select **Delete**.

<a id="section-5-1-3"></a>

### 5.1.3. Manage resource sets

<a id="section-5-1-3-1"></a>

#### 5.1.3.1. Create a resource set

A resource set is a group of resources and is similar to a project. After a user or user group is added to a resource set, the user or users in the user group can manage resources in the resource set. The resource set management feature enables you to resolve complex issues such as user authorization. If an organization has multiple projects, you can create multiple resource sets in the organization. This allows users to use and manage resources by resource set.

**Background information**

A resource set is a logical container of multiple resources. Each resource must belong to a resource set. When you create a resource, you must select a resource set for the resource. This way, resources are grouped by resource set.

- When you create an organization, the system creates a resource set for the organization by default.

- Resource sets are isolated from each other.

- An organization can have multiple resource sets, but each resource set can belong to only one organization.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.

4. On the Resource Sets page, click **Create Resource Set**.

5. In the **Create Resource Set** dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Name | The name of the resource set. The name must be 2 to 50 characters in length. |
   | Organization | The organization to which the resource set belongs. |
   | Secret Level Access | The security level of the resource set. The security level of the resource set must be lower than the security level of the role that performs the current operation.<br>Important<br>The Secret Level Access and Security Level parameters are displayed only after the security level-based authorization feature is enabled by a platform administrator. To enable this feature, choose <strong>Configurations</strong> &gt; <strong>Security Policies</strong> &gt; <strong>Security Level Based Access</strong>. |
   | Tag | The tags of the resource set.<br>• <strong>Add a tag</strong>:<br>a. Click Add.<br>b. Enter a tag key and a tag value.<br>Note<br>• The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. It cannot start with acs: or aliyun.<br>• The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. It cannot start with acs:.<br>• <strong>Delete a tag</strong>: Click the<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/570672f2aaffad31620952f3104ef309.png" width="12" alt="">icon next to the tag. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4733dc2f6f78ce7e4b610135c47d599a.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-1-3-2"></a>

#### 5.1.3.2. View resource sets and details

This topic describes how to view resource sets and the details of a resource set.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.

4. On the Resource Sets page, view the created resource sets in the resource set list. You can quickly find a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set name above the resource set list.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can move the pointer over User or User Group in the User column of a resource set to view the users or user groups that have permissions on the resource set.

5. Find the resource set that you want to view and click its name to go to the Resource Set Details page.

<a id="section-5-1-3-3"></a>

#### 5.1.3.3. Modify a resource set

This topic describes how to modify a resource set.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.

4. On the Resource Sets page, search for a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set name above the resource set list.

5. Find the resource set that you want to modify and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

6. In the **Modify Resource Set** dialog box, enter a new name for the resource set and select a security level.

   > **Important**
   >
   > The Secret Level Access and Security Level parameters are displayed only after the security level-based authorization feature is enabled by a platform administrator. To enable this feature, choose **Configurations** > **Security Policies** > **Security Level Based Access**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6cb5293ccb3877fdf7e8e23b39140663.jpeg)

7. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-1-3-4"></a>

#### 5.1.3.4. Manage tags of a resource set

Adding tags to a resource set helps you better organize, classify, and manage cloud resources in the resource set.

**Limits**

You can add up to 20 tags to each resource.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.

4. On the Resource Sets page, search for a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set name above the resource set list.

5. Find the resource set that you want to manage and click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b99bd9828d1a335ff32fb2f65967ada3.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Tag** column.

6. In the **Modify Tag** dialog box, modify tags of the resource set.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1f562c320f56e97e365615a116cae2bf.jpeg)

   - **Add a tag**:

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     Click **Add**.

     </li>

     <li>

     Enter a tag key and a tag value.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http://or https://. It cannot start with acs: or aliyun.
     >
     > - The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. It cannot start with acs:.

     </li>

     </ol>

   - **Delete a tag**: Click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/570672f2aaffad31620952f3104ef309.png" width="12" alt=""> icon next to the tag.

7. Click **OK**.

8. After the tags are modified, click **Close**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ef3b65857e1bb70763369bcaac9dea2d.jpeg)

<a id="section-5-1-3-5"></a>

#### 5.1.3.5. Manage resource set members

Authorize users or user groups to access a group of resources by granting them membership in a resource set. When users or user groups no longer need access to the resource set, administrators can quickly remove their authorization from the member list.

**Manage central cloud members of a resource set**

**Authorize a resource set to central cloud members**

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resource Management** > **Resource Set Management**.

4. On the **Resource Set Management** page, use the organization drop-down list above the list, apply tag filters, or enter the resource set name in the search box to quickly locate a resource set.

5. On the **Members** tab, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The Central Cloud and Access From Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

6. Click **Member authorization** in the **Actions** column of the resource set.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Alternatively, click the resource set name. On the **Resource Set Details** page, go to the **Members** tab and click **Member authorization**.

7. In the **Member authorization** dialog box, select a role type and then select users or user groups.

   | Configuration item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Select Role Type | In the Resource Pool column, select a central cloud resource pool from the drop-down list. In the Role Type column, select a role type. In the Role column, select a specific role.<br>Note<br>• The Resource Pool column appears only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and the Resource Pool column is not displayed.<br>• You can select only preset roles or custom roles for the role type. |
   | Select User or User Group | Based on the selected role type, select the users or user groups to authorize under Select User or User Group. Enter the user or user group name in the search box above the list to quickly find them.<br>After selecting users or user groups, you can remove or clear the selected items on the right side under Selected Items.<br>Note<br>When authorizing users and user groups, limits apply to the number of selections per operation. Contact Alibaba Cloud technical support for specific limit configurations. |
   | Authorization Validity Period | Control the validity period of the role within the resource set. After expiration, the role permissions become invalid. You can select <strong>Never Expire</strong>, <strong>By</strong> <strong>Duration</strong>, or <strong>Specific Date</strong>. |
   | Validity Period | Configure this item when you select <strong>By Duration</strong> for <strong>Authorization Validity</strong> <strong>Period</strong>.<br>Enter the specific validity duration in the input box. The upper limit is 365 days.The validity period starts from the time of configuration. |
   | Expiration Date | Configure this item when you select <strong>Specific Date</strong> for <strong>Authorization Validity</strong> <strong>Period</strong>.<br>In the <strong>Expiration Date</strong> time picker, select the exact expiration time, accurate to the second. The expiration time must be later than the current time. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/17294b06a7fff6d2496113d527adbfa7.jpeg)

8. Click **Confirm**. After successful member authorization, the authorized users or user groups appear on the Members tab of the resource set details page.

**View members authorized by the central cloud for a resource set**

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the resource set name.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Members** tab.

3. On the **Members** list, switch to the Central Cloud tab to view members authorized for the resource set. Enter a user or user group name in the search box above the list to perform fuzzy search.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The Central Cloud and Access From Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8d859cfffa8c43b4fa69bb81d1714d60.jpeg)

   The member list includes the following information: **Type**, **Authorized Subject**, **Use Role**, **Permission Validity Period**, **Authorization Status**, and **Expired At**.

   - **Type** includes user and user group.

   - **Authorized Subject** indicates the username or user group name of the member.

   - **Use Role** indicates the central cloud role assigned to the authorized member.

   - **Permission Validity Period** indicates the validity period during which the resource set is authorized to the member. A hyphen (-) indicates permanent validity.

   - **Authorization Status** indicates the authorization status of the resource set. The system displays **Enabled** during the validity period and **Disabled** after expiration.

   - **Expired At** indicates the expiration time of the authorization granted to the member for the resource set. A hyphen (-) indicates permanent validity.

**Remove central cloud members from resource set authorization**

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the resource set name.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Members** tab.

3. On the **Members** list, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The Central Cloud and Access From Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

4. Remove authorization.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8d859cfffa8c43b4fa69bb81d1714d60.jpeg)

   - To remove a single member: Click **Remove Authorization** in the **Actions** column for the member.

   - To remove multiple members: Select multiple users and user groups in the member list, then click **Remove Authorization** below the list.

     > **Note**
     >
     > When selecting users and user groups to remove authorization, each selection is subject to quantity limits. Contact Alibaba Cloud technical support for specific configuration of these limits.

5. Click **Confirm**. After you remove authorization, the user or users in the user group can no longer access this resource set or use resources under this resource set.

**Change permission validity period for central cloud members in a resource set**

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the resource set name.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Members** tab.

3. On the **Members** list, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The Central Cloud and Access From Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

4. Click **Permission Renewal** in the **Actions** column for the member.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8d859cfffa8c43b4fa69bb81d1714d60.jpeg)

5. In the Permission Renewal dialog box, configure the authorization validity period.

   | Configuration item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Authorization Validity Period | You can control the validity period of a role within the resource set. After the validity period ends, the role permissions become invalid. You can select <strong>Never</strong> <strong>Expire</strong>, <strong>By Duration</strong>, or <strong>Specific Date</strong>. |
   | Validity Period | Configure this item when you select <strong>By Duration</strong> for <strong>Authorization Validity</strong> <strong>Period</strong>.<br>Enter the specific validity duration in the input box. The upper limit is 365 days.The validity period starts from the time you configure it. |
   | Expiration Date | Configure this item when you select <strong>Specific Date</strong> for <strong>Authorization Validity</strong> <strong>Period</strong>.<br>Select the specific expiration time in the <strong>Expiration Date</strong> time picker. The time is accurate to the second. The expiration time must be later than the current time. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8371e83377bb4d05bf1272de0dbf0a43.jpeg)

6. Click **Confirm**.

**Manage resource set members from Apsara Stack Authorize resource sets to members from Apsara Stack**

**Prerequisites**

- The resource set has been bound to a resource set from Apsara Stack.

- The operating user is an operations administrator (bound to the operations administrator role for Apsara Stack) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the organization administrator role for Apsara Stack).

**Constraints**

When you authorize a resource set to members from Apsara Stack, you can only authorize users. You cannot authorize user groups.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click **Member Authorization** in the **Actions** column of the resource set.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can also click the name of the resource set and then click **Member Authorization** on the **Members** tab of the **Resource Set Details** page.

2. In the **Member Authorization** dialog box, select a role type and select users or user groups.

   | Configuration item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Select Role Type | In the Resource Pool column, select a resource pool from Apsara Stack from the drop-down list. In the Role Type column, select a role type from the drop-down list. In the Role column, select a specific role from the drop-down list.<br>Note<br>• The Resource Pool column appears only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and the Resource Pool column does not appear.<br>• You can select only preset roles or custom roles as the role type. The Role column displays only roles within the management scope of the resource set. |
   | Select a User or User Group | Based on the selected role type, select the users or user groups to be authorized under Select a User or User Group. You can enter the name of a user or user group in the text box above the list to quickly find the user or user group.<br>After you select users or user groups, you can remove or clear the selected users or user groups under Selected Items on the right. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a487a150daff6ddb776d576eac3d056d.jpeg)

3. Click **OK**.

**View members from Apsara Stack authorized for the resource set**

**Prerequisites**

- The resource set has been bound to a resource set from Apsara Stack.

- The operating user is an operations administrator (bound to the operations administrator role for Apsara Stack) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the organization administrator role for Apsara Stack).

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the name of the resource set.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Members** tab.

3. On the **Members** tab, switch to the Apsara Stack tab and view the authorized members for the resource set. Enter user information in the text box above the list to perform a fuzzy search.

   > **Note**
   >
   > In multi-cloud scenarios, the central cloud and connected Apsara Stack tabs appear. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs appear.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cbd6923ca1e25cc0ae6632a97d3359b9.jpeg)

**Remove members from Apsara Stack authorized for the resource set**

**Prerequisites**

- The resource set has been bound to a resource set from Apsara Stack.

- The operating user is an operations administrator (bound to the operations administrator role for Apsara Stack) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the organization administrator role for Apsara Stack).

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the name of the resource set.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Members** tab.

3. On the **Members** tab, switch to the Apsara Stack tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > In multi-cloud scenarios, the central cloud and connected Apsara Stack tabs appear. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs appear.

4. Click **Remove Authorization** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cbd6923ca1e25cc0ae6632a97d3359b9.jpeg)

5. Click **Confirm**. After you remove the authorization, the user cannot access this resource set or use resources under this resource set.

**Manage members of the resource set from the public cloud**

**Authorize resource set members from the public cloud**

**Prerequisites**

- The resource set is already bound to a resource group from the public cloud.

- The operating user must be an operations administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy effective within the scope of the public cloud primary account).

**Constraints**

When authorizing members from the public cloud for a resource set, you can authorize only users, not user groups.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click **Member Authorization** in the **Actions** column of the target resource set.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Alternatively, click the resource set name. On the **Resource Set Details** page, go to the **Members** tab and click **Member Authorization**.

2. In the **Member Authorization** dialog box, select the role type and choose users or user groups.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Configuration item</td>
       <td>Description</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Select Role Type</td>
       <td>From the drop-down list in the Resource Pool column, select the public cloud.<br>Note<br>• The Resource Pool column appears only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and this column does not appear.<br>• The public cloud has no concept of role types. After you select the public cloud in the Resource Pool column, the Role Type and Role columns are hidden by default.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Select a User or User Group</td>
       <td>Under Select User or User Group, select the users to be authorized. You can enter a user name in the text box above the list to quickly find users.<br>After selecting users, you can remove or clear selected users in the Selected Items section on the right.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/39cf6c4643cc52679025604f9a000f76.jpeg)

3. Click **Confirm**.

**View members from the public cloud authorized for a resource set**

**Prerequisites**

- The resource set is already bound to a resource group from the public cloud.

- The operating user must be an operations administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy effective within the scope of the public cloud primary account).

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the resource set name.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, go to the **Members** tab.

3. On the **Members** tab, switch to the public cloud tab and view the authorized members for the resource set. Enter user information in the text box above the list to perform a fuzzy search.

   > **Note**
   >
   > In multi-cloud scenarios, tabs for the central cloud and connected public clouds appear. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs are displayed.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cbd6923ca1e25cc0ae6632a97d3359b9.jpeg)

**Remove public cloud members from a resource set authorization**

**Prerequisites**

- The resource set is already bound to a resource group from the public cloud.

- The operating user must be an operations administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy at the public cloud account level) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy effective within the scope of the public cloud primary account).

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set Management** page, click the resource set name.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, go to the **Members** tab.

3. On the **Members** tab, switch to the public cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > In multi-cloud scenarios, tabs for the central cloud and connected public clouds appear. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs are displayed.

4. Click **Remove Authorization** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cbd6923ca1e25cc0ae6632a97d3359b9.jpeg)

5. Click **OK**. After you remove the authorization, users in this resource set can no longer access the resource set or use its resources.

<a id="section-5-1-3-6"></a>

#### 5.1.3.6. Manage multi-cloud resource sets

After you bind a multi-cloud organization to a level-1 organization, you can bind a multi-cloud resource set to the resource sets of the level-1 organization and its subordinate organizations. After a multi-cloud resource set is bound, you can manage and schedule resources across multiple clouds. This improves resource utilization and management efficiency.

**Bind a multi-cloud resource set**

**Limits**

The default resource set of a level-1 organization cannot be bound to resource groups of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform. You must turn on the O&M switch to enable this capability.

**Prerequisites**

- A multi-cloud organization is bound to the level-1 organization to which the resource set belongs. For more information, see Manage multi-cloud organizations.

- If you want to bind a resource set of a managed Apsara Stack platform, you are an operations administrator to which the operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to which the organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned.

- If you want to bind a resource group of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform, you are an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator and are assigned a Resource Access Management (RAM) role to which the AdministratorAccess policy of the Alibaba Cloud account is attached.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.

4. On the Resource Sets page, search for a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set name above the resource set list.

5. On the **Resource Sets** page, find the resource set that you want to manage and click its name.

6. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Multi-Cloud Resource Set** tab.

7. On the Multi-Cloud Resource Set tab, click **Associate Multi-Cloud Resource Set**.

8. Bind a multi-cloud resource set.

   | Operation | Procedure |
   | --- | --- |
   | Bind a resource set of a managed Apsara Stack platform | • Bind an existing resource set<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bb38c7f0ef097d5521b8505b4bb18ffc.jpeg)<br>• <strong>Association Method</strong>: Set this parameter to <strong>Select Existing Resource</strong> <strong>Set</strong>.<br>• <strong>Cloud Platform</strong>: Select a managed Apsara Stack platform from this drop-down list.<br>• <strong>Multi-Cloud Organization</strong>: This drop-down list displays the name of the organization of the managed Apsara Stack platform bound to the organization to which the current resource set belongs by default.<br>• <strong>Multi-Cloud Resource Set</strong>: Select the resource set of the managed Apsara Stack platform to be bound from this drop-down list.<br>• Create and associate a resource set<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9667a30cd095fa12917cf114617cf4f9.jpeg)<br>• <strong>Association Method</strong>: Set this parameter to <strong>Create and Associate</strong> <strong>Resource Set</strong>.<br>• <strong>Cloud Platform</strong>: Select the managed Apsara Stack platform to which the resource set to be created belongs from this drop-down list.<br>• <strong>Destination Resource Set Name</strong>: Enter the name of the resource set to be created.<br>• <strong>Destination Organization</strong>: Select the organization of the managed Apsara Stack platform to which the resource set to be created belongs.<br>• <strong>Secret Level Access</strong>: Select the security level of the resource set to be created.<br>Note<br>This parameter is displayed only if the security level-based access feature is enabled for the managed Apsara Stack platform. |
   |  |  |
   | Bind a resource group of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform | • Bind an existing resource group<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/85c8d63e3d82bc066c884da0c2e569ee.jpeg)<br>• <strong>Association Method</strong>: Set this parameter to <strong>Select Existing Resource</strong> <strong>Set</strong>.<br>• <strong>Cloud Platform</strong>: Select a managed Alibaba Cloud platform from this drop-down list.<br>• <strong>Resource Group</strong>: Select the resource group to be bound from this drop-down list.<br>• Create and associate a resource group<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bfd6fd973bd738ec3ac5740fc853d495.jpeg)<br>• <strong>Association Method</strong>: Set this parameter to <strong>Create and Associate</strong> <strong>Resource Set</strong>.<br>• <strong>Cloud Platform</strong>: Select the managed Alibaba Cloud platform to which the resource group to be created belongs from this drop-down list.<br>• <strong>Destination Resource Group Name</strong>: Enter the name of the resource group to be created.<br>Note<br>The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters and digits. |

   - **Destination Resource Group ID**: Enter the identifier of the resource group

9. Click **OK**.

   to be created.

0. After the multi-cloud resource set is bound, it is displayed on the Multi-Cloud Resource Set

   > **Note**

   tab. You can search for a multi-cloud resource set by cloud platform name in the search box above the multi-cloud resource set list.

   > - The identifier must be 3 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f7bd0874873bdb430a8b6f8f5472dbf8.png)

**Unbind a multi-cloud resource set**

**Prerequisites**

- A resource set is bound to a multi-cloud resource set.

- If you want to unbind a resource set of a managed Apsara Stack platform, you are an operations administrator to which the operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to which the organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned.

- If you want to unbind a resource group of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform, you are an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator and are assigned a RAM role to which the AdministratorAccess policy of the Alibaba Cloud account is attached.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Sets** page, find the resource set that you want to manage and click its name.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Multi-Cloud Resource Set** tab.

3. Search for a multi-cloud resource set by cloud platform name in the search box above the multi-cloud resource set list.

4. Find the multi-cloud resource set that you want to manage and click **Unbind** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c4a7f8d628c5e5a18feb155c110bb714.jpeg)

5. Click **OK**.

**Related operations**

For information about more multi-cloud operations, see the following topics:

1. Manage cloud platforms

2. Manage multi-cloud organizations

3. Modify multi-cloud roles

4. Manage the resource sets to which a user belongs

<a id="section-5-1-3-7"></a>

#### 5.1.3.7. Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set

You can specify a proxy administrator for a resource set on the Resource Sets page to assist you in managing the resource set. After you specify a proxy administrator for a resource set, a proxy user that maps to the proxy administrator is created. The proxy user can manage the resource set as the assigned role. For more information about how to specify a proxy administrator for an organization, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization.

**Specify a proxy administrator**

**Limits**

- Only users of other level-1 organizations can be specified as proxy administrators.

- You can select only one role whose permission scope is Resource Sets as the proxy role.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.

4. On the Resource Sets page, search for a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set name above the resource set list.

5. Find the resource set that you want to manage, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f9bb16b7fc56e43bcefffd314410a74e.png" width="15" alt=""> icon in the

   **Actions** column, and then select **Set Proxy Administrator**. In the Set Proxy Administrator dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Current Resource Set | The name of the current resource set. This parameter cannot be modified. |
   | Configuratio n Method | The configuration method. Set the value to <strong>Assign</strong>. |
   | Select User | The user who is specified as the proxy administrator. You can select only one user from another level-1 organization. You can search for a user by organization and username above the user list. |
   | Proxy Role | The role assigned to the proxy user. You can select only one role. |
   | Proxy Scope | The permission scope of the proxy administrator, which is the same as the permission scope of the selected proxy role. This parameter cannot be modified. |
   | Proxy Period | The start time and end time of the proxy. The proxy administrator cannot perform proxy operations outside the specified time period. |
   | Description | The description of the proxy administrator. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/76f5ff201e9658d50c1ed3d6910ce184.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

**View the details of a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. View the proxy administrator information in the list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Proxy Administrator: a proxy user of the resource set. A proxy user is automatically created after a proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. The user who is specified as the proxy administrator performs proxy operations as the proxy user.
   >
   > - Proxy Status: the proxy status. A proxy administrator can be in the Activating, Disabled, or Expired state. If a proxy administrator is in the Disabled or Expired state, the corresponding proxy user cannot log in.
   >
   >   - Activating: The proxy is within the validity period, and the proxy administrator is not disabled.
   >
   >   - Disabled: The proxy administrator is disabled.
   >
   >   - Expired: The proxy period expires, and the proxy administrator cannot perform proxy operations.
   >
   > - Owner: the user who is specified as the proxy administrator. After the user logs in, the user can switch to the proxy user in the user center. For more information, see Enable the proxy mode as a proxy administrator for a proxy user.

5. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click its name.

6. On the **User Details** page, view the details of the proxy administrator.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1ecfb838569e87ff786c02a078f76067.jpeg)

**Modify a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Change** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

5. In the **Edit Proxy Administrator** dialog box, select a proxy role, specify a proxy period, and then enter a description.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b833e4c2a5d8c417e7656e3f1ad8a853.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

**Disable a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

- A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

- The proxy administrator is in the Activating or Expired state.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Disable** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Enable a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

- A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

- The proxy administrator is in the Disabled state.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Enabled** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Delete a proxy administrator**

**Prerequisites**

A proxy administrator is specified for a resource set. For more information, see the Specify a proxy administrator section of this topic.

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Sets** page, click the name of the resource set that you want to manage.

2. On the **Resource Set Details** page, click the **Proxy Administrator** tab.

3. Filter proxy administrators by proxy status above the proxy administrator list.

4. Find the proxy administrator that you want to manage and click **Delete** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7b96a8f466fbabac371ceaf0ecdef386.jpeg)

5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-1-3-8"></a>

#### 5.1.3.8. Delete a resource set

You can delete a resource set that you no longer need.

**Limits**

The default resource set of an organization cannot be deleted.

**Prerequisites**

Before you delete a resource set, make sure that the resource set does not have resources, users, or user groups. Otherwise, the resource set cannot be deleted.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.

4. On the Resource Sets page, search for a resource set by organization, tag, or resource set name above the resource set list.

5. Find the resource set that you want to manage, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f9bb16b7fc56e43bcefffd314410a74e.png" width="15" alt=""> icon in the

   **Actions** column, and then select **Delete**.

6. In the **Confirm** message, click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-1-4"></a>

### 5.1.4. Manage regions

You can manage the regions associated with organizations. Regions determine the geographical locations in which resources are created. Large-sized enterprises typically divide their business into different units. Each business unit may correspond to specific product lines or regions. In this case, they need to create different resources in specified regions. Enterprises can associate their organizations with regions to meet their requirements.

**Limits**

- An organization must be associated with at least one region. Users in a general region associated with an organization cannot view the central region associated with the organization.

- After a level-1 organization is associated with a region, its subordinate organizations can also be associated with the region.

- If resources are activated in a region supported by an organization, you cannot disassociate the organization from the region.

- After an organization is associated with regions, the resources of the organization can be created only in the associated regions.

- An organization can be associated with multiple regions, and a region can be associated with multiple organizations.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Regions**.

4. In the left-side organization list, click the name of the organization that you want to manage.

5. In the right-side Regions section, select or clear the name of the region that you want to manage.

   If you select the name of a region, the organization is associated with the region. Then, you can create resources in this region. If you clear the name of a region, the organization is disassociated from the region. Then, you cannot create resources in this region.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7e12a5f2d6794f5bb29f54f6f693f895.jpeg)

6. Click **Update Association**.

7. If a multi-cloud organization is bound to a level-1 organization, you can also view the region of the secondary cloud on the corresponding tab as an operations administrator.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Tabs of secondary clouds are displayed only in multi-cloud scenarios. You can only view region information, but cannot modify it.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0185aaf99cdd9f47b299c0c31a612023.jpeg)

<a id="section-5-1-5"></a>

### 5.1.5. Change management

<a id="section-5-1-5-1"></a>

#### 5.1.5.1. Change the ownership of an organization

After you change the ownership of an organization, the resource sets and users of the organization are also moved to the destination organization.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

- You cannot change the ownership of a level-1 organization.

- You cannot move organizations across level-1 organizations.

- When you change the ownership of an organization, you are not allowed to create instances in the organization and its subordinate organizations or resource sets.

- When you change the ownership of an organization, you are not allowed to change the ownership of existing instances in the organization and its subordinate organizations and resource sets.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Changes**.

4. Search for an organization by name in the search box above the left-side organization tree.

5. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

6. On the right side of the Changes page, click **Change Organization Ownership**.

7. In the **Change Organization Ownership** dialog box, select the destination organization from the **New Organization** drop-down list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/24d2e117af4e5c88adff33e898908dd8.jpeg)

8. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-1-5-2"></a>

#### 5.1.5.2. Change the ownership of a user

Changing the ownership of a user does not affect the original organization or resources.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

- You cannot change the ownership of a user across level-1 organizations.

- You cannot change the organization to which you belong. Only your superior administrator can change the organization to which you belong.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Changes**.

4. Search for an organization by name in the search box above the left-side organization tree.

5. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

6. On the right side of the Changes page, click **Users**.

7. On the Users page, find the user whose ownership you want to change and click **Change** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/21c181710432d8f4e1d0e839abc3350d.jpeg)

8. In the **Change Ownership** dialog box, select the destination organization from the **New Organization** drop-down list and select one or more roles from the **Assigned Roles** drop-down list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5b95b75aa170ef6eaa7701f6bd2b4e20.jpeg)

9. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-1-5-3"></a>

#### 5.1.5.3. Change the ownership of a resource set

If you change the ownership of a resource set, all the resources in this resource set are also moved to the destination organization.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

- You cannot change the ownership of the default resource set of an organization.

- You cannot change the ownership of a resource set across level-1 organizations.

- When you change the ownership of a resource set, you are not allowed to create instances in the resource set.

- When you change the ownership of a resource set, you cannot change the ownership of existing instances in the resource set.

- If the ownership of a parent organization to which a resource set belongs is being changed, the ownership of the resource set cannot be changed.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Changes**.

4. Search for an organization by name in the search box above the left-side organization tree.

5. Change the ownership of a resource set by using one of the following methods.

   - Method 1:

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage and click its name.

     </li>

     <li>

     On the right side of the Changes page, find the resource set that you want to manage and click **Change Ownership** in the Actions column.

     </li>

     </ol>

   - Method 2:

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage and

     click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6e10755d5e8c2825397888ea366aae1a.png" width="18" alt=""> icon to the left of the organization. Then, find the resource set that you

     want to manage in the organization and click the resource set name.

     </li>

     <li>

     On the right side of the Changes page, click **Change Resource Set Ownership**.

     </li>

     </ol>

6. In the **Change Ownership** dialog box, select the destination organization from the **Change Resource Set To** drop-down list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0f12a480252191e8e9e14c676b0e8fb8.jpeg)

7. Click **OK**.

**What to do next**

**View the details of the resource set**

1. On the **Changes** page, find the organization that you want to view in the left-side organization tree and click its name.

2. On the right side of the Changes page, find the resource set that you want to view and click its name or click **Details** in the Actions column.

3. On the **Resource Set Details** page, view information about the resource set on the Resources, Users, and Multi-Cloud Resource Set tabs. For more information about resource sets, see Manage resource sets.

<a id="section-5-1-5-4"></a>

#### 5.1.5.4. View resource relationships

You can view resource relationships to identify dependencies between different resources.

**View resource relationships in the central cloud platform**

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Changes**.

4. Search for an organization by name in the search box above the left-side organization tree.

5. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage, click the

   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6e10755d5e8c2825397888ea366aae1a.png" width="18" alt=""> icon to the left of the organization, and then click the name of a resource set under the

   organization.

6. Optional. Click the tab of the central cloud platform.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The tabs of the central cloud platform and managed cloud platforms are displayed only in multi-cloud environments. In single-cloud environments, only the information about the central cloud platform is displayed.

7. On the right side of the page, configure the **Product Type** and **Resource Type** parameters.

8. Find the resource instance that you want to view and click **View Resource Relations** in the Actions column.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can search for a resource instance by ID or name in the search boxes above the resource instance list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/acfa4e4d7dbe44afe2229db74a97018e.jpeg)

9. In the **View Resource Relations** message, view the resource relationships.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If a resource has a parent resource, the resource cannot be moved. If you still want to move the resource, we recommend that you move its parent resource. This way, the resource is automatically moved with its parent resource.
   >
   > - A shared resource can be moved within the sharing scope of its parent resource.

   - **Resource without a parent resource**

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1a18a5a41b4664d705a7989637c4bbc9.jpeg)

   - **Resource with a parent resource**

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e8c05714030e9dddec1dfc74ef68de9e.jpeg)

**View resource relationships in a managed Apsara Stack platform**

**Prerequisites**

- You are an operations administrator to whom an operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to whom an organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned.

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage, click the

   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6e10755d5e8c2825397888ea366aae1a.png" width="18" alt=""> icon to the left of the organization, and then click the name of a resource set under the

   organization.

2. Click the tab of the managed Apsara Stack platform.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The tabs of the central cloud platform and managed cloud platforms are displayed only in multi-cloud environments. In single-cloud environments, only the information about the central cloud platform is displayed.

3. On the right side of the page, configure the **Product Type** and **Resource Type** parameters.

4. Find the resource instance that you want to view and click **View Resource Relations** in the Actions column.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can search for a resource instance by ID or name in the search boxes above the resource instance list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/acfa4e4d7dbe44afe2229db74a97018e.jpeg)

5. In the **View Resource Relations** message, view the resource relationships.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If a resource has a parent resource, the resource cannot be moved. If you still want to move the resource, we recommend that you move its parent resource. This way, the resource is automatically moved with its parent resource.
   >
   > - A shared resource can be moved within the sharing scope of its parent resource.

   - **Resource without a parent resource**

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1a18a5a41b4664d705a7989637c4bbc9.jpeg)

   - **Resource with a parent resource**

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e8c05714030e9dddec1dfc74ef68de9e.jpeg)

**View resource relationships in a managed Alibaba Cloud platform**

- You have logged in to the console as an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator. A Resource Access Management (RAM) role of the AdministratorAccess policy at the account level of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform is assigned to the operations administrator or the level-1 organization administrator.

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage, click the

   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6e10755d5e8c2825397888ea366aae1a.png" width="18" alt=""> icon to the left of the organization, and then click the name of a resource set under the

   organization.

2. Click the tab of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The tabs of the central cloud platform and managed cloud platforms are displayed only in multi-cloud environments. In single-cloud environments, only the information about the central cloud platform is displayed.

3. On the right side of the page, configure the **Product Type** and **Resource Type** parameters.

4. Find the resource instance that you want to view and click **View Resource Relations** in the Actions column.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can search for a resource instance by ID or name in the search boxes above the resource instance list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3cb6dbf6ac50c3a0c980dc5322d30936.jpeg)

<a id="section-5-1-5-5"></a>

#### 5.1.5.5. Change the ownership of resources

Changing the ownership of resources does not affect the original organization or users.

**Change the ownership of resources in the central cloud platform**

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Changes**.

4. Search for an organization by name in the search box above the left-side organization tree.

5. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage, click the

   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6e10755d5e8c2825397888ea366aae1a.png" width="18" alt=""> icon to the left of the organization, and then click the name of a resource set under the

   organization.

6. Optional. Click the tab of the central cloud platform.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The tabs of the central cloud platform and cloud platforms managed by the central cloud platform are displayed only in multi-cloud environments. In single-cloud environments, only the information about the central cloud platform is displayed.

7. On the right side of the page, configure the **Product Type** and **Resource Type** parameters.

8. In the resource instance list, perform the following operations based on your business requirements:

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can search for a resource instance by ID or name in the search boxes above the resource instance list.

   - **Change the ownership of a single resource instance**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the resource instance list, find the resource instance that you want to manage and click **Change Ownership** in the Actions column.

     </li>

     <li>

     In the **Change Resource Ownership** dialog box, select the destination resource set from the Change Resource Set To drop-down list.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/708c0e938608138791b763f9876cafe7.jpeg)

     </li>

     </ol>

   - **Change the ownership of multiple resource instances at a time**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the resource instance list, select the resource instances that you want to manage and click **Batch Change Ownership** below the list.

     </li>

     <li>

     In the **Change Resource Ownership** dialog box, select the destination resource set from the Change Resource Set To drop-down list.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0409e96832ea3910969c00eab3d57bbd.jpeg)

     </li>

     </ol>

9. Click **OK**.

**Change the ownership of resources in a managed Apsara Stack platform**

**Prerequisites**

- A resource set is associated with a resource set of the managed Apsara Stack platform.

- You have permissions to change resources in the organizations and resource sets of the managed Apsara Stack platform.

**Procedure**

1. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage, click the

   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6e10755d5e8c2825397888ea366aae1a.png" width="18" alt=""> icon to the left of the organization, and then click the name of a resource set under the

   organization.

2. Click the tab of the managed Apsara Stack platform.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The tabs of the central cloud platform and cloud platforms managed by the central cloud platform are displayed only in multi-cloud environments. In single-cloud environments, only the information about the central cloud platform is displayed.

3. On the right side of the page, configure the **Product Type** and **Resource Type** parameters.

4. In the resource instance list, perform the following operations based on your business requirements:

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can search for a resource instance by ID or name in the search boxes above the resource instance list.
   >
   > - When you change the ownership of a resource in a managed Apsara Stack platform and select the destination organization and resource set, the names of the organizations and resource sets in the central cloud platform that manages the Apsara Stack platform are displayed.

   - **Change the ownership of a single resource instance**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the resource instance list, find the resource instance that you want to manage and click **Change Ownership** in the Actions column.

     </li>

     <li>

     In the **Change Resource Set** dialog box, select the destination resource set from the Change Resource Set To drop-down list.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/708c0e938608138791b763f9876cafe7.jpeg)

     </li>

     </ol>

   - **Change the ownership of multiple resource instances at a time**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the resource instance list, select the resource instances that you want to manage and click **Batch Change Ownership** below the list.

     </li>

     <li>

     In the **Change Resource Set** dialog box, select the destination resource set from the Change Resource Set To drop-down list.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0409e96832ea3910969c00eab3d57bbd.jpeg)

     </li>

     </ol>

5. Click **OK**.

1. In the left-side organization tree, find the organization that you want to manage, click the

   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6e10755d5e8c2825397888ea366aae1a.png" width="18" alt=""> icon to the left of the organization, and then click the name of a resource set under the

   organization.

2. Click the tab of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform.

     </li>

     <li>

     In the **Change Resource Set** dialog box, select the destination resource set from the Change Resource Set To drop-down list.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/708c0e938608138791b763f9876cafe7.jpeg)

     </li>

     </li>

     <li>

     In the **Change Resource Set** dialog box, select the destination resource set from the Change Resource Set To drop-down list.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0409e96832ea3910969c00eab3d57bbd.jpeg)

     </li>

     </ol>

5. Click **OK**.
