<a id="section-5-2"></a>

## 5.2. User management

<a id="section-5-2-1"></a>

### 5.2.1. User management

<a id="section-5-2-1-1"></a>

#### 5.2.1.1. Create a user

Administrators can create users individually or in batches and assign different roles to meet the access control requirements of different users.

**Background information**

An operations administrator can create users for all organizations, while an organization administrator can create users only for the current organization and its subordinate organizations.

Each user can have only one login policy. The default policy does not restrict the login time or login IP address. To restrict the login time and IP address for different types of users, create a new login policy.

**Limits**

You can create a maximum of 100 users in batches at a time.

**Prerequisites**

Before you create a user, make sure that the organization and role are already created.

**Create a user**

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise.**

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Users** > **Users.**

4. On the **System Users** tab, click **Create User.**

5. In the **Create User** dialog box, configure the user information.

   | Name | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | User Name | The personal cloud platform account name of the user. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), hyphens (-), and at signs (@), and must be 2 to 64 characters in length. |
   | Display Name | The display name, which can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), hyphens (-), spaces, and at signs (@), and must be 1 to 128 characters in length. |
   | Role | Select a role for the user. |
   | Organization | Select the organization to which the user belongs. |
   | Remarks | Enter a description for the user. |
   | Login Policy | The login policy restricts the login time and login IP address of the user. By default, the system automatically binds the default policy to a newly created user. |
   | Access Method | The access method supports <strong>Console Access</strong> and <strong>Access with Permanent</strong> <strong>AccessKey Pair</strong>. You can select both options.<br>• <strong>Console Access</strong>: Allows the user to access the cloud console with a user name and password.<br>• <strong>Access with Permanent AccessKey Pair</strong>: After you create a user, the system automatically generates an AccessKey ID and an AccessKey Secret.This option allows access through APIs or other development tools. |
   | Phone | Configure this parameter when you select <strong>Console Access</strong> as the access method.<br>The mobile phone number of the user. The system uses this number to send SMS notifications about resource applications and usage. Enter a valid mobile phone number.<br>Note<br>When you enter a mobile phone number, select the correct country code. |
   | Landline | Configure this parameter when you select <strong>Console Access</strong> as the access method.<br>The landline number of the user. It can contain only digits (0 to 9) and hyphens (-), and must be 4 to 20 characters in length. |
   | Email | Configure this parameter when you select <strong>Console Access</strong> as the access method.<br>The email address of the user. The system uses this address to send email notifications about resource applications and usage. Enter a valid email address. |
   | DingTalk Key | Configure this parameter when you select <strong>Console Access</strong> as the access method.<br>The key of the DingTalk robot. For more information about the configuration method, see DingTalk development documentation. |
   | Message | • <strong>Notify User by Email </strong>: When eanbled, if an alert occurs in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and the user is an alert contact, the console notifies the user by email.<br>Note<br>• Email notification requires a configured email server. Contact the on-site O&amp;M engineer for assistance.<br>• After enabling this option, you can also select <strong>After creation, the</strong> user is notified of information such as the username and <strong>password by email</strong>.<br>• <strong>Notify User by DingTalk</strong>: When enabled, if an alert occurs in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and the user is an alert contact, the console notifies the user through DingTalk messages. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/323ada6a230e95f8e44dc374e42b806a.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**. The user is created.

7. In the **Bind Resource Set** dialog box, click **Cancel** or **Bind Resource Set**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > When you bind a resource set, the system navigates to the user details page and opens the **Add to Resource Set** dialog box. For more information about adding a user to a resource set, see Manage the resource sets to which users belong.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/81842b3c8da3775a750054450869a588.jpeg)

**Create users in batches**

**Procedure**

1. On the **System Users** tab, click **Batch Create Users**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > To create users in batches, you must first export the user template, fill in the user information as required, and then import the completed template.

2. In the **Batch Create Users** dialog box, click **User Creation Template**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bdafd3772e058f99ad055346b0c0b3e6.jpeg)

3. In the downloaded template file, fill in the user information as required.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9d03753f02b17a2b393de1819ed503be.png)

   | Name | Description 1 |
   | --- | --- |
   | Username | The personal cloud platform account name of the user. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), hyphens (-), and at signs (@), and must be 2 to 64 characters in length. |
   | Display Name | The display name, which can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), hyphens (-), spaces, and at signs (@), and must be 1 to 128 characters in length. |
   | Role | Enter the name of the target role for the user. You can view all roles by selecting <strong>Permissions</strong> &gt; <strong>Role Permissions</strong>. |
   | Organization | Enter the path of the target organization for the user.<br>Important<br>The path must start from the root organization, for example, "root/level-1 organization/level-2 organization". If the root organization name has been customized, use the custom name. |
   | Login Policy | Enter the name of the login policy for the user. You can view all login policies by selecting <strong>Permissions</strong> &gt; <strong>Access Control</strong>. |
   | Remarks | Enter a description for the user. |
   | Console Access | Enter <strong>Y</strong> or <strong>N</strong>. The default value is <strong>Y</strong>.<br>After you enable this option, the user can access the cloud console with a user name and password. |
   | Access with Permanent AccessKey Pair | Enter <strong>Y</strong> or <strong>N</strong>. The default value is <strong>Y</strong>.<br>After you enable this option, the system automatically generates an AccessKey ID and an AccessKey Secret after user is created. This option allows access through APIs or other development tools. |
   | Country Code | Enter the international dialing code. |
   | Mobile Phone | Enter the mobile phone number of the user. The system uses this number to send SMS notifications about resource applications and usage. Enter a valid mobile phone number. |
   | Landline | The landline number of the user. It can contain only digits (0 to 9) and hyphens (-), and must be 4 to 20 characters in length. |
   | Email | The email address of the user. The system uses this address to send email notifications about resource applications and usage. Enter a valid email address. |
   | Enable Email Notification | Enter <strong>Y</strong> or <strong>N</strong>. The default value is <strong>N</strong>.<br>When enabled, if an alert occurs in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and the user is an alert contact, the console notifies the user by email.<br>Note<br>Email notification requires a configured email server. Contact the on-site O&amp;M engineer for assistance. |
   | Enable DingTalk Notification | Enter <strong>Y</strong> or <strong>N</strong>. The default value is <strong>N</strong>.<br>When enabled, if an alert occurs in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and the user is an alert contact, the console notifies the user through DingTalk messages. |
   | DingTalk Key | The key of the DingTalk robot. For more information about the configuration method, see DingTalk development documentation.<br>Note<br>You must enable DingTalk notification. |
   | The password is sent to you by email | Enter <strong>Y</strong> or <strong>N</strong>. The default value is <strong>N</strong>.<br>Note<br>You must enable email notification. |

4. After you complete and save the template file, click **Upload Template** in the **Import** wizard. After the upload completes, click **Next**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > After you upload the template file, the system automatically validates the user information. If the file contains errors, the system cannot create the users. You must modify the template file locally and then click **Re-upload**.

5. In the **OK** wizard, preview and check the user information to import, and then click **OK**.

6. (Optional) After the system creates the task, you can click **Task List** in the dialog box to go to the asynchronous task page and view the creation results.

<a id="section-5-2-1-2"></a>

5. View user information in the system user list.

6. Use the drop-down list or advanced filter settings above the list to quickly find users.

If the<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7e44f71e4eb65b501bf2514ba25e840f.png" width="12" alt=""><br>user has changed the password, you cannot view the initial password.<br>• Click <strong>Reset Password</strong> next to <strong>Password</strong> to reset the password of the user to a random initial password.</td>

     <tr>
       <td>Resource Set</td>
       <td>The <strong>Resource Set</strong> tab displays the resource sets that the user has joined. For more information, see Manage the resource sets to which users belong.</td>

       <td>User Group</td>
       <td>The <strong>User Group</strong> tab displays the user groups that the user has joined. For more information, see Manage the user groups to which a user belongs.<br>You can enter a user group name in the text box to quickly find user groups.</td>

       <td>Role Permissions</td>
       <td>The <strong>Role Permissions</strong> tab displays the <strong>Preset Roles &amp; Custom Roles</strong> and <strong>RAM</strong> <strong>Authorization</strong> information of the user.<br>• In the <strong>Preset Roles &amp; Custom Roles</strong> drop-down list, select a role to view the specific permissions of the role.<br>• The <strong>RAM Authorization</strong> section displays the RAM authorization roles of the user.</td>

<a id="section-5-2-1-3"></a>

#### 5.2.1.3. Modify basic information of a user

You can modify and update user information as needed.

**Limits**

- You cannot edit the information of proxy administrator users.

- You cannot modify the user name or the organization to which the user belongs.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Users** **> Users**.

4. Click the **System Users** tab.

5. Quickly find a user by using the drop-down list or advanced filter settings above the list.

6. Click **Edit** in the **Actions** column of the target user.

7. In the **Edit User** dialog box, modify the user information. For more information about the configuration items, see Create a user.

   > **Note**
   >
   > When editing a user, you can configure the **Console Access** access mode only.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ebb98bb7d8d5295f20fda0565569645b.jpeg)

8. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-2-1-4"></a>

#### 5.2.1.4. Manage the roles of a user

This topic describes how to manage the roles of a user.

**Assign a role of the central cloud to a user**

**Limits**

You can assign up to 10 Resource Access Management (RAM) roles to a user, including roles directly assigned to the user and roles assigned to the user group to which the user belongs.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab. Search for a user by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user list.

5. Click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions** column and select **Role Authorization**.

6. In the **Role Authorization** dialog box, add or remove roles.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | User Name | The username. This parameter cannot be modified. |
   | Select Role | • <strong>Add roles</strong>: Select the roles that you want to assign to the user in the left section and click <strong>Add</strong>.<br>• <strong>Remove roles</strong>: Select the roles that you want to revoke from the user in the right section and click <strong>Remove</strong>. |
   | Select Multi-Cloud Role | The multi-cloud role. This parameter is displayed in multi-cloud environments. You can assign roles of managed Apsara Stack platforms and managed Alibaba Cloud platforms to the user. For more information, see the Assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a user and Assign a role of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform to a user sections of this topic. |
   | Inherit User Group Role | The roles assigned to the user group to which the user belongs are displayed. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/df2499617f9506de5c2e54d684132960.jpeg)

7. Click **OK**.

**Assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a user**

**Prerequisites**

- The level-1 organization to which the user belongs is bound to an organization of the managed Apsara Stack platform.

- You are an operations administrator to which the operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to which the organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned.

**Limits**

Only one role of the managed Apsara Stack platform can be assigned to a user.

- When you assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a user that is not a level-1 organization administrator, you can select only a role whose management scope is Resource Sets.

- When you assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a level-1 organization administrator, you can select a role whose management scope is Resource Sets or the organization administrator role.

**Procedure**

1. On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, click Advanced Filter and select a level-1 organization that is bound to the managed Apsara Stack platform from the **Organization** drop-down list to filter users in the level-1 organization.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can also use the **User Name** filter condition to search for users.

2. Find the user that you want to manage, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions** column, and then

   select **Role Authorization**.

3. In the **Select Multi-Cloud Role** section of the **Role Authorization** dialog box, select the role of the managed Apsara Stack platform that you want to assign to the user.

   - **Assign or change the role**: Select the desired role from the drop-down list next to Apsara Stack.

   - **Remove the role**: Click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0d00d215f2768ca8ab09118e69ea5ec8.png" width="17" alt=""> next to the role to revoke the role from the user.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/df2499617f9506de5c2e54d684132960.jpeg)

4. Click **OK**.

5. In the **Role Authorization** message, click **Associate Multi-Cloud Resource Set**. On the User Details page, bind a multi-cloud resource set to the user.

**Assign a role of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform to a user**

**Prerequisites**

- The level-1 organization to which the user belongs is bound to the Alibaba Cloud account of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform.

- You are an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator and are assigned a RAM role to which the AdministratorAccess policy of the Alibaba Cloud account is attached.

**Limits**

Only one RAM role of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform can be assigned to a user.

**Procedure**

1. On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, click Advanced Filter. In the **Organization** drop-down list, select a level-1 organization that is bound to the managed Alibaba Cloud platform to filter users in the level-1 organization.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can also use the **User Name** filter condition to search for users.

2. Find the user that you want to manage, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions** column, and then

   select **Role Authorization**.

3. In the **Select Multi-Cloud Role** section of the **Role Authorization** dialog box, select the required role.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/df2499617f9506de5c2e54d684132960.jpeg)

   | Operation | Procedure |
   | --- | --- |
   | Assign a RAM role | If the user is not assigned a role of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform, you can assign a RAM role to the user.<br>i. Click <strong>Authorize Now</strong> next to Public Cloud.<br>ii. <a id="section-5-2-1-5"></a>

#### 5.2.1.5. Modify multi-cloud roles

This topic describes how to modify multi-cloud roles. You can assign a multi-cloud role to a user or change the multi-cloud role of a user.

**Modify roles of a managed Apsara Stack platform**

**Prerequisites**

- The level-1 organization to which the user belongs is bound to an organization of a managed Apsara Stack platform.

- You are an operations administrator to which the operations administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned or a level-1 organization administrator to which the organization administrator role of the managed Apsara Stack platform is assigned.

**Limits**

Only one role of the managed Apsara Stack platform can be assigned to a user.

- When you assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a user that is not a level-1 organization administrator, you can select only a role whose management scope is Resource Sets.

- When you assign a role of a managed Apsara Stack platform to a level-1 organization administrator, you can select a role whose management scope is Resource Sets or the organization administrator role.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, click Advanced Filter and select the level-1 organization that is bound to a managed Apsara Stack platform from the **Organization** drop-down list to filter users in the level-1 organization.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can also use the **User Name** filter condition to search for users.

5. Find the user that you want to manage, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions** column, and then

   select **Edit Multi-Cloud Role**.

6. In the **Edit Multi-Cloud Role** dialog box, select the role of the managed Apsara Stack platform.

   - **Assign a role or change the role**: Select the required role from the drop-down list next to Apsara Stack.

   - **Remove a role**: Move the pointer over the drop-down list and click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0d00d215f2768ca8ab09118e69ea5ec8.png" width="17" alt=""> icon next to

     the role.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/023b5ef5edeb69e437c4cdbcebf9d5cb.jpeg)

7. Click **OK**.

8. In the **Role Authorization** message, click **Associate Multi-Cloud Resource Set**. On the User Details page, bind a multi-cloud resource set to the user.

**Modify roles of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform**

**Prerequisites**

- The level-1 organization to which the user belongs is bound to the Alibaba Cloud account of a managed Alibaba Cloud platform.

- You are an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator and are assigned a Resource Access Management (RAM) role to which the AdministratorAccess policy of the Alibaba Cloud account is attached.

**Limits**

Only one RAM role of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform can be assigned to a user.

**Procedure**

1. On the **System Users** tab of the **Users** page, click Advanced Filter. In the **Organization** drop-down list, select the level-1 organization that is bound to a managed Alibaba Cloud platform to filter users in the level-1 organization.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can also use the **User Name** filter condition to search for users.

2. Find the user that you want to manage, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions** column, and then

   select **Edit Multi-Cloud Role**.

3. In the **Edit Multi-Cloud Role** dialog box, select the role of the managed Alibaba Cloud platform.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/023b5ef5edeb69e437c4cdbcebf9d5cb.jpeg)

<a id="section-5-2-1-6"></a>

#### 5.2.1.6. Manage the resource sets to which users belong

When the resource sets to which a user belongs change, adjust them through resource set management.

**Central Cloud**

**Add users to central cloud resource sets**

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Users** **> Users**.

4. Click the **System Users** tab. Use the drop-down list or advanced filters above the list to quickly find users.

5. On the **System Users** page, click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> in the **Actions** column of a user and select **Resource**

   **Set Management**. The system displays the **Resource Sets** tab by default.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can also click the username to go to the **Resource Sets** tab.

6. Under the **Resource Sets** tab, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The Central Cloud and Connected Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only Central Cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

7. Click **Add to Resource Set** above the list.

8. In the **Add to Resource Set** dialog box, select the role that the user will assume in the resource set. In the **Select Resource Set** list, select the resource sets to which you want to add the user.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5ca02028a52d2e16b18bd17e84813235.jpeg)

9. Click OK. The system successfully adds the user to the resource sets. The added resource sets appear in the resource set list.

**Remove users from central cloud resource sets**

**Procedure**

1. Under the **Resource Sets** tab, switch to the Central Cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The Central Cloud and Connected Cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only Central Cloud exists by default, and no tabs are displayed.

2. Above the resource set list, query resource sets by role.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a9a9562863c05b2d1f4ef10380e97525.jpeg)

3. In the resource set list, click **Remove** in the **Actions** column.

4. In the **Confirm** dialog box, click OK.

**Connected cloud**

**Add users to connected cloud Resource Sets**

**Prerequisites**

- The user has been granted a connected cloud role.

- You must be an operations administrator (bound to the connected cloud operations administrator role) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the connected cloud organization administrator role).

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set** tab, switch to the connected cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > In multi-cloud scenarios, tabs for the central cloud and connected clouds appear. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs are displayed.

2. Click **Add to Resource Set** above the list.

3. In the **Add to Resource Set** dialog box, select the resource sets to which you want to add the user.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Role for Joining Resource Set**: Displays the connected cloud resource pool and connected cloud role. You cannot modify this setting.
   >
   > - **Select Resource Set**: Displays the names of central cloud resource sets that are bound to connected cloud resource sets. Enter a resource set name in the text box to quickly find a resource set.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d631b08c96d312f43c41ba4f2074e9d6.jpeg)

4. Click **Confirm**.

**Remove users from connected cloud Resource Sets**

**Prerequisites**

You must be an operations administrator (bound to the connected cloud operations administrator role) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the connected cloud organization administrator role).

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set** tab, switch to the connected cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > In multi-cloud scenarios, tabs for the central cloud and connected clouds appear. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs are displayed.

2. In the list of resource sets, view the resource sets to which the user belongs.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The resource set names are those of central cloud resource sets bound to connected cloud resource sets.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/04614f1a9c372f855bdf537ccd7bfe92.jpeg)

3. In the list of resource sets, click **Remove** in the **Actions** column.

4. In the **Confirm** dialog box, click **Confirm**.

**Connected cloud Public Cloud**

**Add users to the connected cloud Public Cloud resource set**

**Prerequisites**

- The user has been granted a connected cloud Public Cloud role.

- You are an operations administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy at the connected cloud Public Cloud account level) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy effective within the scope of the connected cloud Public Cloud primary account).

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Set** tab, switch to the connected cloud Public Cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The central cloud and connected cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs appear.

2. Click **Add to Resource Set** above the list.

3. In the **Add to Resource Set** dialog box, select the resource sets to which you want to add the user.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Role for Joining Resource Set**: Displays the connected cloud Public Cloud resource pool and role. You cannot modify this setting.
   >
   > - **Select Resource Set**: Displays the names of central cloud resource sets bound to connected cloud Public Cloud resource groups. Enter a resource set name in the text box to quickly find a resource set.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0ef28306d9a1d443ef1f302e8363e04f.jpeg)

4. Click **Confirm**.

**Remove users from the connected cloud Public Cloud resource set**

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy at the connected cloud Public Cloud account level) or a level-1 organization administrator (bound to the AdministratorAccess policy effective within the scope of the connected cloud Public Cloud primary account).

**Procedure**

1. On the **Resource Sets** tab, switch to the connected cloud Public Cloud tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The central cloud and connected cloud tabs appear only in multi-cloud scenarios. In single-cloud scenarios, only the central cloud is available by default, and no tabs appear.

2. In the list of resource sets, view the resource sets to which the user belongs.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The resource set name is the name of the central cloud resource set bound to the connected cloud Public Cloud resource group.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/04614f1a9c372f855bdf537ccd7bfe92.jpeg)

3. In the list of resource sets, click **Remove** in the **Actions** column.

4. In the **Confirm Removal** dialog box, click **Confirm**.

**Related operations**

Operations and documentation related to multi-cloud connectivity:

1. Multi-Cloud Management.

2. Manage multi-cloud organizations.

3. Manage multi-cloud resource sets.

4. Modify multi-cloud roles.

#### 5.2.1.7. Manage the user groups to which a user belongs

This topic describes how to change the user groups to which a user belongs.

**Prerequisites**

User groups are created.

**Limits**

You cannot add proxy administrators to or remove proxy administrators from a user group.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab.

5. Search for a user by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user list.

6. Find the user that you want to manage, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions**

   column, and then select **User Groups**.

7. Click the **User Group** tab.

8. Click **Add to User Group** above the list. In the Add to User Group dialog box, search for a user group by name in the search box above the list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6cd917ff0b09c9bb7e2670925c5591c2.jpeg)

9. Select one or more user groups to which you want to add the user.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/77435db91e020d7bb8f0665a4891b30f.jpeg)

0. Click **OK**.

1. Remove the user from a user group as needed.

   <ol type="i">

   <li>

   Find the user group that you want to manage and click Remove in the **Actions** column.

   </li>

   <li>

   In the message that appears, click **OK**.

   </li>

   </ol>

<a id="section-5-2-1-9"></a>

#### 5.2.1.9. Configure MFA settings

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is a security measure that significantly enhances account security. It requires users to bind a virtual MFA device such as Alibaba Cloud app to their accounts. This way, users must prove their identity by using multiple verification methods when they log on.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab.

5. Search for a user by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user list.

6. Find the user that you want to manage, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions**

   column, and then select **MFA Settings**.

7. In the **MFA Settings** dialog box, turn on or off MFA Settings and click **OK**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cdd88d81760d8486ea3307d416a09b31.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > : MFA is enabled.
   >
   > ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cb77433c63274962cc9414e513c29aa6.png)
   >
   > : MFA is disabled.
   >
   > ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/fce618772ff4927ac3c9b07cfd350b6f.png)

       <td>MFA Status</td>
       <td>Description</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Enabled/Unbou nd</td>
       <td>When the user logs on to the console by using the username and password, the <strong>Bind Virtual MFA Device</strong> page appears to ask the user to bind an MFA device.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a1377eba283a7b062e985e81f26c9925.jpeg" alt=""></td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Enabled/Bound</td>
       <td>When the user logs on to the console by using the username and password, a dynamic MFA code is required for authentication.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d56cecbbd723cd7eee976119f8206f8c.jpeg" alt=""><br>If you want to unbind an MFA device from a user, select <strong>Unbind Current</strong> <strong>Device</strong> in the <strong>MFA Settings</strong> dialog box.      <tr>
       <td>Disabled/Boun d</td>
       <td>When the user logs on to the console by using the username and password, a dynamic MFA code is still required for authentication.<br>If you want to unbind an MFA device from a user, select <strong>Unbind Current</strong> <strong>Device</strong> in the <strong>MFA Settings</strong> dialog box. After you unbind the MFA device, the MFA device becomes invalid.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Disabled/Unbo und</td>
       <td>When the user logs on to the console by using the username and password, no dynamic MFA code is required for authentication.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

#### 5.2.1.13. Configure validity periods for accounts

You can configure validity periods for accounts, including the validity period of an account and the validity period of account activity.

**Usage notes**

> **Important**
>
> After the validity periods of an account end, issues may occur when the user logs in to the console or uses the AccessKey pair. Exercise caution when you configure validity periods for an account.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab.

5. Search for a user by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user list.

6. Configure validity periods for accounts.

   - Configure validity periods for an account: Find the user that you want to manage, move

     the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions** column, and then select **Specify Account**

     **Validity Period**.

   - Configure validity periods for multiple accounts: Select multiple users that you want to manage from the user list and click **Specify Account Validity Period** below the user list.

7. In the **Account Validity Period** dialog box, configure the parameters in the **Account Validity Period** and **Account Activity Validity Period** sections.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e256fabf87e125a563c7192eab506ab4.jpeg)

   Parameter

   Description

   **Account**

   Valid values: **Permanently Valid**, **By Duration**, and

   **Validity Period**

   **Specific Date**.

   If you select **By Duration** as Account Validity Period, you must configure this parameter.

   Enter a validity period in the field. The maximum validity period is 365 days.

   **Validity Period**

   > **Note**
   >
   > The validity period starts from the day when you configure this parameter.

   If you select **Specific Date** as Account Validity Period, you must configure this parameter.

   **Account**

   **Expiration**

   In the **Expiration Date** field, select a specific time as the

   **Validity Period**

   **Date**

   deadline from the time picker. The time is accurate to seconds. The deadline must be later than the current time.

   If you select **By Duration** or **Specific Date** as Account Validity Period, you can configure this parameter.

   You can select **Disable Access to Console** and **You are not allowed to use AccessKey pairs to call API operations or other development tools for access**.

   - **Disable Access to Console**: does not allow the user to

   **Access Method**

   use the account and password to access the console.

   - **You are not allowed to use AccessKey pairs to call API operations or other development tools for access**: does not allow the user to use the AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret to initiate requests. Such requests will fail. Process with caution.

   **Disable Control**

   Valid values: **Unlimited** and **By Duration**.

   **without Login**

   If you select **By Duration** as **Disable Control without Login**, you must configure this parameter.

   Enter a period of time in the field. The maximum period of time is 365 days.

   **Duration Since Last Login**

   > **Note**
   >
   > If a user has never logged in with an account, the account is not subject to the validity period of account activity.

   **Account Activity Validity Period**

   If you select **By Duration** as **Disable Control without Login**, you can configure this parameter.

   You can select **Disable Access to Console** and **Disable the creation of AccessKey ID and AccessKey Secret, and restrict access to APIs or other development tools**.

   **Access Method**

   - **Disable Access to Console**: does not allow the user to use the account and password to access the console.

   - **Disable the creation of AccessKey ID and AccessKey Secret, and restrict access to APIs or other development tools**: does not allow the user to use the AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret to initiate requests. Such requests will fail. Process with caution.

8. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-2-1-14"></a>

#### 5.2.1.14. Disable a user

This topic describes how to disable a user.

**Prerequisites**

A user is in the Enabled state.

**Limits**

You cannot disable proxy administrators on the Users page. When you disable a proxy administrator, the corresponding proxy user is also disabled. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.

**Procedure**

> **Important**
>
> - After you disable a user, the user is forbidden from logging on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, the AccessKey pairs of the user are disabled, and the user logon status becomes invalid.
>
> - After an AccessKey pair is disabled, the services or applications that reference the AccessKey pair may not run as expected. In this case, enable the user to restore the services or applications.

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab.

5. Search for a user by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user list.

6. Find the user that you want to manage, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions**

   column, and then select **Disable**.

7. In the dialog box that appears, select **I have known the risks and confirm this operation**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose **Enterprise** > **Permissions** > **AccessKey Logs**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a9203acabb19cd23bdf1cdd5567591c8.jpeg)

8. Click **Disable**.

<a id="section-5-2-1-15"></a>

#### 5.2.1.15. Enable a user

This topic describes how to enable a user.

**Prerequisites**

A user is in the Disabled state.

**Limits**

You cannot enable proxy administrators on the Users page. When you enable a proxy administrator, the corresponding proxy user is also enabled. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab.

5. Search for a user by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user list.

6. Find the user that you want to manage, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions**

   column, and then select **Enable**.

7. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose **Enterprise** > **Permissions** > **AccessKey Logs**.
   >
   > - After a user is enabled, the associated AccessKey pairs are also enabled.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e3d36809afdebd4cf875a5fe97099644.jpeg)

<a id="section-5-2-1-16"></a>

#### 5.2.1.16. Delete a user

This topic describes how to delete a user.

**Limits**

You cannot delete a proxy user on the Users page. To delete a proxy user, go to the details page of the corresponding organization or resource set and delete the proxy user on the Proxy Administrator tab. For more information, see Specify and manage a proxy administrator for an organization and Specify and manage a proxy administrator for a resource set.

**Procedure**

> **Important**
>
> - After you delete a user, the user is forbidden from logging on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, the AccessKey pairs of the user are deleted, and the user logon status becomes invalid.
>
> - After you delete a user, the user data cannot be recovered. After an AccessKey pair is deleted, the services or applications that use the AccessKey pair may not work as expected. Before you delete a user, we recommend that you disable the user first and troubleshoot issues.

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab.

5. Search for a user by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user list.

6. Find the user that you want to manage, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c266cf685bb43a5383d1f321e8e2788f.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in the **Actions**

   column, and then select **Delete**.

7. In the dialog box that appears, select **I have known the risks and confirmed this delete operation**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/25db0be52538e3bd891dba5a4c4bf3c3.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > When you move the pointer over the information in the AccessKey Pair Reference Information column, the last 20 reference records within the previous seven days are displayed. To view more records, choose **Enterprise** > Permissions > **AccessKey Logs**.

8. Click **Delete**.

   The deleted system user is displayed on the **Historical Users** tab. You can restore or permanently delete the user on the Historical Users tab.

On the Historical Users tab, you can restore deleted system users. After a user is restored, the user is displayed on the System Users tab.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

4. Click the **Historical Users** tab.

5. Search for a user by name in the search box above the user list.

6. Find the user that you want to manage and click **Restore** in the **Actions** column.

#### 5.2.1.18. Permanently delete a user

On the Historical Users tab, you can permanently delete deleted system users. After a user is permanently deleted, the user is no longer displayed on the Historical Users tab and cannot be restored.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > Users**.

6. Find the user that you want to manage and click **Delete** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/32599088006541a16f030b11cbd4c869.jpeg)

#### 5.2.1.19. Unlock a temporarily locked user

When a user account is locked due to multiple incorrect password entries, an administrator can unlock it. After unlocking, the user can log in normally.

6. Click **Unlock** in the **Actions** column for the user.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f35f216772ac382dfcc6209b33bbfb48.jpeg)

7. In the dialog box, click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-2-2"></a>

### 5.2.2. User group management

<a id="section-5-2-2-1"></a>

#### 5.2.2.1. Create a user group

User groups help you classify users to simplify permission management. After you create a user group, you can grant permissions to multiple users at a time.

**Relationships between items**

| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| User group and organization | • A user group can belong to only one organization.<br>• Multiple user groups can be created within an organization. |
| User group and user | • A user group can contain zero or more users.<br>• A user does not necessarily need to belong to a user group.<br>• A user can be added to multiple user groups. |
| User group and role | • A role can be assigned to multiple user groups.<br>• When a role is assigned to a user group, the permissions that the role has are automatically granted to users within the user group. |
| User group and resource set | • A resource set can contain zero or more user groups.<br>• A user group can be added to multiple resource sets. |

**Prerequisites**

An organization and roles are created.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users** > **User Groups**.

4. On the **User Groups** page, click **Create User Group**.

5. In the **Create User Group** dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | User Group Name | The name of the user group. The name must be 3 to 255 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and at signs (@). |
   | Organization | The organization to which the user group belongs. |
   | Role authorized | The roles that are assigned to the user group. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3dce92f0df84999f6dcdf5b694632e01.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-5-2-2-2"></a>

#### 5.2.2.2. View user groups

After a user group is created, you can view the created user group in the user group list.

**Prerequisites**

User groups are created.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > User Groups**.

4. Search for a user group by using the search box or specifying advanced filter conditions above the user group list.

5. View the user groups in the list.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c1fbecb88be24420b8d81b8987a07c24.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - The User column displays the number of users added to a user group. You can click the number to view the added users. If the number of added users is zero, a hyphen (-) is displayed.
   >
   > - The Resource Set column displays the resource sets to which a user group is added. If a user group is not added to any resource sets, a hyphen (-) is displayed.

<a id="section-5-2-2-3"></a>

#### 5.2.2.3. Modify the name of a user group

This topic describes how to modify the name of a user group.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f27f7c1c285ce9e1fa2d5ef934b4cc07.jpeg)

6. In the **Modify User Group** dialog box, modify the name of the user group.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6a4f77f12ba0fd4180c2cc41a2d580c3.jpeg)

5. Find the user group that you want to manage, move the pointer over the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cbfb155d3b95b7a6c354178017360ab1.png" width="13" alt=""> icon in the

   **Actions** column, and then select **Authorize**.

<a id="section-5-2-2-5"></a>

#### 5.2.2.5. Add users to a user group

After you create a user group, you can add users to the user group. The users can inherit the permissions of the user group. This way, you can grant permissions to multiple users at a time. This allows you to manage permissions in a more efficient manner, without the need to grant permissions to users one by one.

**Prerequisites**

A user group and users are created.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users > User Groups**.

4. On the User Groups page, select a condition from the drop-down list and then enter a keyword in the search box to search for a user group. Alternatively, specify advanced filter conditions above the user group list to search for a user group.

5. Find the user group that you want to manage and click **Add User** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/21e981129e531b5b47e3d2b77d004495.jpeg)

6. In the **Add User** dialog box, add users. You can manually add users or upload multiple users at a time.

   | Adding Method | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Manually Add | i. Set the <strong>Adding Method</strong> parameter to <strong>Manually Add</strong><br>ii. Select one or more users that you want to add from the left-side section and<br>click the<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/74abfc9a97bc18897658af9a5fc80d42.png)<br>icon to add the selected users to the right-side section.<br>Note<br>• You can manually add up to five users at a time. To add more than five users at a time, we recommend that you use the batch upload method.<br>• You can also select one or more users added to the right-side section and click the icon to remove the users from the<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/fd14a9335487319c2993b7edceb07516.png)<br>right-side section.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5db942c69f0802f2d409d4ca20176b44.jpeg)<br>iii. Click <strong>OK</strong>. |
   |  |  |
   | Batch Upload | i. Set the <strong>Adding Method</strong> parameter to <strong>Batch Upload</strong><br>ii. Click <strong>Download Batch Operation Template</strong> to download the template file in the <strong>XLSX</strong> format to your local computer.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3349c1f4ab6beed03f1e6d544c1a0a22.jpeg)<br>iii. Fill the template file with the names of the users to be added in the template file and save the file.<br>Note<br>You can add up to 300 users by using a template file and upload only one template file at a time.<br>iv. In the file upload section, upload the template file that you filled in.<br>v. Click <strong>OK</strong>. |
