When you configure the billing method, you can select <strong>Pay-as-you-go</strong> or <strong>Subscription</strong>. The available billing methods vary by resource.<br>• <strong>Pay-as-you-go</strong>: This billing method charges you after you use resources based on actual resource usage.<br>• <strong>Subscription</strong>: This billing method requires upfront payment based on a subscription period, such as one month.<br>Note<br>When you create a service, the system displays billing methods based on the following rules:<br>• First-party services:<br>• Public cloud resources: When the billing switch uses the pay-as-you-go pricing mode, the system displays only Pay-as-you-go. When the billing switch uses the cost rate mode, the system displays billing methods that the corresponding service resources support.<br>• Apsara Stack resources: When custom metering and billing management is disabled, the system displays billing methods that metering and pricing support. When custom metering and billing management is enabled, the system displays only Pay-as-you-go.<br>• Third-party services:<br>• Public cloud resources: When the billing switch uses the pay-as-you-go pricing mode, the system does not display any billing method.When the billing switch uses the cost rate mode, the system displays billing methods that the corresponding service resources support.<br>• Apsara Stack resources: When no rule template is configured, the system does not display any billing method. When a rule template is configured, the system displays the billing method that the rule template specifies.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="3">Service Authoriza tion</td>
       <td>Authorizat ion type</td>
       <td>The authorization types include:<br>• <strong>Global scope</strong>: Allows all users in all organizations to access the service.<br>• <strong>Specify organization</strong>: Allows all users in a specified organization to access the service.<br>• <strong>Specify user</strong>: Allows specified users to access the service.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Authorized organizati on</td>
       <td>When you set Authorization type to <strong>Specify organization</strong>, you must specify the authorized organization.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Authorized User</td>
       <td>When you set Authorization type to <strong>Specify user</strong>, you must specify the authorized user.<br>Click <strong>Add user</strong>, select an organization and a username, and authorize the user. After you add the user, you can click <strong>Delete</strong> in the Actions column to remove the user from the authorized user list.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d55d3b71dd1cfb36664a1796db04a2ba.jpeg)

   </li>

   <li>

   **Form Field Settings**: Based on the original form of the product resource, you can add custom fields for different business scenarios. The fields that you add appear at the end of the original form by default.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You do not need to configure this item when you set **Type** of the service to **Specify URL**.

   | Configuratio n item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Component | You can select <strong>Container</strong>, <strong>Input</strong>, <strong>Select</strong>, or <strong>Time</strong>.<br>• <strong>Container</strong>: Includes <strong>Grouping</strong>.<br>• <strong>Input</strong>: Includes <strong>Input box</strong>, <strong>Number input box</strong>, <strong>Multi-line input box</strong>, and <strong>Password box</strong>.<br>• <strong>Select</strong>: Includes <strong>Drop-down list</strong>, <strong>Radio button</strong>, and <strong>Checkbox</strong>.<br>• <strong>Time</strong>: Includes <strong>Date</strong> and <strong>Date range</strong>.<br>• <strong>Other</strong>: Includes <strong>Attachment</strong>. |
   | Form Design | Drag components from the left side to this area. After you drag a component to this area, you can adjust its display order, copy it, or delete it. |
   | Component configurati on | In the Form Design area, select a component and configure its settings. Click <strong>Preview the complete form</strong> at the top to preview the complete form, including the existing standard form and the custom form. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/edc3daaf9594ab93b4aa1aea63e3475e.jpeg)

   </li>

   <li>

   **Form parameter configuration**: Configure the optional parameters and content for the service form fields.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You do not need to configure this item when you set **Type** of the service to **Specify URL**.

   | Configuratio n item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Specification pool | • Add a specification pool: When you select multiple organization resource sets at the same time, switching between different organization resource sets requires multiple specification pools for differentiation. Click <strong>Add</strong> to add multiple specification pools.<br>• Move the pointer over the specification pool name and click<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/af6082a8e71c3f9e9a642f2a5aad76b1.png" width="12" alt="">to modify the<br>specification pool name. You cannot modify the default specification pool.<br>• Move the pointer over the specification pool name and click<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ab9dff8706ec8e70b5ff2d375b3e4b81.png" width="14" alt="">to delete the<br>specification pool. You cannot delete the default specification pool.<br>• Preview the complete form: Preview all configuration items that appear when you create the corresponding cloud service resource through the standard process.<br>Note<br>The service catalog at the upper level controls the specification configuration of the specification pool. If the parameter configurations at the lower level conflict with those at the upper level, the validation fails. |
   | Form field | Click <strong>Select attribute fields</strong> and select the fields that you want to specify in the expanded panel. The system generates a field specification configuration based on the selected fields. Configure the field specifications in the corresponding field area.<br>• Service management retrieves different field trees based on the selected service type. These field trees are relationship trees composed based on the dependencies among fields.<br>• All resources require detailed information about the organization and resource set when you activate, modify, or release them in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. Therefore, the Organization and Resource Set fields appear by default. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1546303791312e017a6e7171111c3855.jpeg)

   </li>

   <li>

   **Pricing configuration**: Preview the pricing configuration.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You do not need to configure this item when you set **Type** of the service to **Specify URL**.
   >
   > - If billing information exists, click **View details** to go to the billing configuration details page.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4019dc4f2686a1252842ddc849ec1a56.jpeg)

   </li>

   </ol>

5. Click **Submit** to create the service. The system displays the origin of all created services as Custom.

<a id="section-7-2-2-2-1-3"></a>

###### 7.2.2.2.1.3. View the service list and details

View preset and custom services in the system.

**Prerequisites**

By default, operations administrators, resource auditors, organization administrators, and organization resource auditors can perform this operation.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Service Catalog** > **Service Management**.

4. On the **Product Service** tab, expand the advanced filter, set filter conditions such as **Service name**, **Service ID**, **Resource Pool**, **Product**, **Resources**, **Authorized organization**, **Authorized User**, and **Update Time**, and then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Resource Pool: Select the resource pool to which the service belongs. This option appears only in multi-cloud scenarios.

5. View preset and custom services in the service list.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6496397adb88a16745eaf082f3df800a.png" width="14" alt=""> to the right of the **Type** field in the list to filter services by **Service**,
   >
   >   **Specify URL**, or **Custom Service**. **Custom services** refers to those created with the legacy custom configuration type and no longer supports management. To create a new custom service, go to the product management, add a custom product, and then create a service based on that custom product.
   >
   > - Click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6496397adb88a16745eaf082f3df800a.png" width="14" alt=""> to the right of the **Source** field in the list to filter services by **Custom** or
   >
   >   **System preset**.
   >
   > - Click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6496397adb88a16745eaf082f3df800a.png" width="14" alt=""> to the right of the **Status** field in the list to filter services by **Put on**
   >
   >   **shelves**, **Removed**, or **To be put on shelves** status.

6. Click a service ID to go to the service details page.

   | Item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Basic informat ion | Displays the basic information of the service. |

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Detailed steps</td>
       <td>Displays the <strong>Basic information</strong>, <strong>Form Field Settings</strong>, <strong>Form Parameter</strong> <strong>Configuration</strong>, and <strong>Pricing configuration</strong> of the service.<br>Note<br>• Click a step to switch to and view the detailed configuration content.<br>• If no form fields, form parameter configuration, or pricing configuration exists, the corresponding step appears dimmed and does not display content.<br>• When the <strong>type</strong> of the service is <strong>Specify URL</strong>, only the basic information step is available for viewing.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/121cd349654fa8cb4410d6e413085d1a.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-2-2-1-4"></a>

###### 7.2.2.2.1.4. Edit a service

You can update a service when the service content changes.

**Prerequisites**

- The service source is **Custom**, and the service is in the **To be put on shelves** or **Removed** status.

- The default operator is the operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

- You cannot edit preset services.

- You cannot edit **custom services** of the legacy custom configuration type. If necessary, go to Product Management to add a custom product, and then create a new service based on the custom product.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Service Catalog** > **Service Management**.

4. On the **Product Service** tab, find the target service in the service list and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

5. On the **Edit service** page, modify the service information. For more information on parameter configuration, see Create a service.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8e2c20829279ac9139a7e928580886e7.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-2-2-1-5"></a>

###### 7.2.2.2.1.5. Publish a service

You must publish a service before users can use it. The system initializes all preset services in the **To be put on shelves** status by default.

**Prerequisites**

- The service is in the **To be put on shelves** or **Removed** status.

- The default operator is the operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

You cannot publish **custom services** of the legacy custom configuration type. If necessary, go to Product Management to create a custom product, and then create a new service based on the custom product.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Service Catalog** > **Service Management**.

4. On the **Product Service** tab, publish a single service or multiple services in batches.

   - **Publish a single service**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the service list, click **Shelf** in the **Action** column of the target service.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ad1e8b6630b090c328beabcd6704ecc2.jpeg)

     </li>

     <li>

     Click **OK**. After publishing the service, the system changes its status to **Put on shelves**.

     </li>

     </ol>

   - **Publish multiple services in batches**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the service list, select the services that you want to publish.

     </li>

     <li>

     Click **Publish** at the bottom of the list.

     </li>

     </ol>

     <ol type="i" start="100">

     <li>

     Click **OK**. After publishing the services, the system changes their status to **Put on shelves**.

     </li>

     </ol>

<a id="section-7-2-2-2-1-6"></a>

###### 7.2.2.2.1.6. Unpublish a service

Unpublish a service that is already published.

**Prerequisites**

- The service is in the **Put on shelves** status.

- The default operator is the operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Service Catalog** > **Service Management**.

4. On the **Product Service** tab, unpublish a single service or multiple services in batches.

   - **Unpublish a single service**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the service list, click **Lower shelf** in the **Actions** column of the target service.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/10a87a03fe9789556a8aa3628430c05a.jpeg)

     </li>

     <li>

     Click **OK**. After unpublishing the service, the system changes its status to **Removed**.

     </li>

     </ol>

   - **Unpublish multiple services in batches**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the service list, select the services that you want to unpublish.

     </li>

     <li>

     Click **Unpublish** below the list.

     </li>

     </ol>

     <ol type="i" start="100">

     <li>

     Click **OK**. After unpublishing the services, the system changes their status to **Unpublished**.

     </li>

     </ol>

<a id="section-7-2-2-2-1-7"></a>

###### 7.2.2.2.1.7. Copy a service

Quickly copy a service with the same configuration.

**Prerequisites**

The default operator is the operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

- You cannot copy preset services.

- The system no longer supports management of **custom services** of the legacy custom configuration type. If necessary, go to Product Management to add a custom product, and then create a new service based on the custom product.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Service Catalog** > **Service Management**.

4. On the **Product Service** tab, find the target service and click **Copy** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/10a87a03fe9789556a8aa3628430c05a.jpeg)

5. In the dialog box, enter a name for the service.

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-2-2-1-8"></a>

###### 7.2.2.2.1.8. Change the authorization scope of a service

You can reauthorize a service to change its authorization scope when needed.

**Prerequisites**

- The service source is **Custom**.

- The default operator is the operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

- The authorization scope of a preset service defaults to all users in the global scope, and cannot be changed.

- The system no longer supports authorization for **custom services** of the legacy custom configuration type. If necessary, go to Product Management to add a custom product, and then create a new service based on the custom product.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Service Catalog** > **Service Management**.

4. On the **Product Service** tab, find the target service in the service list, click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9b2aab72b95172fdd9cd8b7db09c1baa.png" width="14" alt=""> in the

   **Actions** column, and then select **Authorization**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/dd228972d1b97387edcd3f157331023a.jpeg)

5. In the dialog box, modify the authorization type as needed.

   | Configuration item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Authorization type | The authorization types include:<br>• <strong>Global scope</strong>: Allows all users in all organizations to access the service.<br>• <strong>Specify organization</strong>: Allows all users in a specified organization to access the service.<br>• <strong>Specified user</strong>: Allows specified users to access the service. |
   | Authorized organization | When you select <strong>Specify organization</strong> as the authorization type, the authorized organization is required. |
   | Authorized User | When you select <strong>Specified user</strong> as the authorization type, the the authorized user is required.<br>• <strong>Add authorized users</strong>: Click <strong>Add user</strong>, select an organization and usernames to authorize the users.<br>• <strong>Remove authorized users</strong>: After adding authorized users, you can click <strong>Delete</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column to remove a user from the authorized user list. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a04a3d6c15740610ebc1caca858a35b8.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-2-2-1-9"></a>

###### 7.2.2.2.1.9. Delete a service

You can delete a service that is no longer needed.

**Prerequisites**

- The service source is **Custom**, and the service is in the **To be put on shelves** or **Removedh** status.

- The default operator is the operations administrator or organization administrator.

**Limits**

You cannot delete preset services.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Service Catalog** > **Service Management**.

4. On the **Product Service** tab, find the target service in the service list, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9b2aab72b95172fdd9cd8b7db09c1baa.png" width="14" alt=""> icon in

   the **Actions** column, and then select **Delete**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/18676b4262630629d34c5b9879ab8897.jpeg)

5. Click **OK**.

Configure the synchronization cycle for services that synchronize models, agents, Model Context Protocols (MCPs), and skills from products such as API Gateway, AI Studio, and OpenAPI Explorer.

   You can set the synchronization cycle to **Every Hour**, **Every 2 Hours**, **Every 6 Hours**, **Every 12 Hours**, **Every 24 Hours**, or a custom cycle.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4d3cf56dec5626f4c7d1d98ab849893a.jpeg)

6. Click **Submit** to save the synchronization configuration.

   Click **Synchronize Now** to synchronize services immediately.

<a id="section-7-2-2-3"></a>

#### 7.2.2.3. Operation examples

<a id="section-7-2-2-3-1"></a>

##### 7.2.2.3.1. Example: Create an ECS instance service

This topic describes how to create an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance service.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or an organization administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Service Catalog** > **Service Management**.

4. On the **Service Management** page, click **Create a service**.

5. In the Basic information step, configure the parameters and click **Next Step**.

   - **Service type**

     - **Type**: Select **Service**.

     - **Cloud Platform**: Select a cloud platform. The Cloud Platform parameter is displayed only in multi-cloud scenarios.

     - **Product**: Select **Elastic Compute Service** of the **Elastic Computing** category from the first drop-down list and **ECS Instance** from the second drop-down list.

   - **Service information**

     - **Service name**: Enter the name of the service. Example: ECS instance service.

     - **Icon**: Select the icon of the service.

     - **Service Description**: Enter the description of the service. Example: Set restrictions on the instance types, disks, and the number of ECS instances for when users in the baseservicetest organization create ECS instances.

   - **Billing Method**

     Select the billing method of the service. Valid values: **Pay-as-you-go** and **Subscription**. When users create ECS instances, the billing method that you configure for this parameter is displayed.

   - **Service Authorization**

     Specify which users of which organizations can access the service. For example, if you select **Specify organization** and select the baseservicetest organization from the **Authorized organization** drop-down list, only users of this organization can access the service.

6. In the Form Field Settings step, configure form fields and configuration instructions, and click **Next Step**.

   For example, click Create Instance on the left, drag the Input box component in the Component section to the Form Design section. Then, configure the component in the Component configuration section on the right. Set the name of the field group to Custom Form and the name of the input box to Reason for Application.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c08edabbd8af48ae09c4ce7750949bf2.jpeg)

7. In the Form parameter configuration step, select attribute fields, configure their values, and then click **Next Step**.

   Example:

   - Click Select attribute fields. In the panel that appears, select **Instance Type** in the **Instance** category, **System Disk** and **Data Disk** in the **Storage** category, and **Number of Instances** in the **Management Configuration** category. Then, click OK.

   - In the **Data Disk** section, click Add specifications and configure parameters such as the instance type, system disk type and capacity, and data disk type and capacity.

   - If you set the **Number of Instances** parameter to 1 to 5, users can create a maximum of five ECS instances at a time.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c1f8976d4e572917ff26860b9e114b4f.jpeg)

8. In the Pricing configuration step, confirm the pricing rules and click **Submit**.

9. In the service list, find the service and click **Shelf** in the Actions column to publish the service.

**Impacts**

When users in the baseservicetest organization select the preceding service catalog when they create ECS instances, the ECS instances are subject to the service catalog restrictions.

**Restrictions on instance types**

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4646fad210cf115eb6b999be2e57574f.jpeg)

**Restrictions on the types and capacities of the system disk and data disk**

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/dc4179af49a9cea65095c59e7f96f102.jpeg)

**Restrictions on the number of ECS instances**

### 7.2.3. Order management

<a id="section-7-2-3-1"></a>

#### 7.2.3.1. Orders

On the Orders page, you can view the order history, including order status, date, and cost, and track the progress of orders.

<a id="section-7-2-3-1-1"></a>

##### 7.2.3.1.1. View orders

The Orders page displays order information categorized as My Orders, Orders to Be Handled, To Be Claimed, All Orders, and Abnormal Orders.

**Background information**

- Orders include orders for activation, configuration change, unsubscription, renewal, and billing method change. The following scenarios generate orders.

  - Activation: You activate a cloud service for the first time or create an instance in the cloud product console.

  - Configuration change: You change the configuration of cloud product resources, such as scaling in, scaling out, upgrading, or downgrading.

  - Unsubscription: You release the corresponding cloud service or cloud product resources.

  - Renewal: You renew a resource order that uses the subscription billing method.

  - Subscription to pay-as-you-go: You change the billing method of a resource from subscription to pay-as-you-go.

  - Pay-as-you-go to subscription: You change the billing method of a resource from pay-as-you-go to subscription.

- Each cloud service generates one main order, and each cloud product resource generates one sub-order. If no cloud product corresponds to the service, the service generates one main order. By default, the system does not display sub-order information in the order details. Instead, the system displays it as instance information.

- My Orders: orders that you created

- Orders to Be Handled: orders that need to be handled

- To Be Claimed: orders pending claim. Administrators can also assign these orders.

- All Orders: all orders within your permission scope

- Abnormal Orders: orders that have billing exceptions, uncreated resources, or inconsistent statuses

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top menu bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Orders** > **Orders**.

4. On the **Orders** page, click the **My Orders**, **Orders to Be Handled**, **To Be Claimed**, **All Orders**, or **Abnormal Orders** tab.

5. Expand **Advanced Filter**, configure the filter conditions, and then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Resource Pool**: Filter orders by resource pool. This option is available only in multi-cloud scenarios.
   >
   > - **Organization**: When you filter orders by organization, the system does not include order data from subordinate organizations.
   >
   > - **Type**: You can select **Purchase**, **Change Configuration**, **Unsubscribe**, **Renew**, **Switch to Pay-as-you-go**, or **Switch to Subscription**.
   >
   > - **Billing Method**: You can select **Pay-as-you-go** or **Subscription**.
   >
   > - **Resource Item**: Select a cloud product before you select a resource item.

6. View the order list on the corresponding tab.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/390d78be1800ef64ffa34ac19e07ac10.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Move the pointer over
   >
   >   next to **Specification details** to view the detailed
   >
   >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3698b249fb5cb0adf3a14a5aa69d9bb5.png" width="19" alt="">
   >
   >   specification information.
   >
   > - **Quantity**: the number of resources in the order
   >
   > - **Duration**: For the pay-as-you-go billing method, charges are based on the actual usage, and this column displays a hyphen (-). For the subscription billing method, this column displays the actual duration of new purchases, renewals, or the remaining duration after configuration changes based on the order type. For the unsubscription, this column displays a hyphen (-).
   >
   > - **Fees**: the fee information of the order. For the pay-as-you-go billing method, this column displays the unit price. For the subscription billing method, this column displays the total cost. If the resource does not support billing or the fee is zero, this column displays a hyphen (-).
   >
   >   - **Purchase**: the unit price or the total cost for the newly purchased resources
   >
   >   - **Renewal**: the total renewal cost for the resources
   >
   >   - **Change Configuration**: the unit price of the resources after the configuration change or the price difference for this configuration change. A positive price difference indicates an upgrade and represents the additional fee that you must pay. A negative price difference indicates a downgrade and represents the refund amount.
   >
   >   - **Unsubscribe**: the total refund amount upon the unsubscription
   >
   >   - **Switch to Pay-as-you-go**: the total refund amount when you change the billing method from subscription to pay-as-you-go
   >
   >   - **Switch to Subscription**: the additional fee that you must pay when you change the billing method from pay-as-you-go to subscription

7. Click **Details** in the **Actions** column of an order, or click the order ID to go to the order details page.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5169ec2f0dd484bee36a56b4c117bfe5.jpeg)

   | Item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Basic informatio n | Displays information about the order, including the organization, resource set, region, creator, creation time, order type, billing method, and total expenses. |
   | Service informatio n | Displays service configuration information and instance details provisioned by this order. Service information represents sub-order details. The status of the main order correlates with the provisioning status of instances in sub-orders.<br>• <strong>Service configuration</strong>: Displays the service name, configuration specifications, billing method, subscription duration, and fees.Note<br>Click <strong>View Details</strong> to open the <strong>Expense Details</strong> dialog box and view detailed billing information.<br>• Original Price: the sum of the original prices of all billing items<br>• Discount Price: the sum of the discounted prices of all billing items<br>• Discounted price = Total price × Discount rate<br>The discounted price is automatically truncated at the seventh decimal place. Any amount beyond the seventh decimal place is excluded from the final discounted price.<br>• Under the discounted price, each billing item and its corresponding discounted price are displayed. For example, in Expense Details, Priced by specification and Priced by storage capacity both represent billing items.<br>• A price difference may exist when you change the service configurations.<br>• For the pay-as-you-go billing method, the price difference represents the difference in unit price before and after the configuration change.<br>• For the subscription billing method, a positive price difference indicates the additional amount that you must pay, and a negative price difference indicates the refund amount.<br>• A refund may be issued when you unsubscribe from a service. The refundable amount is automatically truncated at the third decimal place. The used duration is calculated in exact days, and any partial day is rounded up to one full day.<br>• <strong>Request Configuration Change Records</strong>: The system displays configuration change records when the service configuration has been modified.<br>• <strong>Instance details</strong>: Displays detailed information about instances associated with the order. The information shown is a snapshot taken when the order was completed. If the instance changes later, the snapshot remains unchanged.<br>• Overall provisioning status:<br>• Total quantity: the total number of resources in the order |
   | Execution Progress | • Completed: the number of successfully provisioned resources Displays the overall execution progress of the order.<br>• Failed: the number of failed resources. If failures occur, you can click <strong>Rerun</strong> or <strong>Cancel execution</strong> on the page. |
   | Coupon Informatio n | • Canceled: the number of canceled resources<br>Displays the coupon deduction records of the order.<br>• Update Time: the time of the last update, including operations triggered by reruns or cancellations |

   - Instance details list: Displays detailed information about instances in the order.

<a id="section-7-2-3-1-2"></a>

##### 7.2.3.1.2. Reorder

This topic describes how to generate an identical or a similar order based on an existing order. This way, the configurations of the existing order can be reused to avoid reconfiguration.

**Prerequisites**

The order type is **Purchase**.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top menu bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Orders** > **Orders**.

4. On the **Orders** page, click the **My Orders**, **Order to Be Handled**, or **All Orders** tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **My Orders**: displays the orders that you created.
   >
   > - **Orders to Be Handled**: displays the orders that need to be handled by you.
   >
   > - **All Orders**: displays all orders within your permission scope.

5. Expand **Advanced Filter**, configure the filter conditions, such as **Order No.**, **Organization**, **Creation Time (UTC±HH:MM)**, **Created by**, **Resource Pool**, **Service**, **Product**, **Resource Item**, **Type**, **Instance ID**, **Instance Name**, **Billing Method**, and **Status**, and click **Search**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e9d6c899f1858a615cb98046354e9cdf.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Resource Pool**: Filter orders by resource pool. This condition is available only in multi-cloud scenarios.
   >
   > - **Organization**: If you filter orders by organization, the order data of subordinate organizations is excluded.
   >
   > - **Type**: You can select **Purchase**, **Change Configuration**, **Unsubscribe**, **Renew**, **Switch to Pay-as-you-go**, or **Switch to Subscription**.
   >
   > - **Billing Method**: You can select **Pay-as-you-go** or **Subscription**.
   >
   > - **Resource Item**: Select a cloud product before you select a resource item.

6. On the order list, find the new purchase order that you want to reorder.

7. Click **Re-order** in the **Actions** column of the order. Alternatively, go to the **Order Details** page and click **Re-order**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/390d78be1800ef64ffa34ac19e07ac10.jpeg)

8. On the displayed resource creation page, adjust the configuration parameters as needed, and then submit the order.

##### 7.2.3.1.4. Execute delivery

On the **Orders to Be Handled** tab, set a delivery time for a custom service order in the pending status. The system automatically executes the delivery when the specified time arrives.

**Prerequisites**

The order status is **Processing**.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Orders** > **Orders**.

4. On the **Orders** page, click the **Orders to Be Handled** tab.

5. Expand **Advanced Filter**, set the **Order No.**, **Organization**, **Creation time (UTC±08:00)**, **Created by**, **Resource Pool**, **Service**, **Product**, **Resource Item**, **Type**, **Instance ID**, **Instance Name**, **Billing Method**, and **Status** conditions, and then click **Search**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e9d6c899f1858a615cb98046354e9cdf.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Resource Pool**: Filters orders by resource pool. This option appears only in multi-cloud scenarios.
   >
   > - **Organization**: When you filter orders by organization, the results do not include order data from subordinate organizations.
   >
   > - **Type**: Supports **Purchase**, **Change Configuration**, **Unsubscrbe**, **Renew**, **Switch to Pay-as-you-go**, and **Switch to Subscription**.
   >
   > - **Billing Method**: Supports **Pay-as-you-go** and **Subscription**. Custom services support only the pay-as-you-go method, so the system delivers only pay-as-you-go services.
   >
   > - **Resource Item**: Select a cloud service before you select a resource item.

6. In the order list, find the order that you want to process.

7. Click **Perform delivery** in the **Actions** column of the order. Alternatively, go to the **Order Details** page, click **More**, and then select **Perform delivery**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1649382b46afe1c2d87052e3f53757f7.jpeg)

8. In the **Service delivery confirmation** dialog box, enter the **Instance Details Address**, **Delivery time**, and **Description**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can select a past time as the delivery time. The earliest selectable time is 15 days before the current time.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/85adf218d9c16f29092a9d8add336694.jpeg)

9. Click **OK**.

On the **My Orders**, **Orders to Be Handled**, or **All Orders** tab, click **Advanced Filter**, configure filter conditions such as **Order No.**, **Organization**, **Creation time(UTC±HH:MM)**, **Created by**, **Cloud Platform**, **Service**, **Product**, **Resource Item**, **Type**, **Instance ID**, **Instance Name**, **Billing Method**, and **Status**, and then click **Search**.

#### 7.2.3.2. Renewal management

<a id="section-7-2-3-2-1"></a>

##### 7.2.3.2.1. View organization renewal resources

The Renewal Management page displays resources that users activated with the subscription billing method.

**Prerequisites**

By default, authorized users include Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, Organization Resource Auditor, Organization Security Administrator, Global Organization Security Administrator, Platform Security Administrator, and Platform Security Configuration Administrator. Custom roles must have the permission “View organization renewal resources” under “Order Management” and menu access to “Renewal Management”.

**Constraints**

- Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Global Organization Security Administrator, Platform Security Administrator, and Platform Security Configuration Administrator have permissions across all organizations.

- Organization Administrator, Organization Resource Auditor, and Organization Security Administrator have permissions for their own organization and subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Order Management** > **Renewal**.

4. On the **Renewal** page, expand **Advanced Filter**, set conditions for **Instance ID**, **Instance Name**, **Organization**, **Resource Set**, **Resource Pool**, **Product**, **Resource**, and **Expiration time (UTC±HH:MM)**, then click **Search** to quickly locate resources.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Resource Pool**: Filter resources by resource pool. This option appears only in multi-cloud scenarios.
   >
   > - Select an organization before selecting a resource set.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ae09cda92ced9b6261cedf82d4b641db.jpeg)

5. View resource instances activated within the organization.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Click
   >
   >   next to **Expiration Time** to sort resources in ascending or descending
   >
   >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1fa8bb553b8f55903954d541340481b9.png" width="11" alt="">
   >
   >   order.
   >
   > - Click an instance ID to navigate to the corresponding resource console and view instance details.
   >
   > - Resources configured for **Manual Renewal** change status to **Expired** upon expiration and are billed on a pay-as-you-go basis. If you renew an expired resource, the system charges on a pay-as-you-go basis for the renewal day and switches to subscription billing from the next day.
   >
   > - Automatic renewal takes effect the day after configuration. The system deducts the renewal fee at 08:00, nine days before resource expiration.
   >
   >   - If deduction fails, the system retries daily until successful or until one day before expiration.
   >
   >   - If a resource expires tomorrow, automatic renewal does not apply. You must manually renew it.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/35b44ea4dbfa7e9aad016f60a6edf55b.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-3-2-2"></a>

##### 7.2.3.2.2. Set the renewal method

Renewal management allows you to manage resource renewal methods.

**Prerequisites**

By default, users with the following roles can perform this operation: Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, Organization Resource Auditor, Resource Set Administrator, Resource User, Organization Security Administrator, Global Organization Security Administrator, Platform Security Administrator, and Platform Security Auditor. For custom roles, you must grant the "Set Renewal Method" permission under "Order Management" and the "Renewal Management" menu permission.

**Limits**

- The permission scope for Operations Administrators, Resource Auditors, Global Organization Security Administrators, Platform Security Administrators, and Platform Security Configuration Administrators covers all organizations.

- The permission scope for Organization Administrators, Organization Resource Auditors, and Organization Security Administrators covers their own organization and subordinate organizations.

- The permission scope for Resource Set Administrators and Resource Users covers their own resource sets.

- You cannot set the renewal method for resources that are undergoing changes.

**Change manual renewal resources to automatic renewal**

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Order Management** > **Renewal**.

4. On the **Renewal** page, click **Enable Auto Renewal** in the **Actions** column of a resource configured with manual renewal.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/35b44ea4dbfa7e9aad016f60a6edf55b.jpeg)

5. In the **Automatic Renewal Management** dialog box, select a value for **Subscription Duration**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Valid values: **1 Month**, **2 Months**, **3 Months**, **4 Months**, and **More Durations**.
   >
   > - If you select **More Durations**, you can customize the subscription duration by specifying a value from 5 to 60 in the **Subscription Duration (Months)** field.
   >
   > - The automatic renewal setting takes effect the next day. The system deducts the quota at 08:00 nine days before the resource expires.
   >
   >   - If the deduction fails, the system retries daily until the deduction succeeds or one day before expiration.
   >
   >   - If the resource expires tomorrow, automatic renewal does not apply. You must manually renew the resource.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c2f05db9009da0cd6f4a35c379b0f67d.jpeg)

6. Click OK. After the setting is successful, the renewal method of the resource changes from **Manual Renewal** to **Automatic Renewal**.

**Change automatic renewal resources to manual renewal**

**Procedure**

1. On the **Renewal** page, click **Resume Manual Renewal** in the **Actions** column of a resource configured with automatic renewal.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/35b44ea4dbfa7e9aad016f60a6edf55b.jpeg)

2. In the **Operation Confirmation** dialog box, click **Confirm**. After the setting is successful, the renewal method of the resource changes from **Automatic Renewal** to **Manual Renewal**.

**Set the subscription duration for automatic renewal**

**Procedure**

1. On the **Renewal** page, click **Modify Automatic Renewal** in the **Actions** column of a resource configured with automatic renewal.

2. In the **Automatic Renewal Management** dialog box, select a value for **Subscription Duration**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Valid values: **1 Month**, **2 Months**, **3 Months**, **4 Months**, and **More Durations**.
   >
   > - If you select **More Durations**, you can customize the subscription duration by specifying a value from 5 to 60 in the **Subscription Duration (Months)** field.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c2f05db9009da0cd6f4a35c379b0f67d.jpeg)

3. Click OK.

<a id="section-7-2-3-2-3"></a>

##### 7.2.3.2.3. Manual renewal

The renewal management feature supports manual renewal of resources.

**Prerequisites**

By default, users with the following roles can perform this operation: Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, Organization Resource Auditor, Resource Set Administrator, Resource User, Organization Security Administrator, Global Organization Security Administrator, Platform Security Administrator, and Platform Security Auditor. Custom roles must have the “Manual Renewal” permission under “Order Management” and access to the “Renewal Management” menu.

**Constraints**

- Users with the roles of Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Global Organization Security Administrator, Platform Security Administrator, and Platform Security Configuration Administrator have permissions across all organizations.

- Users with the roles of Organization Administrator, Organization Resource Auditor, and Organization Security Administrator have permissions for their own organization and subordinate organizations.

- Users with the roles of Resource Set Administrator and Resource User have permissions limited to their assigned resource sets.

- You cannot renew resources that are currently undergoing modification.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Orders**> **Renewal**.

4. On the **Renewal** page, click **Renew** in the **Actions** column for the target resource.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/35b44ea4dbfa7e9aad016f60a6edf55b.jpeg)

5. In the **Manual Renewal** dialog box, select **Subscription Duration**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Available durations include **1 month**, **2 months**, **3 months**, **4 months**, and **More Durations**.
   >
   > - If you select **More Durations**, you can customize the subscription duration in **Subscription Duration (Months)**. The valid range is 5 to 60 months.
   >
   > - After successful manual renewal, the expiration date of the resource extends by the number of months you selected.
   >
   > - When a resource renewed via **Manual Renewal** expires, its status changes to **Expired**, and billing switches to the Pay-As-You-Go method. If you renew an expired resource, the system charges on a Pay-As-You-Go basis for the day of renewal and switches to Subscription billing starting the next day.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f2bb133be9b67409ca8809ccee12e28e.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-3-2-4"></a>

##### 7.2.3.2.4. AI analysis of renewal resources

Perform AI analysis on renewal resources.

**Prerequisites**

- The operations administrator has enabled the display of the intelligent assistant in **Configurations** > **Apsara Copilot** > **Custom Settings**.

- Make sure that you have enabled the **Intelligent Operations Expert** on the expert management page of Apsara Copilot.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Orders** > **Renewal**.

4. On the **Renewal** page, click **AI Analysis** in the upper-right corner.

5. View the idle resource ratio analysis report.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/939425175fa5e2d112d3afbc5ade7ccf.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-3-3"></a>

#### 7.2.3.3. Billing method change

<a id="section-7-2-3-3-1"></a>

##### 7.2.3.3.1. View instances eligible for billing method conversion

In the instance list, view all instances eligible for billing method conversion.

**Prerequisites**

By default, users with the following roles can perform this operation: Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, Organization Resource Auditor, Organization Security Administrator, Global Organization Security Administrator, Platform Security Administrator, and Platform Security Configuration Administrator. Custom role users must be granted the permission "View instances eligible for billing method conversion" under "Order Management" and access to the "Switch Billing Method" menu.

**Constraints**

- Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Global Organization Security Administrator, Platform Security Administrator, and Platform Security Configuration Administrator manage resources across all organizations.

- Organization Administrator, Organization Resource Auditor, and Organization Security Administrator manage resources within their own organization and subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager management console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Order Management** > **Switch Billing Method**.

4. Expand **Advanced filter**, set filters for **Instance ID**, **Instance name**, **Organization**, **Resource set**, **Resource pool**, **Service**, and **Resource item**, then click **Search** to locate resources quickly.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/edbb0e1b614ad1f308537d8769ead804.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Resource pool**: Filter by resource pool. This option appears only in multi-cloud scenarios.
   >
   > - Select an organization before selecting a resource set.

5. In the instance list, view information about instances eligible for billing method conversion.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Click an instance ID to go to its details page and view detailed information.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/916e697614207b787d8f4bc543ba7b29.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-3-3-2"></a>

##### 7.2.3.3.2. Switch from subscription to pay-as-you-go

You can switch the billing method of an instance from subscription to pay-as-you-go. After you change the billing method, you are charged based on the actual usage. The fee for the remaining subscription is refunded. This helps you reduce costs and flexibly manage resources.

**Prerequisites**

- The current billing method of the instance is subscription.

- You are an operations administrator, a resource auditor, an organization administrator, an organization resource auditor, an organization security administrator, a global organization security administrator, a platform security administrator, or a platform security configuration administrator. If you are using a custom role, the role must be granted the View Organization Resource Renewals management permission and the Renewal menu permission.

**Limits**

- The payment method of an instance can be changed only once within a calendar day.

- The operations administrator, resource auditor, global organization security administrator, platform security administrator, and platform security configuration administrator have permissions on all organizations.

- The organization administrator, organization resource auditor, and organization security administrator have permissions on the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Orders** > **Switch Billing Method**.

4. Find the instance for which you want to change the billing method and click **Change to Pay-as-you-go** in the **Actions** column.

5. In the **Change to Pay-as-you-go** dialog box, view the instance information and refund fees.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Click the instance ID to go to the Instance Details page to view the instance details.
   >
   > - Move the pointer over **View details** in the Change to Pay-as-you-go dialog box to view the billing details.
   >
   > - Refundable fee = (Original order amount -Charged fee) × Refund percentage.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/79961b868a976fb2b5c420d14e591a47.jpeg)

6. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-3-3-3"></a>

##### 7.2.3.3.3. Switch from Pay-As-You-Go to Subscription Billing

After you switch a Pay-As-You-Go instance to Subscription Billing, the system bills you based on the selected subscription duration and resource configuration.

**Prerequisites**

- The current billing method of the instance is Pay-As-You-Go.

- By default, only users with the following roles can perform this operation: Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, Organization Resource Auditor, Organization Security Administrator, Global Organization Security Administrator, Platform Security Administrator, and Platform Security Configuration Administrator. Custom role users must be granted the "Switch Billing Method" permission under "Order Management" and access to the "Switch Billing Method" menu.

**Limits**

- You can switch the billing method for the same instance only once per calendar day.

- Only Pay-As-You-Go instances of cloud services that support Subscription Billing can be switched to Subscription Billing.

- Operations Administrators, Resource Auditors, Global Organization Security Administrators, Platform Security Administrators, and Platform Security Configuration Administrators manage all organizations.

- Organization Administrators, Organization Resource Auditors, and Organization Security Administrators manage their own organization and subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Orders** > **Switch Billing Method**.

4. Click **Change to Subscription** in the **Actions** column of the target instance.

5. In the **Change to Subscription** dialog box, set the subscription duration and whether to enable auto-renewal.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Click the instance ID to go to the instance details page and view detailed information about the instance.
   >
   > - Available subscription durations are **1 month**, **2 months**, **3 months**, **4 months**, and **More Durations**. If you select **More Durations**, you can specify a custom duration in the **Subscription Duration (Months)** field. Valid values range from 5 to 60 months.
   >
   > - Hover over **View Details** to expand the cost breakdown.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5d35f8714b32053aed3e387c3e2a0fa4.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

##### 7.2.4.1.1. View the product bill overview

The Bill Overview tab of the Product Bill Overview page displays the bill overview of products.

You are an operations administrator, a resource auditor, an organization administrator, or an organization resource auditor.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor have permissions only on the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Product Bill Overview**.

4. On the **Bill Overview** tab, select an accounting period from the **Accounting Period** drop-down list. If the selected accounting period has unprocessed issues, the bill data displayed may be inaccurate. In this case, you can click **Pending Bill Issues** as an operations administrator or a resource auditor to go to the **Bill Audit Issues** page for troubleshooting.

   - **Bill Overview of Resource Items**: displays the **number of activated resource items**, **number of resource items for which fees are charged in the selected month**, **total fees in the selected month**, and **total fees of the year**.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - Move the pointer over the number corresponding to **Resource Items that Incur Fees This Month** and view details.
     >
     > - Click the amount corresponding to **Total Fees of This Month** to go to the **Overview of Monthly Bill** tab.

     - Click **Top 5** or **Top 10** in the upper-right corner to display the top 5 or top 10 resource items for which the most fees are charged each month.

       ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/97fe61865eb5e25ee0b80940f172e117.png)

       ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6c26896c7de1c36aa221171fd86c496c.png)

     - Click the

       or

       icon to display the consumption trend of resource items in a

       column chart or a line chart.

   - **Top 5 or Top 10 Consumption Distribution of Resource Items**: displays the fees and percentage of the fees that are charged for the top 5 or top 10 resource items in the selected month.

     > **Note**
     >
     > You can click an amount in the **Fees** column to go to the **Overview of Monthly Bill** tab. On this tab, the accounting period and resource item are selected as the filter conditions by default.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/864e697b91b1d2273b707b2aec451ca6.jpeg)

     > **Note**

##### 7.2.4.1.2. View the monthly bill overview

The Overview of Monthly Bill tab displays the monthly bill overview of products.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator, a resource auditor, an organization administrator, or an organization resource auditor.

**Limits**

- The operations administrator and resource auditor have permissions on all organizations.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor have permissions only on the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Product Bill Overview**.

4. Click the **Overview of Monthly Bill** tab.

5. Specify the accounting period, resource item, and organization, and then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > After you select an organization, only the bills of the selected organization are displayed. The bills of its subordinate organizations are not displayed.

6. View the monthly bill information in the **Accounting Period**, **Organization**, **Resource Item**, **Amount**, and **Billing Cycle** columns.

   > **Note**

##### 7.2.4.1.4. Perform an AI-based analysis of cloud service bills

This topic describes how to perform an AI-based analysis of cloud service bills.

**Prerequisites**

- You are an operations administrator, a resource auditor, an organization administrator, or an organization resource auditor.

- The display of Apsara Copilot is enabled by an operations administrator on the **Custom Settings** page of the **Apsara Copilot** module in **Configurations**.

**Limits**

- The operations administrator and resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage all organizations.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Product Bill Overview** to go to the **Product Bill Overview** page.

4. On the **Bill Overview** tab, select an accounting period from the **Accounting Period** drop-down list. If the selected accounting period has unprocessed issues, the bill data displayed may be inaccurate. In this case, you can click **Pending Bill Issues** as an operations administrator or a resource auditor to go to the **Bill Audit** page for troubleshooting.

5. Click **AI Diagnostics** in the upper-right corner to perform intelligent analysis on the overview data and generate a bill analysis report.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - The Bill Fluctuation Analysis feature supports the analysis of bill changes from multiple dimensions, such as cloud service, organization, resource set, and tag.
   >
   > - The Trend Analysis and Forecast feature provides bill trend prediction for cloud services, organizations, resource sets, tags, cost centers, and resource instances.
   >
   > - You can ask questions based on analysis results by using Apsara Copilot.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/fd2f3789054bf5ac159cd694b8263f5d.jpeg)

The Organization Bill Overview page displays the overview of monthly bills by organization and resource set.

- The operations administrator and resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage all organizations.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

If unhandled issues exist in the selected accounting period, the bill data may be inaccurate. To handle the issues, you can click **Bill problem pending** as an operations administrator or a resource auditor to go to the **Bill Audit Issues** page.

     - Click the

       or

       icon to display the consumption trend of organizations in a

       column chart or a line chart.

     > **Note**

##### 7.2.4.2.2. View the monthly bill overview of an organization

You can view the monthly bill overview of an organization on the Organization monthly bill overview tab of the Organization Bill Overview page.

**Prerequisites**

You are assigned the operations administrator, resource auditor, organization administrator, or organization resource auditor role.

**Limits**

- The operations administrator and resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage all organizations.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

**Prerequisites**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Organization Bill Overview** to go to the **Organization Bill Overview** page.

4. On the Organization Bill Overview page, click the **Organization monthly bill overview** tab.

5. Click **Advanced Filter**, select an accounting period from the **Accounting Period** drop-down list and an organization from the **Organization** drop-down list, and then click **Search**.

6. View the monthly bill information of the organization in columns such as **Organization**, **Accounting period**, **Amount (only for organization at this level)**, **Amount (including subordinate organizations)**, and **Billing cycle**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If unhandled issues exist in the selected accounting period, the bill data may be inaccurate. To handle the issues, you can click **Go Now** above the bill list as an operations administrator or a resource auditor to go to the **Bill Audit Issues** page.
   >
   > - If you do not select an organization, the monthly bills of all organizations that you can manage are displayed by default.
   >
   > - In the bill list, if an organization has subordinate organizations, you can click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d4470c91715645315bd8731243df32f2.png" width="6" alt=""> icon next to the organization to view the monthly bills of the subordinate
   >
   >   organizations.
   >
   > - You can click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6e1474f0c3844e002d046cda8d1f24c2.png" width="7" alt=""> icon next to **Amount (including subordinate**
   >
   >   **organizations)** to sort data by amount in ascending or descending order.
   >
   > - To view the bill details of an organization by month, you can find the organization in the bill list and click **View Details by Month** in the **Operation** column to go to the **Monthly Details** tab of the **Bill Details** page.
   >
   > - To view the transaction details of an organization, you can find the organization in the bill list and click **View Transaction Details** in the **Operation** column to go to the **Hourly Details** tab of the **Bill Details** page.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/26a79ec84545ebb61e0b0985ab0c51c3.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-2-3"></a>

##### 7.2.4.2.3. View the monthly bill overview of a resource set

You can view the monthly bill overview of a resource set on the Resource Collection monthly bill overview tab of the Organization Bill Overview page.

**Prerequisites**

You are assigned the operations administrator, resource auditor, organization administrator, or organization resource auditor role.

**Limits**

- The operations administrator and resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage all organizations.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Organization Bill Overview** to go to the **Organization Bill Overview** page.

4. On the Organization Bill Overview page, click the **Resource Collection monthly bill overview** tab.

5. Click **Advanced Filter**, select an accounting period from the **Accounting Period** drop-down list, an organization from the **Organization** drop-down list, and a resource set from the **Resource Set** drop-down list, and then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If you do not select an organization, the monthly bills of resource sets in all organizations that you can manage are displayed by default. If you select an organization, only the monthly bills of resource sets in the selected organization are displayed. The monthly bills of resource sets of the subordinate organizations are not included.
   >
   > - You can select a resource set only after you select an organization.

6. View the monthly bill information of the resource set in columns such as **Accounting Period**, **Organization Name**, **Resource Set Name**, **Amount**, and **Billing Cycle**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If unhandled issues exist in the selected accounting period, the bill data may be inaccurate. To handle the issues, you can click **Go Now** above the bill list as an operations administrator or a resource auditor to go to the **Bill Audit Issues** page.
   >
   > - To view the bill details of a resource set by month, you can find the resource set in the bill list and click **View Details by Month** in the **Actions** column to go to the **Monthly Details** tab of the **Bill Details** page.
   >
   > - To view the transaction details of a resource set, you can find the resource set in the bill list and click **View Transaction Details** in the **Actions** column to go to the **Hourly Details** tab of the **Bill Details** page.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9c258b5bc6f2d3a4bf290838aed03266.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-2-4"></a>

##### 7.2.4.2.4. Settle monthly bills for organizations

After monthly bills are settled, the quotas of independent accounts and allocation accounts in budgets are deducted based on the actual bill amount of the current month, and the frozen quota is unfrozen.

**Usage notes**

> **Important**
>
> - After the bills in an accounting period are settled, the bill amount is frozen and cannot be adjusted or regenerated. Be sure to confirm the bill information before settlement.
>
> - If the billing rules, discount deductions, bill adjustments, and cost center rules for the accounting period are adjusted, the bill regeneration feature must be used to ensure that the configurations and rules are applied to historical bills.
>
> - If you want to adjust the bill amount after the bills are settled, make supplements and corrections in the bills next month.

**Prerequisites**

- In the budget settings, the **Budget account creation dimension** parameter in **global settings** is set to **By organization**.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

You can settle monthly bills only if all check items are in the **Successful** state.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Organization Bill Overview**.

4. Click **Monthly Bill Settlement** in the upper-right corner.

5. In the **Monthly Bill Settlement** dialog box, configure the **Billing Cycle** parameter and view the status of check items.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Param eter</td>
       <td>Description</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Billing Cycle</td>
       <td>The accounting period involved in the settlement.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Check Item</td>
       <td>• <strong>The fee deduction switch is turned on.</strong>: checks whether the fee deduction switch is turned on. If not, turn on the switch before settlement.<br>• <strong>The billing period has ended.</strong>: checks whether the accounting period has ended.Settlement can be made only after two days from the end date of the accounting period.<br>• <strong>The bill for the billing period is not generated.</strong>: checks whether the bills of the selected accounting period are settled. Settlement is not supported if the bills have been settled.<br>• <strong>All freezing tasks of the budget account in the billing period are normal.</strong>: checks whether all freezing tasks of the budget account in the current accounting period are normal. If not, contact O&amp;M engineers to handle abnormalities before settlement.<br>• <strong>The latest independent account balance matches the account statement.</strong>: checks whether the latest balance of the independent account is consistent with the account statement. If not, contact O&amp;M engineers to handle abnormalities before settlement.<br>• The latest balance of the independent account is the same as the balance of <strong>the allocation account.</strong>: checks whether the latest balance of the independent account is the same as the balance of the allocation account. If not, contact O&amp;M engineers to handle abnormalities before settlement.<br>• No running bill regeneration task, cost center relabeling task, or bill <strong>adjustment task exists in the current billing period.</strong>: checks whether the accounting period has any bill regeneration tasks, cost center relabeling tasks, or bill adjustment tasks that are running. If yes, wait until the tasks are complete before settlement.<br>• <strong>No pending audit issues exist during the billing period.</strong>: checks whether the accounting period has any unprocessed audit issues. If yes, go to the Bill Audit page to troubleshoot issues before settlement.<br>• <strong>Reconciliation rules in the billing period have taken effect.</strong>: checks whether the adjustment rules are effective during the accounting period. If the adjustment is not complete, make the adjustment records effective or void. After the adjustment records take effect, you need to regenerate bills.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3aa3b2849eab23a8ee8176d5051e2eae.jpeg)

6. Select **You confirm that the billing data in the billing period is accurate.** and click **Confirm**.

##### 7.2.4.2.5. Export organization monthly bills

You can export organization monthly bills on the Organization Monthly Bill Overview tab.

**Prerequisites**

By default, users with the Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, or Organization Resource Auditor roles can perform this operation.

- Operations Administrators and Resource Auditors have permission over all organizations.

- Organization Administrators and Organization Resource Auditors have permission over their own organization and its subordinate organizations.

**Constraints**

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Bill Management** > **Organization Bill Overview** to go to the **Organization Bill Overview** page.

4. Click the **Organization Monthly Bill Overview** tab.

   > **Note**
   >

   >   organization name to expand its subordinate organization monthly bills.

<a id="section-7-2-4-2-7"></a>

##### 7.2.4.2.7. Perform an AI-based analysis of organization bills

This topic describes how to perform an AI-based analysis of organization bills.

**Prerequisites**

- You are an operations administrator, a resource auditor, an organization administrator, or an organization resource auditor.

- The display of Apsara Copilot is enabled by an operations administrator on the **Custom Settings** page of the **Apsara Copilot** module in **Configurations**.

**Limits**

- The operations administrator and resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage all organizations.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor roles have the permissions to manage the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Organization Bill Overview** to go to the **Organization Bill Overview** page.

4. On the **Bill Overview** tab, select an accounting period from the **Accounting Period** drop-down list. If the selected accounting period has unprocessed issues, the bill data displayed may be inaccurate. In this case, you can click **Pending Bill Issues** as an operations administrator or a resource auditor to go to the **Bill Audit** page for troubleshooting.

5. Click **AI Diagnostics** in the upper-right corner to perform intelligent analysis on the overview data and generate a bill analysis report.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - The Bill Fluctuation Analysis feature supports the analysis of bill changes from multiple dimensions, such as cloud service, organization, resource set, and tag.
   >
   > - The Trend Analysis and Prediction feature provides bill trend prediction for cloud services, organizations, resource sets, tags, cost centers, and resource instances.
   >
   > - You can ask questions based on analysis results by using Apsara Copilot.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/be512677cbdcb0376e43e747709b8b58.jpeg)
