#### 7.2.4.3. Bill overview of cost centers

You can view the monthly bill overview of cost centers on the Cost Center Bill Overview page.

<a id="section-7-2-4-3-1"></a>

##### 7.2.4.3.1. View the bill overview of cost centers

You can view the bill overview of cost centers on the Bill overview tab of the Cost Center Bill Overview page.

**Prerequisites**

You are assigned the operations administrator, resource auditor, organization administrator, or organization resource auditor role.

**Limits**

- By default, the operations administrator and resource auditor roles can view the bills of all cost centers.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor roles can view only the bills of the cost center that they have the permissions to manage and the subordinate cost centers.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Cost Center Bill Overview** to go to the **Cost Center Bill Overview** page.

4. On the **Bill overview** tab, select an accounting period from the **Accounting period** drop-down list. If unhandled issues exist in the selected accounting period, the bill data may be inaccurate. To handle the issues, you can click **Bill problem pending** as an operations administrator or a resource auditor to go to the **Bill Audit Issues** page.

   - **All Overview of financial unit bills**: displays the number of cost centers, number of cost centers that incur fees in the selected month, total fees in the selected month, and total fees of the year.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - The number of cost centers includes the cost center that you have the permissions to manage and its subordinate cost centers.
     >
     > - You can click the number above **Total expenses for this month** to go to the **Financial order lunar January bill overview** tab.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9ea817158f8fdff6a65b4347aed73d3f.jpeg)

   - **Financial unit consumption trend. Recent 6 months**: displays the consumption trend of each cost center in the selected month and the previous five months.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/2dd829d6dc0e0d8339dd614d82e8cf4e.jpeg)

     - Click **Top 5** or **Top 10** in the upper-right corner to display the top five or ten cost centers that incur most fees each month.

     - Click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/42a0626703b58b9037cca5b5704ffe30.png" width="26" alt=""> or <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f40bdff86e80359c1dca437d1b186751.png" width="17" alt=""> icon to display the consumption trend of cost centers in a column

       chart or a line chart.

   - **Top 5 or Top 10 Consumption distribution of financial units**: displays the fees incurred by the top five or top ten cost centers in the selected month and corresponding percentages.

     > **Note**
     >
     > In the Top 5 or Top 10 Consumption distribution of financial units section, you can find a cost center and click the amount in the **Fees** column to go to the **Financial order lunar January bill overview** tab. By default, the selected month and cost center are specified as the filter conditions.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/879b6927202a447f523d62679d5ff679.jpeg)

   - **Financial unit consumption details**: displays the fees incurred by all cost centers in the selected month.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - In the upper-right corner of the section, you can select **Sort by cost from high to low** or **Sort by cost from low to high**.
     >
     > - In the Financial unit consumption details section, you can find a cost center and click the amount in the Fees column to go to the **Financial order lunar January bill overview** tab. By default, the selected month and cost center are specified as the filter conditions.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b10164c04ee8c74aa486855164331732.jpeg)

You can view monthly bills of cost centers on the Cost Center Bill Overview page.

   >

##### 7.2.4.3.4. Export cost unit monthly bills

On the cost unit monthly bill overview tab, you can export cost unit monthly bills and save them locally.

**Prerequisites**

By default, users performing this operation are operations administrators, resource auditors, organization administrators, and organization resource auditors.

**Constraints**

- The permission scope for operations administrators and resource auditors covers all cost units.

- The permission scope for organization administrators and organization resource auditors covers authorized cost units and their subordinate cost units.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Bills** > **Cost Unit Bill Overview** to go to the **Cost Unit Bill Overview** page.

4. Click the **Cost Unit Monthly Bill Overview** tab.

5. Expand advanced filters, set filter conditions for **Accounting Period** and **Cost Unit**, then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > If there are pending issues for the accounting period, bill data may be inaccurate. Operations administrators and resource auditors can click **Go Now** above the list to go to the **Bill Audit Issues** page.

6. Export all bills or export selected bills.

   - **Export all bills**

     > **Note**

<a id="section-7-2-4-4"></a>

#### 7.2.4.4. Overview of public cloud bills

The Public Cloud Bill Overview page provides a comprehensive bill comparison across public cloud services.

<a id="section-7-2-4-4-1"></a>

##### 7.2.4.4.1. View the overview of public cloud bills

The Public Cloud Bill Overview page provides an overview of public cloud bills.

**Prerequisites**

- The multi-cloud management feature is enabled, and the Alibaba Cloud public cloud platform is configured. This allows you to view bill data.

- You are an operations administrator or a resource auditor.

**Usage notes**

> **Important**
>
> Public cloud subscription resources are not billed based on orders, but are billed based on the total list price on public cloud bills.
>
> - Newly purchased, configurations upgraded, renewed, and billing method changed from pay-as-you-go to subscription: Total list price × Price multiplier × Discount
>
> - Unsubscribed, configurations downgraded, and billing method changed from subscription to pay-as-you-go: Total list price × Price multiplier × Discount × Refund ratio

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Overview of Public Cloud Billing** to go to the **Public Cloud Bill Overview** page.

4. On the **Bill Overview** tab, select an accounting period from the **Account Period** drop-down list. If the selected accounting period has unprocessed issues, the bill data displayed may be inaccurate. In this case, you can click **Bill problem pending** as an operations administrator or a resource auditor to go to the **Bill Audit** page for troubleshooting.

   - **Resource Item Bill Overview**: displays the following items: **Products in Selected Accounting Period**, **Charged Resources**, **Total Public Cloud Cost in This Month**, **Total Resale Revenue of Public Cloud in This Month**, **Total Profit in This Month**, and **Total Profit in This Year**.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1be39d83f7da245e04114a13570ae29a.jpeg)

   - **Trend and Distribution**: displays the resale revenue trends and resource profit distribution in the previous six months. You can switch between the top 5 and top 10 resources.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9cf1a391364dd0c914a303b145f1d93a.jpeg)

     - **Resale Revenue Trends in Last 6 Months**: displays the trends of resale revenue in the current month and the previous five months in the selected accounting period. You can click the drop-down list in the upper-right corner of the chart to select a cloud service.

     - **Resource Profit Distribution**: displays the profit distribution of the resources in the selected accounting period.

   - **Organization Ranking by Profit**: displays the profit information of all organizations in the current month of the selected accounting period.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - **Public Cloud Cost**: the payable amount of public cloud bills.
     >
     > - **Resale Revenue**: the amount payable in cloud service bills.
     >
     > - **Profit** = **Resale Revenue** - **Public Cloud Cost**.
     >
     > - You can click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/89315651890b3b0d9555f9bd47b733af.png" width="13" alt=""> icon next to the Public Cloud Cost, Resale Revenue, or
     >
     >   Profit field to sort data by amount in ascending or descending order.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/892eed06819ad02abd031445dc7f701e.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-4-2"></a>

**Usage notes**

> **Important**
>
> Public cloud subscription resources are not billed based on orders, but are billed based on the total list price on public cloud bills.
>
> - Newly purchased, configurations upgraded, renewed, and billing method changed from pay-as-you-go to subscription: Total list price × Price multiplier × Discount
>
> - Unsubscribed, configurations downgraded, and billing method changed from subscription to pay-as-you-go: Total list price × Price multiplier × Discount × Refund ratio

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

4. Click the **Monthly Product Bill Overview** tab.

5. Configure the **Account Period** and **Resources** filter conditions to filter bills.

6. View the monthly bills of public cloud services in the list.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Public Cloud Cost**: the payable amount of public cloud bills.
   >
   > - **Resale Revenue**: the amount payable in cloud service bills.

   >
   > - You can click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/89315651890b3b0d9555f9bd47b733af.png" width="13" alt=""> icon next to the Public Cloud Cost, Resale Revenue, or Profit
   >
   >   field to sort data by amount in ascending or descending order.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cc03680e2ff269c0b5ac35e330623949.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-5"></a>

#### 7.2.4.5. Bill details

The Bill Details page displays the bill details by month or hour. This helps you understand the bills within a specific period of time.

<a id="section-7-2-4-5-1"></a>

##### 7.2.4.5.1. View monthly details

The Monthly details tab displays billing information by month.

**Prerequisites**

By default, the user roles that can perform this operation are Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, and Organization Resource Auditor.

**Limits**

- The permission scope for Operations Administrators and Resource Auditors covers all organizations and all cost centers.

- When the data scope is set by organization, the permission scope for Organization Administrators and Organization Resource Auditors includes their own organization and subordinate organizations.

- When the data scope is set by cost center, the permission scope for Organization Administrators and Organization Resource Auditors includes authorized cost centers at their level and child cost centers.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Details** to go to the **Bill Details** page.

4. On the **Monthly Details** tab, expand **Advanced filter**, configure filters such as **Data Scope**, **Cost Center**, **Billing period (UTC±HH:MM)**, **Organization**, **Resource Set**, **Product**, **Resource item**, **Resource Pool**, **Region**, and **Instance ID**, and then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Data Scope**: Select **By Organization** or **By Cost Center**.
   >
   > - **Billing period (UTC±HH:MM)**: Select the year and month to view. The billing period refers to the time zone of the service deployment location.
   >
   > - **Cost Center**: This option is available only when you select **Data Scope** as **By Cost Center**.
   >
   > - **Organization**: If you select **Data Scope** as **By Cost Center**, you must first select a cost center.
   >
   > - **Resource Set**: If you select a resource set, you must first select an organization.
   >
   > - **Product**: When you select a cloud product, you can enter its name in the text box to quickly find it.
   >
   > - **Resource**: If you select a resource, you must first select a cloud product.
   >
   > - **Resource Pool**: You can select only one resource pool. This option appears only in multi-cloud scenarios.
   >
   > - **Region**: Select one or more regions from the drop-down list.
   >
   > - **Instance ID**: Enter the instance ID to query.

5. View the monthly bill details in the list.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If there are pending issues for the billing period, the bill data may be inaccurate. Operations Administrators and Resource Auditors can click **Go Now** above the list to go to the **Bill Audit Issues** page.
   >
   > - **Tag**: Refers to tags configured for cloud resource instances.
   >
   > - Consumption amount = Total consumption amount - Refund amount
   >
   > - Amount payable = Consumption amount - Deduction amount - Discount amount - Rounding amount - Coupon deduction amount
   >
   > - Click
   >
   >   above the list to customize list items. On the Global list items and
   >
   >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3318f3cae0cfc66c265459fc60adeb7d.png" width="22" alt="">
   >
   >   Resource list items tabs, select items to display, and then drag them under Selected items to adjust their order.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b0cbbec2efbcf3a013e38a7167a24a4a.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-5-2"></a>

##### 7.2.4.5.2. View daily details

The Daily Details tab shows billing information by day.

**Prerequisites**

By default, the operating user is an Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, or Organization Resource Auditor.

**Constraints**

- The permission scope for Operations Administrators and Resource Auditors covers all organizations and all cost centers.

- When the data scope is set by organization, the permission scope for Organization Administrators and Organization Resource Auditors includes their own organization and subordinate organizations.

- When the data scope is set by cost center, the permission scope for Organization Administrators and Organization Resource Auditors includes authorized cost centers at their level and child cost centers.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Bills** > **Bill Details** to go to the **Bill Details** page.

4. Click the **Daily Details** tab.

5. Expand **Advanced filtering**, set **Data Scope**, **Bill Data**, **Billing period (UTC±HH:MM)**, **Start and end time (UTC±HH:MM)**, **Cost Center**, **Organization**, **Resource Set**, **Product**, **Resource**, **Resource Pool**, **Region**, **Instance ID**, **Bill Source**, **Tag**, and **Type**, then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Data Scope**: Select **By Organization** or **By Cost Center**.
   >
   > - **Bill Data**: Select **Split Bill** or **Original Bill**.
   >
   > - **Billing period (UTC±HH:MM)**: Select the year and month you want to view. The billing period refers to the server deployment location time and displays different time zones based on the deployment location.
   >
   > - **Start and end time (UTC±HH:MM)**: Select the start and end times. Start and end times refer to the server deployment location time and display different time zones based on the deployment location.
   >
   > - **Cost Center**: Available only when **Data Scope** is set to **By Cost Center**.
   >
   > - **Organization**: When **Data Scope** is set to **By Cost Center**, select a cost center first.
   >
   > - **Resource Set**: When selecting a resource set, select an organization first.
   >
   > - **Product**: Select the cloud product you want to view.
   >
   > - **Resource**: When selecting a resource item, select a cloud product first.
   >
   > - **Resource Pool**: Select a resource pool. Single selection is supported. This option is displayed only in multi-cloud scenarios.
   >
   > - **Region**: Select one or more regions from the drop-down list.
   >
   > - **Instance ID**: Enter the instance ID you want to query.
   >
   > - **Bill Source**: Select **System Generated**, **Manual Reconciliation**, or **External Import**.
   >
   > - **Tag**: Select tags.
   >
   > - **Type**: Select the bill type.

6. View daily detailed bills in the list.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If there are pending issues for the billing period, the bill data may be inaccurate. Operations Administrators and Resource Auditors can click **Go Now** above the list to go to the **Bill Audit Issues** page.
   >
   > - **Tag**: Refers to tags set on cloud resource instances.
   >
   > - Consumption amount is the fee generated by an instance according to billing rules. For refunds, the consumption amount is the actual refundable amount.
   >
   > - When **Bill Data** is set to **Split Bill**, the detail list displays split ratio information.
   >
   > - Click
   >
   >   above the list to customize list items. On the Global List Items and
   >
   >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3318f3cae0cfc66c265459fc60adeb7d.png" width="22" alt="">
   >
   >   Resource List Items tabs, select items to display, then drag and drop to adjust the order of selected items.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3ff23e59661bac7277ff9f3f51f8caf2.jpeg)

7. For bills with Manual Reconciliation as the source, click **View Details** in the **Actions** column to view billing details for that instance.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e7a87b129ab498f8cd70f1a06bcb874c.jpeg)

   - Reversal: Reduces the amount of an existing bill and appears as a red negative number.

   - Supplement: Increases the amount of an existing bill and appears as a blue positive number.

##### 7.2.4.5.3. View hourly details

The Hourly Details tab displays billing information by hour.

**Prerequisites**

By default, users performing this operation are Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, or Organization Resource Auditor.

**Constraints**

- The permission scope for Operations Administrator and Resource Auditor covers all organizations.

- The permission scope for Organization Administrator and Organization Resource Auditor covers their own organization and subordinate organizations.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Bills** > **Bill Details** to go to the **Bill Details** page.

4. Click the **Hourly Details** tab.

5. Expand **Advanced filter**, set conditions for **Billing period (UTC±HH:MM)**, **Start and end time (UTC±HH:MM)**, **Organization**, **Resource Set**, **Product**, **Resource**, **Resource Pool**, **Region**, and **Instance ID**, then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - **Billing period (UTC±HH:MM)**: Select the year and month to view. The billing period refers to the server deployment location time and displays different time zones based on the deployment location.
   >
   > - **Start and end time (UTC±HH:MM)**: Select the start and end times. Start and end times refer to the server deployment location time and display different time zones based on the deployment location.
   >
   > - **Organization**: Select the organization to view. This does not include bills from subordinate organizations.
   >
   > - **Resource Set**: When selecting a resource set, first select an organization.
   >

   >
   > - **Resource**: When selecting a resource, first select a cloud product.

6. View the hourly billing details in the list.

   > **Note**

   >

   >
   > - The consumption amount is the fee generated by the instance according to the billing rules. For refund types, the consumption amount represents the actual refundable amount.

##### 7.2.4.5.5. Export daily detailed billing statement

On the Daily Details tab, you can export billing details by day. After exporting the billing statement, go to the report download page to download and save the report locally.

By default, the operating user is an Operations Administrator, Resource Auditor, Organization Administrator, or Organization Resource Auditor.

**Limits**

- The permission scope for Operations Administrators and Resource Auditors covers all organizations and all cost centers.

- When the data scope is set by organization, the permission scope for Organization Administrators and Organization Resource Auditors includes their own organization and subordinate organizations.

- When the data scope is set by cost center, the permission scope for Organization Administrators and Organization Resource Auditors includes authorized cost centers at their level and child cost centers.

##### 7.2.4.5.6. Export hourly bill details

On the Hourly Details tab of the Bill Details page, you can export hourly bill details. After the bill details are exported, you can go to the Report Download page to download the generated report to your local device.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator, a resource auditor, an organization administrator, or an organization resource auditor.

**Limits**

- The operations administrator and resource auditor have permissions on all organizations.

- The organization administrator and organization resource auditor have permissions only on the organization to which they belong and the subordinate organizations.

   >

   >
   > - The **Label** column displays the tags that are set for cloud resource instances.
   >
   > - The consumption amount is the expense incurred by an instance based on billing rules. The consumption amount of the refund type refers to the actual refundable amount.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/93e367c25445371b5860cd89d633843d.jpeg)

     </tr>

<a id="section-7-2-4-5-7"></a>

##### 7.2.4.5.7. Regenerate bills

If a bill is abnormal or needs to be updated, you can regenerate the bill based on the latest data and rules. This ensures the accuracy and timeliness of the bill.

**Prerequisites Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

For accounting periods whose bills are settled, bill regeneration is not supported.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Details** to go to the **Bill Details** page.

4. Click **Generate bills again** in the upper-right corner.

5. In the **Generate bills again** dialog box, configure the following parameters.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Output Type | Valid values: <strong>Basic Bill</strong>, <strong>Bill Adjustment</strong>, <strong>Bill Split</strong>, and <strong>Cost Unit</strong>.<br>• <strong>Basic Bill</strong>: applies to scenarios in which the billing, discount, or reduction rules are adjusted. If you select this option, the cost center bills are updated.<br>• <strong>Bill Adjustment</strong>: applies to scenarios in which the bill adjustment records are added, enabled, or canceled.<br>• <strong>Bill Split</strong>: applies to scenarios in which bills are split based on the split rule.<br>• <strong>Cost Unit</strong>: applies to scenarios in which the cost center data or allocation rules are adjusted. |
   | Product | The products for which you want to regenerate bills. You can select multiple products at a time. You can also search for a product by name.<br>After you select products, click <strong>OK</strong> at the bottom of the Product drop-down list. |
   | Resources | The resources for which you want to regenerate bills. You can select all or specific resources. |
   | Account period(UTC ±HH:MM) | The accounting period of the bills to be regenerated.<br>• If you select <strong>Basic Bill</strong>, <strong>Bill Split</strong>, or <strong>Cost Unit</strong> as the output type, you can select only one month as the accounting period.<br>• If you select <strong>Bill Adjustment</strong> as the output type, you can select at most six consecutive months as the accounting period. |
   | Billing Date | The time range of the bills to be regenerated. This parameter is supported only when you select <strong>Basic Bill</strong>, <strong>Bill Split</strong>, or <strong>Cost Unit</strong> as the output type. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/09a83251ec0ce7f670a30c42ce43b676.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

7. After bills are regenerated, click **Rebuild records** in the upper-right corner of the **Bill Details** page to view the detailed generation records.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If a record displayed as Failed to generate exists on the **Bill Adjustment**, **Bill Split**, or **Cost Center** tab, contact the O&M engineers for troubleshooting.
   >
   > - A failed record on the **Basic Bill** tab indicates that an audit issue exists. In this case, go to the Bill Audit Issues page for troubleshooting.
   >
   > - If a record is not generated within 1 hour, you can click **Stop** in the Actions column of the record to stop the regeneration. After you stop the regeneration, you can resume it.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bd22554460dd73b50d4bcb4ec3100141.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-5-8"></a>

##### 7.2.4.5.8. AI analysis of bill details

This feature provides a detailed breakdown of instance bills, including usage, unit prices, and calculation rules.

**Prerequisites**

- The operations administrator has enabled the display of the intelligent assistant in **Configurations** > **Apsara Copilot** > **Custom Settings**.

- By default, operations administrators, resource auditors, organization administrators, and organization resource auditors can perform this operation.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Bills** > **Bill Details**.

4. On the **Daily Details**/**Hourly Details** tab, click **AI Parsing** in the **Actions** column of a bill.

5. View the AI analysis of the bill details.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7d9b54f5d2a3db9e7009c3e5562e87fb.png)

<a id="section-7-2-4-6-2"></a>

##### 7.2.4.6.2. View reconciliation records

This topic describes how to view reconciliation records on the Bill Reconciliation page.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or a resource auditor.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Reconciliation**.

4. Click **Advanced Filter**, configure filter conditions such as **ID**, **Instance ID**, **Instance Name**, **Product**, **Resources**, **Organization**, **Resource Set**, and **Status**, and then click **Search**.

5. View the information about reconciliation records.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Description of the Adjustment Amount column:
   >
   > - A negative amount is generated if a reconciliation record is added to decrease the amount of an existing bill.
   >
   > - A positive amount is generated if a reconciliation record is added to increase the amount of an existing bill.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7ef2c4fa59017c23716ad1b5a55350ec.jpeg)

6. Click a record ID. The **Bill Adjustment Record Details** panel appears.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5f0582e37460a474f4941d44af33a228.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-6-3"></a>

##### 7.2.4.6.3. Enable a reconciliation record

After a reconciliation record changes from the To take effect state to the In effect state, the reconciliation record is enabled. After you enable a reconciliation record, you must click Generate bills again on the Bill Details page to regenerate bills. Bill details and reconciliation amounts are then added.

**Prerequisites**

- You are an operations administrator or resource auditor.

- The reconciliation record is in the To take effect state.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Reconciliation**.

4. Click **Advanced Filter**, configure the **ID**, **Instance ID**, **Instance Name**, **Product**, **Resources**, **Organization**, **Resource Set**, and **Status** parameters, and then click **Search**.

5. Find the reconciliation record that you want to enable and click **Effective** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7ef2c4fa59017c23716ad1b5a55350ec.jpeg)

6. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

   After the reconciliation record is enabled, it changes to the In effect state.

<a id="section-7-2-4-6-4"></a>

##### 7.2.4.6.4. Disable a reconciliation record

You can disable a reconciliation record. After you disable a reconciliation record, you must click Generate bills again on the Bill Details page to regenerate bills. Bill details and reconciliation amounts are then added.

**Prerequisites**

- You are an operations administrator.

- The reconciliation record is in the To take effect or In effect state.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Reconciliation**.

4. Click **Advanced Filter**, configure the **ID**, **Instance ID**, **Instance Name**, **Product**, **Resources**, **Organization**, **Resource Set**, and **Status** parameters, and then click **Search**.

5. Find the reconciliation record that you want to disable and click **Void** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7ef2c4fa59017c23716ad1b5a55350ec.jpeg)

6. In the **Confirm void** message, click **OK**.

   After the reconciliation record is disabled, it changes to the Invalidated state.

#### 7.2.4.7. Bill split management

<a id="section-7-2-4-7-1"></a>

##### 7.2.4.7.1. Create a split rule

This topic describes how to create a split rule to allocate unowned resource sets or shared costs to the correct owner based on the rule.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Split Management**.

4. On the **Bill Split Management** page, click **Create A Rule**.

5. In the **Create Split Rule** dialog box, configure the following parameters.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <th colspan="2">Section and parameter</th>
       <th>Description</th>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="3">Basi c Info rma tion</td>
       <td>Rule Name</td>
       <td>The name for the split rule. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Plan Priorit y</td>
       <td>The priority of the split rule. Valid values: 0 to 99. If you click the input field, the existing priorities are displayed. You cannot enter an existing priority. Bill split rules are matched from the highest priority to the lowest priority.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Effecti ve Time(UTC± HH:M M)</td>
       <td>The effective time of the split rule. Bills within the effective period are split based on the corresponding rules. For historical bills, go to the bill details to update them by regenerating bills.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Rul e Con diti ons</td>
       <td>Condit ions</td>
       <td>The conditions for the split rule. You can configure multiple conditions with the <strong>Or</strong> or <strong>And</strong> combination.<br>• <strong>Add a condition or a condition group</strong>:<br>a. Click <strong>Add Condition</strong> or <strong>Add Group</strong>.<br>b. Configure a specific condition rule in the condition line.<br>• <strong>Delete a condition or a condition group</strong>: Click the<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7fbe79dc2f09b143e5caf17e2f3f088a.png" width="18" alt="">icon on the right<br>side of the condition or condition group.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td></td>
       <td>Cost Alloca tion</td>
       <td>Configure the resource set to which the cost belongs and the allocation proportion. You can configure multiple resource sets for bill splitting at the same time, and the allocation proportions cannot exceed 100% in total.<br>• <strong>Add a resource set</strong>:<br>a. Click <strong>Add Resource Set</strong>.<br>b. Select a resource set from the <strong>Resource Set</strong> drop-down list and set the allocation proportion of each resource set in the <strong>Allocation Proportion</strong> field.<br>• <strong>Delete a resource set</strong>: Click the<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7fbe79dc2f09b143e5caf17e2f3f088a.png" width="18" alt="">icon in the row of a resource set and its<br>allocation proportion.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/40dcc9170bfe01f8be1f47acf815c902.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-4-7-2"></a>

##### 7.2.4.7.2. View the split rule list and the details of a split rule

This topic describes how to view the split rule list and the details of a split rule.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or resource auditor.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Split Management**.

4. On the **Bill Split Management** page, view the created split rules.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can configure the Rule Effective Date and Rule Name parameters to quickly find a specific rule.

5. Click the name of the rule that you want to view. In the **Rule Details** dialog box, view the details of the rule.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/bc381c13f958954f6f2a6e4c1254b524.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-7-3"></a>

##### 7.2.4.7.3. Modify a split rule

This topic describes how to modify a spit rule when the rule changes.

**Prerequisites**

- The split rule is not deprecated.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Split Management**.

4. On the **Bill Split Management** page, find the rule that you want to modify and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can configure the Rule Effective Date and Rule Name parameters to quickly find a specific rule.

5. In the **Modify Split Rule** dialog box, modify the rule configuration. For more information about the rule parameters, see Create a split rule.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b2f07a526da9a9e12261d2a44ade1a0f.jpeg)

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-4-7-4"></a>

##### 7.2.4.7.4. Enable a split rule

This topic describes how to enable a split rule. After split rules are enabled, they are executed in order of priority.

**Prerequisites**

- The split rule is not enabled.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Split Management**.

4. On the **Bill Split Management** page, find the rule that you want to enable and click **Enable** in the **Actions** column.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can configure the Rule Effective Date and Rule Name parameters to quickly find a specific rule.

5. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-4-7-5"></a>

##### 7.2.4.7.5. Discard a split rule

This topic describes how to discard a split rule. After a split rule is discarded, it is no longer used for splitting bills.

**Prerequisites**

- A split rule is enabled.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Split Management**.

4. On the **Bill Split Management** page, find the rule that you want to discard and click **Discard** in the **Actions** column.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can configure the Rule Effective Date and Rule Name parameters to quickly find a specific rule.

5. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-4-7-6"></a>

##### 7.2.4.7.6. Delete a split rule

This topic describes how to delete a discarded split rule. After the split rule is deleted, it is removed from the list.

**Prerequisites**

- A split rule is discarded.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Split Management**.

4. On the **Bill Split Management** page, find the rule that you want to delete and click **Delete** in the **Actions** column.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can configure the Rule Effective Date and Rule Name parameters to quickly find a specific rule.

5. Click **Delete**.

<a id="section-7-2-4-8"></a>

#### 7.2.4.8. Bill audit

You can check and handle metering, billing, and bill generation issues.

<a id="section-7-2-4-8-1"></a>

##### 7.2.4.8.1. View bill audit issues

This topic describes how to view the overview of bill audit issues and details of each bill audit issue on the Bill Audit Issues page.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator or resource auditor.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Audit**.

4. View overview data.

   | Item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Abnormal Bill Days | The number of unique billing dates involving issues in the Pending Review state. |
   | Total Issues | The total number of issues in all states. The states include <strong>Pending Review</strong>, <strong>Processed</strong>, and <strong>Closed</strong>. |
   | Pending | The number of issues in the Pending Review state. |
   | Processed | The number of issues in the Processed state. |

5. Click **Advanced Filter**, configure the **Billing Period**, **Bill Date**, **Issue Type**, **Status**, **Service**, **Resource Item**, and **Detected At** parameters, and then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Valid values of the **Issue Type** parameter: **An error occurred in the bill generation system.** and **An error occurred in the business configurations.**
   >
   > - Before you select a resource item, select a cloud service first.

6. View bill audit issues. The information is displayed in the following columns: **Issue ID**, **Detected At**, **Billing Date**, **Billing Period**, **Service**, **Resource Item**, **Issue Type**, **Status**, **Cause**, and **Suggestion**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/80857ff2b348eb2487ef0d887b59c322.jpeg)

7. Contact on-site O&M engineers to handle the issues based on the suggestions. Alternatively, click **View Details** in the **Actions** column of an issue. In the **Error Message** panel, view the details of the issue and the solution.

   > **Note**
   >
   > In the Error Message panel of an issue, if "The price of the specifications is not specified." is displayed in the Issue column of the Details section, the specifications for which prices are not specified are displayed in the Content column. You can go to the Rule Settings page, find a billing configuration that is effective on the billing date, and then go to its details page. On the details page of the billing configuration, find the service that you want to manage and click Pricing Configuration in the Actions column. In the Price Settings step of the Pricing Configuration panel, set prices for the specifications.
   >
   > ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a7d3115608d9b8118e59d2c71fd52226.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-4-8-2"></a>

##### 7.2.4.8.2. Close a bill audit issue

This topic describes how to close a bill audit issue that does not need to be processed on the Bill Audit Issues page.

**Prerequisites**

- The issue is in the Pending Review state.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Bill Audit**.

4. Click **Advanced Filter**, configure the **Billing Period**, **Bill Date**, **Issue Type**, **Status**, **Service**, **Resource Item**, and **Detected At** parameters, and then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Valid values of the **Issue Type** parameter: **An error occurred in the bill generation system.** and **An error occurred in the business configurations.**
   >
   > - Before you select a resource item, select a cloud service first.

5. View bill audit issues. The information is displayed in the following columns: **Issue ID**, **Detected At**, **Billing Date**, **Billing Period**, **Service**, **Resource Item**, **Issue Type**, **Status**, **Cause**, and **Suggestion**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/80857ff2b348eb2487ef0d887b59c322.jpeg)

6. Find the issue that you want to manage, confirm that the issue does not need to be processed, and then click **Close** in the **Actions** column.

7. In the **Confirm** message, click **Close**. After the issue is closed, the issue changes to the Closed state.

<a id="section-7-2-4-8-3"></a>

##### 7.2.4.8.3. AI analysis of bill audit

The system provides bill audit capabilities based on AI analysis.

**Prerequisites**

- The operations administrator has enabled the display of the intelligent assistant in **Configurations** > **Apsara Copilot** > **Custom Settings**.

- Ensure that you have enabled **Intelligent Operations Expert** on the expert management page of Apsara Copilot.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top menu bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Bills** > **Bill Audit**.

4. Click **Start Audit** above the issue list.

5. View the AI analysis and interpretation for bill audit.

#### 7.2.4.9. Cost center management

<a id="section-7-2-4-9-1"></a>

##### 7.2.4.9.1. Create a cost center

Cost centers are used for settlement. You can create cost centers based on your business requirements.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Cost Centers**.

4. On the Cost Centers page, select the cost center that you want to manage in the **Financial unit settings** section. You can enter the name of a cost center in the search box to quickly find the cost center.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - To create a level-1 cost center, select the root node.
   >
   > - To create a level-2 cost center, select a level-1 cost center. You can create up to five levels of cost centers by using the similar method.

5. On the right side of the page, click **Create a sub-Financial unit**.

6. In the **Create a financial unit** dialog box, specify the name and description of the cost center.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e22afc0f0aa8a15e31ab25acd6783f0d.jpeg)

7. Click **OK**.

   >
   >   centers and click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/abdbc0929dcb43beedffe0b8e57dd647.png" width="14" alt=""> icon to hide its subordinate cost centers.

5. On the right side of the Cost Centers page, click **Edit** in the basic information section.

6. In the **Modify Cost Center** dialog box, modify the name and description of the cost center.

<a id="section-7-2-4-9-4"></a>

##### 7.2.4.9.4. Create an allocation rule

After you create a cost center, you can configure rules based on the actual financial cost structure to reaggregate resource bills. Resources are matched to different cost centers in ascending order in which global rules take effect. A resource belongs to only one cost center. After a bill is generated on the next day, you can view the resource ownership in the bill details.

**Prerequisites**

- A cost center is created.

- You are assigned the operations administrator role.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Cost Centers**.

4. On the Cost Centers page, select the cost center that you want to manage in the **Financial unit settings** section in the left-side pane. Enter the name of a cost center in the search box to quickly find the cost center.

5. On the right side of the Cost Centers page, click the **Rule list** tab. On the Rule list tab, click **Create a rule**.

6. In the **Create allocation rules** dialog box, configure the parameters that are required to create the allocation rule.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <th colspan="2">Section and parameter</th>
       <th>Description</th>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="4">Basic informat ion</td>
       <td>Rule name</td>
       <td>The name of the allocation rule.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Financial unit</td>
       <td>The cost center to which the allocation rule belongs.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Effective order</td>
       <td>The priority value of the allocation rule. A smaller value specifies a higher priority.<br>Select a reference allocation rule from the <strong>Reference location</strong> drop-down list, and then select <strong>Before</strong> or <strong>After</strong> from the <strong>Sequence</strong> drop-down list.<br>If no allocation rule is available, the Effective order parameter is not displayed.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Effective time</td>
       <td>The time range of the bills to which the allocation rule applies.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td colspan="2">Rule conditions</td>
       <td>The conditions based on which the allocation rule is triggered. The allocation rule is triggered only if the conditions are met. For more information, see the Rule conditions section of this topic.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/eb787e24fd2a7a1abc823c53778d0472.jpeg)

7. Click **OK**.

**Rule conditions**

**Items in rule conditions**

| Item | Condition type | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Organization | • Only this organization is included<br>• Organizations and subordinate organizations | In the organization tree, find an organization and click the name of the organization. |
| Resource set | • Equal<br>• Not equal | Select a resource set from the drop-down list. |
| Resource set name | • Equal<br>• Not equal<br>• Include<br>• Not included<br>• Start... | Enter a condition value in the field. |
| Cloud products | • Equal<br>• Not equal | Select a cloud service from the drop-down list. |
| Resource Item | • Equal<br>• Not equal | Select a resource item from the drop-down list. |
| Instance ID | • Equal<br>• Not equal<br>• Include<br>• Not included<br>• Start... | Enter a condition value in the field. |
| Region | • Equal<br>• Not equal | Select a region from the drop-down list. |
| Label | • Contains any one<br>• All | Select one or more tags from the dialog box. |

**Operators**

Conditions are connected by using the **And** or **Or** operator.

- **And**: All conditions must be met.

- **Or**: At least one of the conditions must be met.

A condition group is a set of conditions that need to be met.

**Add or remove a condition or condition group**

At least one condition must be retained in the rule conditions. Up to five levels of rule conditions are supported.

- To add a condition, click **Add condition** in the rule conditions.

- To add a condition group, click **Add condition Group** in the rule conditions.

- To delete a condition, find the condition and click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c5d4cb0af6af097e51c63a22b92e0d91.png" width="13" alt=""> icon that corresponds to the

  condition in the rule conditions.

- To delete a condition group, find the condition group and click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c5d4cb0af6af097e51c63a22b92e0d91.png" width="13" alt=""> icon that corresponds

  to the condition group in the rule conditions.

##### 7.2.4.9.8. Authorize users to access cost centers

You can authorize users to access a cost center based on your business requirements. Then, the users can access and manage the cost center and its subordinate cost centers by using the roles that are granted the permissions to access the Bill Details, Cost Center Bill Overview, and Budgets modules.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Bills** > **Cost Centers**.

4. In the left-side **Financial unit settings** section, select the cost center that you want to manage. You can enter the name of a cost center in the search box to quickly find the cost center.

   > **Note**
   >
   > If a user is authorized to access the root node, the user is authorized to access all cost centers.

5. On the right side of the Cost Centers page, click the **User list** tab.

6. On the **User list** tab, click **Authorized User**.

7. In the **Authorized User** dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Usernam e | The user that you want to authorize. After you enter a keyword in the Username field, select a user from the users displayed in the drop-down list. You can select only one user. |
   | Effective time | The time period during which the selected user is authorized to access the cost center.<br>Note<br>A user can be authorized multiple times to access the same cost center within different time periods. The time periods cannot overlap. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/41761c4c4fe64fe70474977d50afb19c.jpeg)

8. Click **OK**.
