<a id="section-7-2-8-3-4"></a>

##### 7.2.8.3.4. Create a billing configuration

This topic describes how to create a billing configuration on the Billing Rules page.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

When you create a billing configuration, the service list displays the services and specifications that support and use the billing configuration. If additional services and specifications are added later, **Pending Configuration** is displayed in the billing configuration list and on the details pages of billing configurations, which prompts you to complete the billing configuration.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

4. On the **Billing Rules** page, click **Create Billing Configuration**.

5. On the Create Billing Configuration page, configure parameters in the **Basic Information** step, and then click **Next: Billing Configuration**. The following table describes the parameters.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Billing Configuratio n Name | The unique name of the billing configuration. |
   | Effective Time(UTC+0 8:00) | The start and end dates of the validity period of the billing configuration. The effective time is accurate to the date and excludes the specified end date.<br>For example, if you set the start date to August 13, 2024 and the end date to August 15, 2024, the billing configuration takes effect at 00:00:00 on August 13, 2024 and expires after 00:00:00 on August 15, 2024. |
   | Billing Method | The billing method. Valid values: <strong>Pay-as-you-go</strong> and <strong>Subscription</strong>.<br>• <strong>Pay-as-you-go</strong>: Users use services before fees are generated based on the actual amount of used resources. This billing method is suitable for scenarios in which resource usage frequently fluctuates or is difficult to predict. It allows users to flexibly utilize resources based on actual needs, preventing resource waste.<br>• <strong>Subscription</strong>: Users directly subscribe to resources for a fixed period, and the cost is generated based on the subscribed quantity and duration. No additional fees are charged during subsequent usage. This billing method is suitable for scenarios in which resource usage is relatively stable. Users can plan resource usage and estimate resource requirements to prevent the impact on business due to insufficient resources. |
   | Plan Priority | The priority of the billing configuration. Set the value to a unique number.<br>Note<br>A larger number indicates a higher priority. This priority determines the sequence in which billing configurations are displayed. After a billing configuration is created, its display order is adjusted based on its priority. |
   | Applicable Organization s | The organization to which the billing configuration applies. Only level-1 organizations are supported. If you select root, the billing configuration applies to all organizations. |
   | Remarks | The description of the billing configuration. The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/866bd31e0f43c9e0102eee8afa4ca404.jpeg)

6. In the **Billing Configurations** step, configure pricing configurations for services, and then click **Next: Billing Configuration Verification**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > For more information, see Manage pricing configurations.

7. In the **Billing Configuration Verification** step, preview the pricing configurations, and then click **Save**. The following table describes the parameters.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Product | The name of the cloud service. |
   | Product Category | The category to which the cloud service belongs. |
   | Instance Type Configuratio n Ratio | The proportion of cloud service specifications whose prices have been set to a number greater than 0. |
   | Price Verification | Indicates whether the configuration ratio is 100%.<br>Note<br>If the configuration ratio of a service is smaller than 100%, Rejected is displayed. The parameter value is for reference only. You can create the billing configuration even if the configuration ratios of specific services are smaller than 100%. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b9152b3913a7cf6e5e262761f7420053.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-8-3-5"></a>

##### 7.2.8.3.5. View billing configuration

View the system-preset and user-created billing configurations on the rule configuration page.

**Prerequisites**

The operating user defaults to the operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager management console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

4. On the **Billing Rules** page, view existing billing configurations in the list.

5. Click the name of a billing configuration to go to the **Billing Configuration Details** page.

   - **View basic information**

     In the upper part of the page, view the basic information of the billing configuration, including **Configuration Name**, **Effective Scope**, **Billing Method**, **Priority**, **Organization**, **Description**, and more.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/37db0b5fec33b1c8524b9027a9c51679.jpeg)

   - **View billing configuration details**

     In the lower part of the page, view detailed billing configuration information, including **Product**, **Resource**, **Meter Name**, **Billing Cycle**, **Billing Method**, **Pricing Method**, **Billable Item Description**, **Pricing Configuration**, **Unit**, and more.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - Click
     >
     >   in the product column to group and display items by product name,
     >
     >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4814bd893cdd61d0c70c87ea73f39d46.png" width="15" alt="">
     >
     >   sorted according to the product order in the menu.
     >
     > - The resource column displays new specifications:
     >
     >   - The rule may not have been saved.
     >
     >   - Prices may be pending configuration.
     >
     > - The resource column displays inactive status:
     >
     >   - After the user site upgrades to a new version, the new version may add billing support for this product.
     >
     >   - This message appears after creating a third-party product rule template.
     >
     > - To resolve issues with new specifications or inactive status: Update the price via **Pricing Configuration** or **Price Preview**, then save the rule.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/2c018981286c902d6104cf9051aaa448.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-8-3-6"></a>

##### 7.2.8.3.6. Modify the basic information about a billing configuration

This topic describes how to modify the basic information about a billing configuration.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

The billing method in the basic information about a billing configuration cannot be modified.

**Impact of modification**

After you modify a billing configuration, the billing configuration takes effect on the bills generated the next day and does not affect the historical bills. However, if you manually regenerate the bills, the billing configuration affects the historical bills.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

4. Go to the **Billing Configuration Detail** page of a billing configuration.

   - On the **Billing Rules** page, find the billing configuration that you want to modify and click its name.

   - On the **Billing Rules** page, find the billing configuration that you want to modify and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

5. On the **Billing Configuration Detail** page, click **Modify Basic Information** in the upper-right corner.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/956a1c6d230a51b1d27c5ed204c464f8.jpeg)

6. In the **Modify Basic Information** dialog box, update the basic information based on your business requirements.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/056ffe5a2a21f97f5d32f4306f9db8e6.jpeg)

7. Click **Save**.

<a id="section-7-2-8-3-7"></a>

##### 7.2.8.3.7. Manage pricing configurations

You can manage pricing configurations when you create billing configurations or manage existing billing configurations.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

4. Go to the **Pricing Configuration** panel.

   - **When you create a billing configuration**:

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the **Billing Configurations** step of the **Create Billing Configuration** page, select a cloud service from the **Product Details** drop-down list to quickly find the cloud service.

     </li>

     <li>

     Click **Pricing Configuration** in the **Actions** column.

     </li>

     </ol>

   - **When you manage an existing billing configuration**:

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     Find the billing configuration that you want to manage and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

     </li>

     <li>

     On the **Billing Configuration Detail** page, select a cloud service from the **Product Details** drop-down list to quickly find the cloud service.

     </li>

     </ol>

     <ol type="i" start="100">

     <li>

     Click **Pricing Configuration** in the **Actions** column.

     </li>

     </ol>

5. In the Pricing Configuration panel, configure the parameters in the **Billable Item Configuration** and **Price Settings** steps.

   <ol type="i">

   <li>

   In the **Billable Item Configuration** step, configure the billable items and price type of the cloud service and the filter condition type for fine-grained cost management.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Product | The name of the cloud service for which you want to configure the pricing configuration. The current cloud service is selected by default and cannot be changed. |
   | Billing Method | The billing method of the cloud service. The current billing method of the cloud service is selected by default and cannot be changed. |
   | Configure Filtering Condition | The filter condition type. Valid values: <strong>Exact Match</strong> and <strong>Conditional</strong> <strong>Match</strong>. For more information, see the Filter conditions section of this topic. |
   | Metering Table | The metering table associated with the cloud service. |
   | Billing Cycle | The billing cycle of metering table. |
   | Price Type | The type of the unit price that you want to use for the pricing configuration.Valid values: <strong>Monthly Price</strong>, <strong>Daily Price</strong>, and <strong>Hourly Price</strong>. For more information, see the Price types section of this topic. |
   | Billing Item Management | You can modify existing billable items and create or delete billable items based on your business requirements. For more information, see the Billable item management section of this topic. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c8b9ca616f27c6301b0572876b502cc9.jpeg)

   </li>

   <li>

   In the **Price Settings** step, configure the prices of billable items and click **OK**.

   </li>

   </ol>

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If you turn on **Display Only Unpriced Items** in the upper-right corner of the panel, the billable items for which you have not configured prices are automatically displayed.
   >
   > - Click **AllHide** or **AllShow** in the upper-right corner to collapse or expand all priced and unpriced billable items.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/131122b49c284c77531756180dd8bba6.jpeg)

**Billable item configurations**

**Filter conditions**

You can set the Configure Filtering Condition parameter to **Exact Match** or **Conditional Match**.

- **Exact Match**: All metering data is included in the billing and used for bill generation.

- **Conditional Match**: Only metering data that meets the specified filter conditions is included in the billing. The filter condition consists of the **Field** and **Value** parameters. If the value of a field in the metering data is the same as the specified value of the Value parameter, the metering data meets the filter condition.

  > **Note**
  >
  > - To add a filter condition, you can click **Add Filtering Condition**. You can add multiple filter conditions.
  >
  > - You can click **Delete** in the **Actions** column of a filter condition to delete the filter condition. If you set the Configure Filtering Condition parameter to Conditional Match, at least one filter condition must be retained.

  ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ec771ad69da97b29aed55341e743f688.jpeg)

  - If you select **And**, a bill is generated only if the metering data meets all the filter conditions that you specified.

  - If you select **Or**, a bill is generated if the metering data meets at least one of the filter conditions.

**Price types**

> **Important**
>
> - If the decimal cannot be completely divided, the amount after the seventh decimal place is automatically rounded off and not included in the unit price. If the pay-as-you-go billing method is used, bills are generated based on the hourly price. We recommend that you set the price type to hourly price if the pay-as-you-go billing method is used.
>
> - 30 indicates the number of days in a calendar month. You need to replace it with the actual number of days in the current month based on the actual situation.

You can select **Monthly Price**, **Daily Price**, or **Hourly Price** from the Price Type drop-down list.

- If you select **Monthly Price** as the price type, bills are generated for the billable item by month. You can use the following formulas to calculate the hourly price, daily price, and annual price:

  - Hourly price = Monthly price/30/24

  - Daily price = Monthly price/30

  - Annual price = Monthly price × 12

- If you select **Daily Price** as the price type, bills are generated for the billable item on a daily basis. You can use the following formulas to calculate the hourly price, monthly price, and annual price:

  - Hourly price = Daily price/24

  - Monthly price = Daily price × 30

  - Annual price = Monthly price × 12

- If you select **Hourly Price** as the price type, bills are generated for the billable item on an hourly basis. You can use the following formulas to calculate the daily price, monthly price, and annual price:

  - Daily price = Hourly price × 24

  - Monthly price = Daily price × 30

  - Annual price = Monthly price × 12

**Billable item management**

**Billable item**

A billable item defines how to price and charge a type of service. For example, ApsaraDB RDS is charged based on specifications and storage. In this case, the specifications and storage are two billable items. Each billable item defines the billing method and unit price of a type of service.

**Pricing**

The logic for determining the price of a particular feature of a cloud service per unit quantity is categorized into three types: **metered pricing**, **fixed pricing**, and **tiered pricing**.

- **Metered pricing**: You are charged based on the service specifications and attribute values.

  For example, Elastic Compute Service (ECS) provides a variety of instance types at different prices. Metering fields and values can be found in the metering data. The billing module obtains the values of specific metering fields from the metering data to determine the unit price of an instance.

  In addition, prices of specific services are not determined based only on specifications, and prices of instances with the same specifications may vary based on their regions. Therefore, in metered pricing mode, multiple metering fields are required for pricing.

- **Fixed pricing**: You are charged at a fixed rate that does not change with variables within a unit quantity.

  For example, you are charged for the storage capability based only on the amount of data because the storage capability does not involve specifications. In this case, the unit price is fixed.

- **Tiered pricing**: You are charged different prices based on the service usage. You can customize one or more usage ranges and specify a price for each range. If you configure tiered unit prices for a service capability, only metered quantities are supported.

**Quantity settings**

A quantity indicates the usage or a declared number of a resource. The following quantity types are supported:

- **Fixed quantity**: The number of instances is fixed in each metered data record.

  For example, you are charged for ECS instances based on specifications, and each metered data record is generated for one instance. In this case, the instance quantity is fixed to 1.

- **Metered quantity**: The billing module uses the value of a specific numeric field in the metered data as the quantity for billing.

  For example, the value of the Storage field in the metering data for Object Storage Service (OSS) indicates the storage usage. If you want to charge users for OSS based on the storage usage, you can configure the Storage field as the quantity.

  The unit used to measure metering data may not be the same as that used to determine the price. For example, OSS is billed per GB. However, the unit of the Storage field in the metering data may be Byte. Therefore, when you define a quantity, you need to specify a conversion factor to convert the value of a specific parameter in the metering data to a value in the unit of the price. For example, 1 GB is equal to 1,073,741,824 bytes. In this case, you need to set the conversion factor to 1073741824.

**Manage billable items**

1. In the Billable Item Configuration step of the **Pricing Configuration** panel, click **Create Billable Item** in the **Billing Item Management** section.

2. In the **Create Billable Item** dialog box, configure the billable item.

   | Parameter | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Billable Item Name | The name of the billable item. |
   | Billing Method | The billing method of the billable item. By default, the billing method is the same as that in the billing configuration. |
   | Unit Price Settings | The pricing model. Valid values: <strong>Quantity-based Price</strong>, <strong>Fixed Price</strong>, and <strong>Stepwise Pricing</strong>.<br>• If you select <strong>Quantity-based Price</strong>, you must configure the primary price of the cloud service and upload a pricing file. If secondary prices are supported for the cloud service, you can also add one or more secondary prices for the cloud service. To upload a pricing file, download a pricing template, specify the unit price in the pricing template, and then click Upload Price File to upload the pricing file.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/fc6578aacf87c99714fccbc1429148b7.jpeg)<br>• If you select <strong>Fixed Price</strong>, enter a fixed price.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/343f5a64c41fba2ac8d7194335d13655.jpeg)<br>• If you select <strong>Stepwise Pricing</strong>, configure the <strong>Match Mode</strong> and <strong>Stepwise</strong> <strong>Pricing Configuration</strong> parameters.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5a586a39e7f5b774bdf7d976ab6dd959.jpeg)<br>• <strong>Match Mode</strong>: Select <strong>Graduated Pricing</strong> or <strong>Volume-based Pricing</strong>.<br>Note<br>You can specify pricing factors, such as primary and secondary prices.If you select a pricing factor, the <strong>Specified Price</strong> column is not displayed in the <strong>Stepwise Pricing Configuration</strong> table. Instead, the <strong>Download detailed pricing Template</strong> button is displayed. You must upload a pricing file.<br>• <strong>Graduated Pricing</strong>: The total cost is calculated by applying the unit price of the tier corresponding to the total usage<br>Example: The unit price is USD 0.2 if the total used disk space falls into the 0 to 40 GB tier and USD 0.1 if the total used disk space exceeds 40 GB. In this case, if 50 GB of disk space is used, the fee is calculated based on the following formula: 50 × 0.1 = 5.<br>• <strong>Volume-based Pricing</strong>: The total cost is calculated by applying the corresponding unit price to the usage within each tier and summing the results.<br>Example: The unit price is USD 0 if the used disk space falls into the 0 to 40 GB tier and USD 0.1 if the total used disk space exceeds 40 GB. In this case, if 50 GB of disk space is used, the fee is calculated based on the following formula: 40 × 0 + (50 - 40) × 0.1 = 1.<br>• <strong>Stepwise Pricing Configuration</strong>: Specify a tier and a price for the tier.<br>Note<br>• You can click <strong>Add Interval</strong> to add more tiers and prices.<br>• You can click <strong>Delete</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column to delete the tier and price.<br>• You can click <strong>Upload Price File</strong> to upload a pricing file. To upload a pricing file, download a pricing template, specify the prices in the pricing template, and then click Upload Price File to upload the pricing file. |

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Quantity Settings</td>
       <td>A quantity indicates the usage or a declared number of a resource. Quantities are classified into fixed quantity and metered quantity.<br>• If the <strong>Quantity Type</strong> parameter is set to <strong>Quantity</strong>, the value of the <strong>Quantity</strong> parameter is set to a specification field used for metering.<br>If you select <strong>Stepwise Pricing</strong> in the <strong>Unit Price Settings</strong> section, you can set the <strong>Quantity Type</strong> parameter only to <strong>Quantity</strong>, and only one entry can be configured in the Quantity Settings section.<br>• If the <strong>Quantity Type</strong> parameter is set to <strong>Fixed Quantity</strong>, the value of the <strong>Quantity</strong> parameter can be set to a custom value.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/755f40b78bd309988282eac1d9a60743.jpeg" alt=""><br>Note<br>• You can click <strong>Add Quantity Settings</strong> to configure multiple entries.<br>• You can click <strong>Delete</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of an entry to delete the entry. At least one entry must be retained.</td>

<a id="section-7-2-8-3-8"></a>

##### 7.2.8.3.8. Add a rule

This topic describes how to add a rule in the billing configuration details.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

4. Find the billing configuration that you want to manage and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

5. On the **Billing Configuration Detail** page, click **Add Rule**.

6. In the **Pricing Configuration** panel, configure **Billable Item Configuration** and **Price Settings**. For more information about the parameters, see Manage pricing configurations.

   > **Note**
   >
   > After the rule is added, you can enable the rule template in the rule template configuration. After the rule template is enabled, you can use the rule template in the billing rule configuration.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d4524c82e7cd74661b9928e3afab43f2.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-8-3-9"></a>

##### 7.2.8.3.9. Configure multiple pricing configurations at a time

You can download a pricing template, configure unit prices of cloud services in the pricing template, and then upload the pricing template to configure multiple pricing configurations at a time.

**Prerequisites**

- A billing configuration is disabled.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

4. Go to the **Billing Configuration Detail** page of a billing configuration.

   - On the **Billing Rules** page, find the billing configuration that you want to manage and click its name.

   - On the **Billing Rules** page, find the billing configuration that you want to manage and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

5. On the **Billing Configuration Detail** page, click **Download Pricing Template** above the list to download the pricing template to your computer.

6. In the pricing template, configure the unit prices of cloud services.

   > **Important**
   >
   > - The Primary pricing factor and Secondary pricing factor fields in the pricing template cannot be modified.
   >
   > - By default, the value of the Unit Price field in the pricing template is the price of one primary pricing factor. This field supports up to six decimal places. If an item is free of charge, set it to 0.
   >
   > - To change the pricing factors, you need to modify the corresponding billable items.

7. Click **Batch Upload Pricing Configuration** above the service details list.

8. In the **Upload files** dialog box, click the dotted rectangle and select the template file that you configured. Alternatively, drag the template file to the dotted rectangle.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f0c3561192e74a108285bc5821aa65db.jpeg)

9. Click **Upload**.

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

   > **Note**

<a id="section-7-2-8-3-12"></a>

##### 7.2.8.3.12. Disable a billing configuration

You can disable an enabled billing configuration.

**Prerequisites**

- The billing configuration is in the enabled status.

- The default operator is the operations administrator.

**Limits**

You cannot disable a preset pay-as-you-go billing configuration.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

4. Go to the **Billing Configuration Detail** page.

   - On the **Billing Rules** page, click the name of the target billing configuration.

   - On the **Billing Rules** page, click **Edit** in the **Actions** column of the target billing configuration.

5. In the upper-right corner of the **Billing Configuration Detail** page, click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3f5669baa43f25642dd95c13f8703fe0.png" width="38" alt=""> next to

   **Enable Configuration**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > To disable the last subscription billing configuration:
   >
   > - If published subscription services exist, unpublish the services or change the billing method before you disable the configuration.
   >
   > - If you disable the scubscription billing configuration while running subscription service instances exist, unexpired subscription resources automatically transitions to pay-as-you-go billing upon expiration.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/571d374c9d099eb4f2f6c70b1c1da56b.jpeg)

6. In the **Disable configuration** dialog box, click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-8-3-13"></a>

##### 7.2.8.3.13. Export a price list

You can export the price list of a billing configuration if you want to save the pricing configurations of cloud services to your computer. This topic describes how to export a price list.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

4. Go to the **Billing Configuration Detail** page of a billing configuration.

   - On the **Billing Rules** page, find the billing configuration for which you want to export a price list and click its name.

   - On the **Billing Rules** page, find the billing configuration for which you want to export a price list and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

5. On the **Billing Configuration Detail** page, click **Export Price List** above the service details list.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - The price list of a billing configuration is exported as an **XLS** file.
   >
   > - The price list file contains the organization, export time, start and end time of the billing configuration, and pricing configurations of each service. The pricing configurations include the service type, service name, billing method, pricing method, billable item description, billing field, specifications, prices, counting method, counting field, unit, and conversion factor.

You can clone an existing billing configuration to create a similar billing configuration.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Billing Rules**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/909c61d271c21c5e42801a5cdd8d23f1.jpeg)

5. On the **Clone Billing Configuration** page, modify the parameters of the billing configuration. For more information about the parameters, see Create a billing configuration.

**Create a discount rule**

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/af3af8c578e4fad0d2df7264fc10945b.jpeg)

**Edit a discount rule**

1. On the **Discount Management** page, find the discount rule and click **Edit** in the **Actions** column.

2. In the **Edit Discount Rule** panel, modify the settings of the discount rule. For more information about the configuration items, see Create a discount rule.

**Enable a discount rule**

1. On the **Discount Management** page, find the discount rule and click **Enable** in the **Actions** column.

2. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Disable a discount rule**

> **Important**
>
> A discount rule will not be used in cost calculations after it is disabled.

1. On the **Discount Management** page, find the discount rule and click **Enable** in the **Actions** column.

2. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Delete a discount rule**

1. On the **Discount Management** page, find the discount rule and click **Enable** in the **Actions** column.

2. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Revoke a discount rule**

1. On the **Discount Management** page, find the discount rule, click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/56d28547cc47188087e3d092339dc4c5.png" width="17" alt=""> in the **Actions**

   column, and select **Revoke**.

2. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**View the approval details of a discount rule**

> **Important**
>
> Only after approval is enabled, you can view the approval details of the discount rules in the Being Approved or Approval Rejected state. For more information about how to create an approval process and how to bind an approval process to an operation, see Process approval.

1. On the **Discount Management** page, find the discount rule, click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/56d28547cc47188087e3d092339dc4c5.png" width="17" alt=""> in the **Actions**

   column, and select **Approval Details**.

2. On the Approval Details page, view the approval details of the discount rule.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/553631dbac686061301a47b13707346d.jpeg)

##### 7.2.8.4.1. Create a discount rule

This topic describes how to create a discount rule on the Discounts page.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Discounts**.

4. On the **Discounts** page, click **Create a discount rule**.

5. In the **Create a discount rule** panel, configure parameters in the **Basic configuration** and **Discount configuration** steps.

   <ol type="i">

   <li>

   **Basic configuration**

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8a10064f437977877e72acebc2a42bd0.jpeg)

   <table>
     <tr>
       <th colspan="2">Parameter</th>
       <th>Description</th>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="2">Basic Information</td>
       <td>Rule name</td>
       <td>The name of the discount rule. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start or end with a space.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Description</td>
       <td>The description of the discount rule.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="4">Rule configurati on</td>
       <td>Effective scope</td>
       <td>The organizations for which the discount rule takes effect. Valid values: <strong>Global scope</strong> and <strong>Specify organization</strong>.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Specify organizatio n</td>
       <td>This parameter is displayed only if the <strong>Effective scope</strong> parameter is set to <strong>Specify organization</strong>.<br>Select one or more organizations from the drop-down list.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Effective time(UTC± HH:MM)</td>
       <td>The time when the discount rule takes effect.<br>The effective time refers to the time when the server is deployed. The time zone varies based on the deployment location.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Priority</td>
       <td>The priority of the discount rule. Valid values: 0 to 99. Click the text box to display the existing priority values.<br>Note<br>The priority must be unique.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   </li>

   <li>

   **Discount configuration**

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/fd9c2eb588975df04bf8af7ad369710d.jpeg)

   | Paramete r | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Cloud Platform | This parameter is displayed only in multi-cloud environments. Select a cloud platform and a region. |
   | Discount settings | You can select <strong>Unified discount</strong> or <strong>Specified product</strong>.<br>• <strong>Unified discount</strong>: By default, the unified discount is applied to all services.Enter a positive integer that is smaller than or equal to 1000 in the test box.Unit: %.<br>• <strong>Specified product</strong>: You do not need to enter a unified discount. You must enter a positive integer that is smaller than or equal to 1000 in the Discount column for each service. Unit: %.<br>Note<br>If a service is added to the cloud platform, the service is added to the discount rule with the 100% discount by default. |

   </li>

   </ol>

6. Click **Submit**.

#### 7.2.8.5. Deduction management

You can deduct billable usage and fees for resources based on your business requirements.

<a id="section-7-2-8-5-1"></a>

##### 7.2.8.5.1. Create a deduction rule

This topic describes how to create a deduction rule on the Deductions page.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Deductions**.

4. On the Deductions page, click **Create Deduction Rule**.

5. In the **Create Deduction Rule** panel, configure the parameters in the Basic Configurations step. The following table describes the parameters.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <th colspan="2">Parameter</th>
       <th>Description</th>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="2">Basic Informati on</td>
       <td>Rule Name</td>
       <td>The name of the deduction rule.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Descripti on</td>
       <td>The description of the deduction rule.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="4">Rule Configur ation</td>
       <td>Effective Scope</td>
       <td>The effective scope of the deduction rule. Valid values: <strong>Global</strong>, <strong>Specified Organization</strong>, and <strong>Specified Resource Set</strong>.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Specified Organizat ion</td>
       <td>This parameter is displayed only if the <strong>Effective Scope</strong> parameter is set to <strong>Specified Organization</strong>.<br>You can select one or more organizations from the drop-down list.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Resource Set</td>
       <td>This parameter is displayed only if the <strong>Effective Scope</strong> parameter is set to <strong>Specified Resource Set</strong>.<br>You can select one or more resource sets from the drop-down list.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Effective At</td>
       <td>The start and end time of the validity period of the deduction rule.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/917969501c7ec3c2d91aa9d8d2cdc00f.jpeg)

6. Click **Next**.

7. In the Deduction Configuration step, click **Add Deduction Rule**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can add multiple deduction rules.
   >
   > - After a deduction rule is added, you can click **Edit** or **Delete** in the **Actions** column to modify or delete the deduction rule.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ee840b5d01cbc7ced8c1d4f41c267624.jpeg)

8. In the **Add Deduction Rule** dialog box, configure the parameters that are described in the following table.

   | Paramete r | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Deducte d Services | The cloud service and resource item to which the deduction rule applies. You need to select a cloud service first before you can select a resource item. |

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Deductio n Scope</td>
       <td>The effective scope of the deduction rule. Valid values: <strong>All</strong>, <strong>By Instance</strong>, and <strong>By</strong> <strong>Condition</strong>.<br>• If you set the <strong>Deduction Scope</strong> parameter to <strong>By Instance</strong>, you must enter one or more instance IDs in the <strong>Instance ID</strong> field. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,) or line feeds.<br>• If you set the <strong>Deduction Scope</strong> parameter to <strong>By Condition</strong>, you must specify the filter condition. The deduction rule takes effect only if the specified filter condition is met. A filter condition consists of the <strong>Field</strong> and <strong>Value</strong> parameters. If the value of a field in the metering data is the same as the specified value of the Value parameter, the metering data meets the filter condition.<br>Note<br>• You can click <strong>Add Filter Condition</strong> to add a filter condition. You can add multiple filter conditions.<br>• You can click <strong>Delete</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of a filter condition to delete the filter condition. If you set the Deduction Scope parameter to <strong>By Condition</strong>, at least one filter condition must be retained.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/24177a684ce94d2494966bc675c6bed5.jpeg" alt=""><br>• If you select <strong>And</strong>, the deduction rule takes effect only if all the specified filter conditions are met.<br>• If you select <strong>Or</strong>, the deduction rule takes effect if one of the specified filter conditions is met.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Deductio n Content</td>
       <td>The billable items to which the deduction rule applies. Valid values: <strong>All</strong> or <strong>By Billable</strong> <strong>Item</strong>.<br>If you set the Deduction Content parameter to <strong>By Billable Item</strong>, you must configure the <strong>Metering Table</strong> and <strong>Billable Item</strong> parameters and enter a specific deduction amount in the <strong>Deduction Amount</strong> field.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Effective Period</td>
       <td>The validity period of the deduction rule. Valid values: <strong>Effective Period of Current</strong> <strong>Rule</strong> and <strong>Since Instance Creation</strong>. You can select Since Instance Creation only for specific services.<br>If you select <strong>Since Instance Creation</strong>, you must configure the <strong>Duration</strong> parameter to specify the validity period of the deduction rule. Unit: day or month.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8ff209aea912d2128d698d5e66fe6446.jpeg)

9. Click **OK**.

0. Click **Submit**.

This topic describes how to delete a deduction rule.

**Prerequisites**

- The deduction rule is in the **Disable**, **Disable (Enable-Rejected)**, or **Disable (Enable Failed)** state.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Deductions**.

4. On the **Deductions** page, find the deduction rule that you want to delete, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/7a48e924cf94e88ea38aed8615ff49a4.png" width="24" alt=""> icon

   in the **Actions** column, and then select **Delete**.

5. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-8-6"></a>

#### 7.2.8.6. Rule template configuration

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-1"></a>

##### 7.2.8.6.1. Billing rule templates

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-1-1"></a>

###### 7.2.8.6.1.1. Create a billing rule template

You can create billing rule templates based on your business requirements. This topic describes how to create a billing rule template.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Rule Template Configuration**.

4. Optional. Configure the **Cloud Services**, **Resource Item**, and **Status** parameters and click **Search** to filter billing rule templates.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The following options are available in the **Status** drop-down list: **Not Configured**, **Configured**, **Delete Service**, and **Unpublish Service**.

5. Find and click the resource card that you require to go to the **Rule Template** page.

6. On the **Billing Rule Template** tab, click **Create Rule**.

7. Configure the parameters in the **Basic Information**, **Rule Settings**, and **Price Query Settings** steps as prompted.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The Price Query Settings step is displayed only for third-party custom cloud services. After price query settings are configured for a cloud service, prices can be displayed on the activation, configuration change, purchase, and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) and pricing (price calculator, configuration list, and service pricing) pages of the service.

**Basic Information**

In the **Basic Information** step, configure the metering table, billing cycle, and billing field settings of the billing rule template.

| Paramet er | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Meteri ng Table | The metering table to be associated with the billing rule template. Select a metering table from the Metering Table drop-down list. |
| Billing Cycle | The billing cycle for the selected metering table. |
| Billing Field Setting s | • Click <strong>Add Field</strong>. Configure the parameters, including Billing Field, Field Type, Usage Unit for Billing, and Conversion Factor.<br>Note<br>The system automatically configures the fields of the Specifications type with data of the configured service specifications.<br>• Find the billing field that you want to remove and click <strong>Remove</strong> in the Actions column to remove the billing field. |

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5b83842504c8e492ae3a6529dab7352a.jpeg)

**Rule Settings**

You need to add billing rules, including the billable item configuration and price settings.

1. In the **Rule Settings** step, click **Create Billing Rule**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b1324dae735ac30eafe9c3b33ac53573.jpeg)

2. In the **Pricing Template Configuration** panel, configure the parameters in the **Billable Item Configuration** and **Price Settings** steps. For more information about billable item configuration and pricing settings, see Manage pricing configurations.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/792afeea8a8ef92adb8211a7382f8f39.jpeg)

**Price Query Settings**

In the **Price Query Settings** step, configure price query settings. You can select Field Mapping Configuration or Code Configuration.

**Field Mapping Configuration**

You can complete price query settings by configuring field mapping.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Required Fields for Price Query by Using Form | From the <strong>Form Fields</strong> drop-down list, select the fields for price query by using a form.The organizationId and regionId fields are required.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d6ca315f1f2bcd2fa1710d0382fa0589.jpeg) |

<table>
  <tr>
    <td>Billing Field Mapping Configurat ion</td>
    <td>Configure the mapping between billing fields and form fields. You can add or remove fields.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e21286ff84af29bf39dac0d58bec154c.jpeg" alt=""><br>If you select <strong>No Mapped Form Field</strong> in the <strong>Form Fields</strong> column, you can select <strong>Integer</strong>, <strong>Boolean Value</strong>, <strong>String</strong>, or <strong>Empty</strong> in the <strong>Default Value</strong> column.<br>• Set <strong>Billing Field</strong> to a fixed value. The value can be a Boolean value, a numeric value, or a character.<br>• If <strong>Empty</strong> is selected in the <strong>Default Value</strong> column, the value of the configured billing field is calculated based on the extended rule. The system saves the form fields in the context. Groovy expressions are supported.<br>• <strong>Scenario 1: Unit conversion</strong>.<br>The billing rule charges for the systemDisk field. The unit in the context is GB.However, the billing rule charges for this field based on the unit of MB. Therefore, you need to configure the following expression in the corresponding extended rule: <code> systemDisk × 1024 </code>.<br>Note<br>• Other unit conversions follow the same principle.<br>• To perform quantity operations, you must first confirm the field types in the context. Only fields of the integer type can be used for quantity operations. If a field is not of the integer type, you must first convert the field type by using relevant Groovy syntax.<br>• <strong>Scenario 2: String processing</strong>.<br>The billing rule charges for the <code> spec </code> field. The value of the <code> spec </code> field in the context is small. However, all enumerated fields configured for the <code> spec </code> field in the billing rule contain the ecs prefix. For example, the price of the ecs-small specification is 2. In this case, to concatenate the ecs string for the <code> spec </code> field, you need to configure <code> "ecs-" + spec </code> in the extended rule.<br>• Scenario 3: Context field computing<br>The billing rule charges for the total disk size. The total disk size is calculated based on the <code> systemDisk, dataDisk, and dataNum </code> fields. Total disk size = System disk size + Data disk size × Number of data disks. Configure <code> systemDisk + dataDisk × dataNum </code> in the extended rule.</td>
  </tr>
</table>

<table>
  <tr>
    <td>Instance Informatio n Mapping</td>
    <td>Instance information mapping must be configured only in the configuration change, unsubscription, or renewal scenarios. This way, you can query the billing amount from the instance details.<br>• In the configuration change scenario, instance information mappings are first used to query the price before the change, and then used to calculate the price difference before and after the configuration change.<br>• In the unsubscription or renewal scenario, instance information mappings are used to query the monthly price of the instance, and then calculate the refund amount of the unsubscription or the renewal fee.<br>To configure the instance information mapping, you must query the instance to obtain the instance details. Then, enter the details field as the configuration input. For more information about how to obtain the instance details, see Configure price query settings.<br><img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/1dfe4bced069b8ffdb9cf0c43463586c.jpeg" alt=""></td>
  </tr>
</table>

**Code Configuration**

In the code editor, you can write code for price query settings. The code configuration method provides a more customized and comprehensive price query capability and allows you to configure mappings by using code. The price query settings are used to convert the parameters in forms or instance details into the corresponding billing field data and obtain a price based on billing rules. Therefore, to write the code for price query settings, you must parse the data in forms or instance details. For more information about code configuration, see Configure price query settings.

The following code provides an example on how to configure price query settings for a new purchase:

```json
{
  "product": "ECS",
  "resourceType": "ecs_instance",
  "priceQueryForNew": {
    "priceQueryRequiredFields": [
      "Department",
      "RegionId",
      "Amount",
      "InstanceType",
      "SystemDisk",
      "_imageType"
    ],
    "priceQueryRequiredFieldsAny": [
      [
        "ImageId"
      ],
      [
        "customImage"
      ],
      [
        "shareImage"
      ],
      [
        "publicImage"
      ]
    ],
    "priceQueryAgainForValueChangedFields": [
      "Department",
      "RegionId",
      "Amount",
      "InstanceType",
      "SystemDisk",
      "DataDisk",
      "_imageType",
      "ImageId",
      "customImage",
      "shareImage",
      "publicImage"
    ],
    "priceQueryProducts": [
      {
        "product": "ECS",
        "billingFields": [
          {
            "key": "InstanceType",
            "valueExpression": "InstanceType"
          },
          {
            "key": "GPUSpec",
            "valueExpression": "GPUSpec",
            "defaultValue": "ASCM_SPEC_EMPTY"
          },
          {
            "key": "GPUAmount",
            "valueExpression": "GPUAmount",
            "defaultValue": 0
          },
          {
            "key": "OSType",
            "valueExpression": "Images.Image[0].OSType",
            "valueExpressionType": "GROOVY_EXPRESSION"
          },
          {
            "key": "OSNameEn",
            "valueExpression": "Images.Image[0].OSNameEn",
            "valueExpressionType": "GROOVY_EXPRESSION"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "comment": "For a new purchase of an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance, the system disk is required, and data disks are optional.",
        "product": "EBS",
        "billingFieldExpression": "def SystemDiskNew = [\n    \"DiskCategory\": 
SystemDisk.Category,\n    \"DiskSize\": SystemDisk.Size\n]\n\n\ndef DataDiskList = []\n
\ndef binding = getBinding()\nif (binding.variables.containsKey(\"DataDisk\")) {\n    DataDiskList = DataDisk ?: []\n}\n\ndef DataDiskListNew = []\nif (DataDiskList) {\n    DataDiskList.each { disk ->\n        def num = disk.Num\n        if (num > 0) {\n        
(1..num).each {\n                DataDiskListNew << [\n                    
\"DiskCategory\": disk.Category,\n                    \"DiskSize\": disk.Size\n         
]\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ndef result = [SystemDiskNew] + 
DataDiskListNew\n\nreturn result"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-1-2"></a>

###### 7.2.8.6.1.2. View the details of a billing rule template

This topic describes how to view the details of a billing rule template.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Rule Template Configuration**.

4. Optional. Specify **Cloud Services**, **Resource Item**, and **Status** and click **Search** to filter rule templates.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The following options are available in the **Status** drop-down list: **Not Configured**, **Configured**, **Delete Service**, and **Unpublish Service**.

5. Click a resource card to go to the **Rule Template** page.

6. On the **Billing Rule Template** tab, view the billing rule templates of the service.

7. Find the billing rule template that you want to view, and click **Details** in the Actions column.

8. On the **Rule Template Details** page, view the detailed configurations.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b291395e70edfcd75f1bdd54d5bdb3b9.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-1-3"></a>

###### 7.2.8.6.1.3. Modify a billing rule template

You can modify the settings of a billing rule template based on your business requirements.

**Prerequisites**

- Billing rule templates are in the **Disable** state.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

Preset billing rule templates cannot be modified.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Rule Template Configuration**.

4. Optional. Configure the **Cloud Services**, **Resource Item**, and **Status** parameters as filter conditions and click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Valid values of the **Status** parameter: **Not Configured**, **Configured**, **Delete Service**, and **Unpublish Service**.

5. Find and click the card for the resource type that you want to manage to go to the **Rule Template** page.

6. On the **Billing Rule Template** tab, find the template that you want to modify and click **Modify** in the Actions column.

7. On the **Modify Rule Template** page, modify the settings of the billing rule template. For more information about the parameters, see Create a billing rule template.

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-1-4"></a>

###### 7.2.8.6.1.4. Enable a billing rule template

You can enable a disabled billing rule template. After a billing rule template is enabled, you can use it for billing rule configuration.

**Prerequisites**

- Billing rule templates are in the **Disable** state.

- Metering tables associated with billing rule templates are in the **Enable** state.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

- You can enable only one custom billing rule template for the billing rule configuration of a single resource type.

- If both an enabled custom billing rule template and a preset billing rule template are used for the billing rule configuration of a single resource type, the custom billing rule template takes precedence over the preset billing rule template.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Rule Template Configuration**.

4. Optional. Configure the **Cloud Services**, **Resource Item**, and **Status** parameters as filter conditions and click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Valid values of the **Status** parameter: **Not Configured**, **Configured**, **Delete Service**, and **Unpublish Service**.

5. Find and click the card for the resource type that you want to manage to go to the **Rule Template** page.

6. On the **Billing Rule Template** tab, find the template that you want to enable and click **Enable** in the Actions column.

7. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-1-5"></a>

###### 7.2.8.6.1.5. Disable a billing rule template

You can disable an enabled billing rule template. After a billing rule template is disabled, you can no longer use it for billing rule configuration.

**Prerequisites**

- Billing rule templates are in the **Enable** state.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

Preset billing rule templates cannot be disabled.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Rule Template Configuration**.

4. Optional. Configure the **Cloud Services**, **Resource Item**, and **Status** parameters as filter conditions and click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Valid values of the **Status** parameter: **Not Configured**, **Configured**, **Delete Service**, and **Unpublish Service**.

5. Find and click the card for the resource type that you want to manage to go to the **Rule Template** page.

6. On the **Billing Rule Template** tab, find the template that you want to disable and click **Disable** in the Actions column.

7. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-1-6"></a>

###### 7.2.8.6.1.6. Configure price query settings

This topic describes how to configure price query settings in billing rule templates.

**Field mapping configurations**

**Instance information mappings**

The configuration of instance information mappings is required only in scenarios that involve configuration changes, unsubscription, or renewal. Instance information mappings can be used to query the corresponding billing amount from instance details.

- In a configuration change scenario, instance information mappings are first used to query the price before the change, and then used to calculate the price difference before and after the configuration change.

- In an unsubscription or renewal scenario, instance information mappings are first used to query the monthly subscription price of an instance, and then used to calculate the refund for the unsubscription or the fee for the renewal.

**Obtaining of instance details**

Unlike directly obtaining form fields from an frontend page as the input, the configuration of instance information mappings requires querying the relevant instance to retrieve instance details, and then using the instance details fields as the input.

The system calls the  `CloudSearchResources`  operation to query instance details, and places the instance details fields into the context. When you configure instance information mappings in the console, specify the instance details fields in the Instance Field column.

For example, the following response is returned if the system calls the CloudSearchResources operation to query a third-party cloud service instance:

```json

    "total" : 1,
    "pageSize" : 10,

      "product" : "custom-klmtest",
      "supportTag" : false,
      "organizationName" : "ascmTest",

d01\",\"resourceSetId\":2,\"spec\":\"small\",\"systemDisk\":10,\"dataDisk\":15,\"dataNum\
2,\"instanceUrl\":\"https://one.console.con.shuguang.com/test/console/instance/detail/inf
InstanceId=31313123313\"}",
```

The following code shows the fields in the returned  `detail`  parameter after JSON serialization. These fields are the instance details fields that you can specify in the Instance Field column when you configure instance information mappings in the console. In this example, instance details fields include  `organizationId, instanceId, regionId, resourceSetId, spec, systemDisk, dataDisk, dataNum, and instanceUrl` . If additional operations are required on the details data, the operations can be configured in extension rules.

```json
{
 "organizationId": "3",
 "instanceId": "31313123313",
 "regionId": "cn-wulan-env***-d01",
 "resourceSetId": 2,
 "spec": "small",
 "systemDisk": 10,
 "dataDisk": 15,
 "dataNum": 2,
 "instanceUrl": 
"https://one.console.con.shuguang.com/test/console/instance/detail/info?
InstanceId=31313123313"
}
```

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4842fb0dce3fcb429ae0a9ed1f7379b2.jpeg)

**Extension rules**

Extension rules support Groovy expressions. The context variables of Groovy expressions can be form fields or instance details fields. When the data source for a price query is a form on a frontend page, such as billing field mappings for a new purchase or configuration change, the Groovy expression context includes all form fields. When the data source for a price query is instance details, such as instance information mappings for a configuration change, unsubscription, or renewal, the Groovy expression context consists of instance details fields.

For example, the context variables include the following fields:

```json
{
  "organizationId": "3",
  "instanceId": "31313123313",
  "regionId": "cn-wulan-env***-d01",
  "resourceSetId": 2,
  "spec": "small",
  "systemDisk": 10,
  "dataDisk": 15,
  "dataNum": 2,
  "instanceUrl": 
"https://one.console.con.shuguang.com/test/console/instance/detail/info?
InstanceId=31313123313"
}
```

- **Scenario 1: Unit conversion**

  A billing rule involves charges for the systemDisk field. The unit in the context is GB, but the billing rule requires charging based on the unit of MB. Therefore, the following expression is configured in the corresponding extension rule:  `systemDisk * 1024` .

  > **Note**
  >
  > - Other unit conversions follow the same principle.
  >
  > - To perform quantity operations, you must first confirm the field types in the context. Only integers can be used for quantity operations. If a field is not of an integer type, you must first convert the field type by using relevant Groovy syntax.

- **Scenario 2: String processing**

  A billing rule involves charges for the  `spec`  field. The value of the  `spec`  field in the context is small. However, all enumeration fields configured for  `spec`  in the billing rule include the ecs prefix. For example, the price for the ecs-small specification is 2. In this case, to concatenate the ecs string for  `spec` , the following expression is configured in the corresponding extension rule:  `"ecs-" + spec` .

- **Scenario 3: Context field calculation**

  A billing rule involves charges for the total disk size, which requires the combination of the  `systemDisk, dataDisk, and dataNum`  fields for billing. The total disk size is calculated by using the following formula: Total disk size = System disk size + Data disk size × Number of data disks. Therefore, the following expression is configured in the corresponding extension rule:  `systemDisk + dataDisk * dataNum` .

**Code configurations**

Code configurations offer more customizable and comprehensive price query capabilities, allowing you to configure mappings by using pure code.

The essence of price query settings is to convert fields from forms or instance details into corresponding billing field data, which is then used by billing rules to obtain a price. Therefore, price query settings require the parsing of form data or instance details data.

**New purchases**

**Obtaining of form fields for new purchases**

On the new purchase page of a cloud platform, specify the form fields and click Add Configuration Quotation. The form fields for new purchases are then parsed from the  `params`  input parameter of the  `AddTradeCart`  request from Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) and serialized into the JSON format. ```json

```json
  "product": "ECS",

  "priceQueryForNew": {
    "priceQueryRequiredFields": [
      "Department",

        "ImageId"
      ],

        "customImage"
      ],

        "shareImage"
      ],
      [
        "publicImage"
      ]
    ],
    "priceQueryAgainForValueChangedFields": [
      "Department",
      "RegionId",
      "Amount",
      "InstanceType",
      "SystemDisk",
      "DataDisk",
      "_imageType",
      "ImageId",
      "customImage",
      "shareImage",
      "publicImage"
    ],
    "priceQueryProducts": [
      {
        "product": "ECS",
        "billingFields": [
          {
            "key": "InstanceType",
            "valueExpression": "InstanceType"
          },
          {
            "key": "GPUSpec",
            "valueExpression": "GPUSpec",
            "defaultValue": "ASCM_SPEC_EMPTY"
          },

            "valueExpression": "GPUAmount",

        "comment": "For a new purchase of an ECS instance, the system disk is required, 
and data disks are optional.",
        "product": "EBS",
        "billingFieldExpression": "def SystemDiskNew = [\n    \"DiskCategory\": 
SystemDisk.Category,\n    \"DiskSize\": SystemDisk.Size\n]\n\n\ndef DataDiskList = []\n
\ndef binding = getBinding()\nif (binding.variables.containsKey(\"DataDisk\")) {\n    DataDiskList = DataDisk ?: []\n}\n\ndef DataDiskListNew = []\nif (DataDiskList) {\n    DataDiskList.each { disk ->\n        def num = disk.Num\n        if (num > 0) {\n        
(1..num).each {\n                DataDiskListNew << [\n                    
\"DiskCategory\": disk.Category,\n                    \"DiskSize\": disk.Size\n         
]\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ndef result = [SystemDiskNew] + 
DataDiskListNew\n\nreturn result"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

**product**

Required. The billable item code of the cloud service in price query settings. If the cloud service is provided by a third party, this field specifies the cloud service code generated when the cloud service was created. The billable item code for such a cloud service is consistent with the cloud service code. If the cloud service is provided by Apsara Stack, this field specifies the billable item code of the cloud service in the corresponding preset billing rule.

Alternatively, you can configure and submit field mappings in price query settings. After the configurations are saved, you can obtain the value of the  `productPriceQueryConfigForAll.product`  field. Then, you can configure code in price query settings.

**resourceType**

Required. The resource type of the cloud service in price query settings. If the cloud service is provided by a third party, this field specifies the unique identifier generated when the resource type was created. If the cloud service is provided by Apsara Stack, this field specifies the resource type code after the number sign (#) in the value of the  `_CatalogConfig.resourceType`  field obtained from the form fields for new purchases. In this example, the value is  `ecs#ecs_instance` , and  `ecs_instance`  after the number sign (#) is the resource type code.

Alternatively, you can configure and submit field mappings in price query settings. After the configurations are saved, you can obtain the value of the  `productPriceQueryConfigForAll.resourceType`  field. Then, you can configure code in price query settings.

**type**

Required. The configuration type of price query settings. For code configurations, set the value to  `JSON` .

**priceQueryForNew.departmentIdKey**

Optional. The key of the organization ID field in the new purchase form. If no value is specified, Department or organizationId is used. If a value other than Department and organizationId is used in some new purchase forms, such as department, you must analyze and confirm the value.

**priceQueryForNew.regionIdKey**

Optional. The key of the region ID field in the new purchase form. If no value is specified, RegionId or regionId is used. If a value other than RegionId and regionId is used in some new purchase forms, such as _regionId, you must analyze and confirm the value.

**priceQueryForNew.priceQueryRequiredFields**

Required. The basic price query fields. A price query is initiated only if the values of these fields are not empty. If the  `priceQueryRequiredFieldsAny`  field is specified, the specified fields are also required. You must select at least the form fields that specify the organization ID and region ID. A detailed analysis of the billing fields and the new purchase page is required to determine the specific basic price query fields.

**priceQueryForNew.priceQueryRequiredFieldsAny**

Optional. The incremental price query fields, which are designed for dynamic scenarios involving required fields. The value of this field is a two-dimensional array. A price query is initiated when the form fields include both the basic price query fields and one of incremental price query fields.

Example:

- Elastic Compute Service (ECS) has the  `OSType`  and  `OSNameEn`  billing fields, which are obtained based on the image ID selected on the relevant page.

- However, the key of the image ID field in the new purchase form changes dynamically based on the image type ( `_imageType` ) selected in the form:

  - If  `_imageType = "system"`  is specified, the key of the image ID field is  `ImageId` .

  - If  `_imageType = "self"`  is specified, the key of the image ID field is `customImage` .

  - If  `_imageType = "others"`  is specified, the key of the image ID field is  `shareImage` .

  - If  `_imageType = "others2"`  is specified, the key of the image ID field is  `publicImage` .

- In this case, four incremental price query fields are required for price queries involving dynamic scenarios.

```text
    "priceQueryRequiredFields": [
      "Department",
      "RegionId",
      "Amount",
      "InstanceType",
      "SystemDisk",
      "_imageType"
    ],
    "priceQueryRequiredFieldsAny": [
      [
        "ImageId"
      ],
      [
        "customImage"
      ],
      [
        "shareImage"
      ],
      [
        "publicImage"
      ]
    ]
```

**priceQueryForNew.priceQueryAgainForValueChangedFields**

Required. The fields for re-initiating a price query. This indicates that a price query must be re-initiated if the value corresponding to one of these fields changes.

A detailed analysis of the billing fields and the new purchase page is required to determine the fields for re-initiating a price query. When the values of these fields in the new purchase form change, the price query results are affected and a price query must be re-initiated.

**priceQueryForNew.priceQueryProducts**

Required. The expressions for mapping form fields to billing fields for a price query of a billable resource. The system uses the defined methods to calculate the values of the corresponding fields from form fields. This list of values is then passed to the billing rule involved to obtain the actual price.

- product: required. The billable item code for which a price query is requested in a billing rule.

- billingFields: a list. Each element in the list represents the method for obtaining the value of a billing field. Each element consists of four fields: key, valueExpression, valueExpressionType, and defaultValue. You need to specify only one of the  `billingFields`  and  `billingFieldExpression`  fields.

  - key: the corresponding billing field.

  - valueExpression: the value expression. The system supports the direct mapping of context fields or complex operations by using Groovy expressions.

  - valueExpressionType: the type of the value expression. This field can be left empty if the  `valueExpression`  field specifies the direct mapping of context fields. If a Groovy operation is required, set this field to GROOVY_EXPRESSION.

  - defaultValue: the default value to use if the corresponding value cannot be obtained by using the value expression specified by the  `valueExpression`  field.

- billingFieldExpression: Use this field in the following cases: when the billingFields field cannot meet your price query requirements, when the billing fields cannot be obtained by using mapping or calculation, and when multiple price queries are to be performed and the results need to be summed up. You need to specify only one of the  `billingFields`  and  `billingFieldExpression`  fields. For example, the new purchase page for an ECS instance allows you to select multiple data disks of different specifications. In this case, multiple price queries are performed and the prices are summed up.

**Examples of using billingFields**

- **When the billing data is consistent with the data of a form field**

  Scenario: The billing data required by the billing rule involved is consistent with the data of a form field.

  Examples:

  - ECS specifications: Both the relevant field in the new purchase form and the billing field are InstanceType.

  - ApsaraDB RDS specifications: The relevant field in the new purchase form is DBInstanceClass, and the billing field is ClassCode.

  Configurations:

  ```json
    {
      "key": "InstanceType",
      "valueExpression": "InstanceType"
    }
  ```

  ```json
    {
      "key": "ClassCode",
      "valueExpression": "DBInstanceClass"
    }
  ```

- **When the billing data needs to be calculated from form fields**

  Scenario: The billing data required by the billing rule involved cannot be obtained directly from form fields and requires logic operations. In this case, a Groovy expression is needed.

  Examples:

  - VPN specifications: The relevant field in the new purchase form is Bandwidth, and the billing field is Spec. The value of the Bandwidth field is a number, such as 5. However, the Spec field in the billing rule requires a unit, such as M. Therefore, the value of the Bandwidth field needs to be converted. In this case, a Groovy expression is required, and the value expression is set to "Bandwidth + \\"M\\"".

  - ECS operating system type: The billing field is OSType, which can be found in the Image list under the Images field in the new purchase form. In this case, a Groovy expression is required, and the value expression is set to "Images.Image[0].OSType".

  Configurations:

  ```json
  {
    "key": "Spec",
    "valueExpression": "Bandwidth + \"M\"",
    "valueExpressionType": "GROOVY_EXPRESSION"
  }
  ```

  ```json
  {
    "key": "OSType",
    "valueExpression": "Images.Image[0].OSType",
    "valueExpressionType": "GROOVY_EXPRESSION"
  }
  ```

- **When the billing data is a fixed value**

  Scenario: The billing data for an item is not obtained from a form, but needs to be set to a fixed value.

  Examples:

  - Flink used core-hours: The billing field is CpuUsed. For a new purchase, no used core-hours are involved and a unit quantity needs to be displayed. Therefore, the default value is set to a unit quantity. Take note that the corresponding conversion factor for the billing field must be considered. If the conversion factor is 3, the default value is set to 3.

  - ECS GPU specifications: The billing field is GPUSpec. However, ECS does not have GPU specifications. Therefore, the default value is set to ASCM_SPEC_EMPTY, indicating no charge for the specifications.

  Configurations:

  ```json
  {
    "key": "CpuUsed",
    "defaultValue": 1
  }
  ```

  ```json
  {
    "key": "GPUSpec",
    "defaultValue": "ASCM_SPEC_EMPTY"
  }
  ```

**Examples of using billingFieldExpression**

Scenario: Billing field mappings are highly complex and cannot be complete with simple configurations. In this case, an expression is required to directly generate the list of price query fields.

For example, for an ECS disk price query during a new purchase, the system disk field is required and only one specification option is available. However, you can specify multiple data disks with different specifications for the data disk field. A single mapping cannot generate the full list of billing fields required to complete the entire price query. Therefore, a Groovy expression can be used to directly generate multiple sets of billing fields, perform multiple price queries, and then aggregate the results at the framework layer.

Configurations:

```text
// Define the system disk information.
def SystemDiskNew = [
    "DiskCategory": SystemDisk.Category,
    "DiskSize": SystemDisk.Size
]

// Initialize the data disk list.
def DataDiskList = []

// Obtain variables in the current context.
def binding = getBinding()

// Check whether the DataDisk variable exists in the context. If the variable exists, assign values. Otherwise, use an empty list.
if (binding.variables.containsKey("DataDisk")) {
    DataDiskList = DataDisk ?: []
}

// Initialize the processed data disk list.
def DataDiskListNew = []

// Process the data disk configurations.
if (DataDiskList) {
    DataDiskList.each { disk ->
        def num = disk.Num
        if (num > 0) {
            (1..num).each {
                DataDiskListNew << [
                    "DiskCategory": disk.Category,
                    "DiskSize": disk.Size
                ]
            }
        }
    }
}

// Merge the price query results for the system disk and data disks.
def result = [SystemDiskNew] + DataDiskListNew

// Return the final results.
return result
```
