###### 7.2.8.6.1.7. Edit the billing origin of a rule template

Edit the billing origin for third-party products.

**Prerequisites**

Only non-Alibaba public cloud products that are integrated through product management support editing the billing origin.

**Operator**

By default, the operator is the operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Service Pricing** > **Rule Template Management**.

4. (Optional) Set the **Cloud Service**, **Resource Item**, and **Status** filter conditions, then click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > **Status** includes **Not configured**, **Configured, Product deleted**, and **Unpublish Service**.

5. Click a resource card to go to the **Rule Template** page.

6. In the **Basic information** section, click **Edit**.

7. On the **Edit Rule Template** page, update the billing origin.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The billing origin supports **System Generated** and **External Import**.
   >
   > - **System Generated**: The system generates billing data based on metering data.
   >
   > - **External Import**: Obtain billing data through an API. If the billing origin is external import, the bill audit does not perform verification. Resources with external import do not generate billing data according to billing rules.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ddc861a1332ec7d97918481c6e102ba5.jpeg)

8. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-2"></a>

##### 7.2.8.6.2. Alibaba Cloud mapping configurations

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-2-1"></a>

###### 7.2.8.6.2.1. Configure mappings to Alibaba Cloud multiplier pricing

This topic describes how to configure mappings to Alibaba Cloud multiplier pricing.

**Purpose of multiplier pricing mappings**

Multiplier pricing mappings associate the billing resources of Alibaba Cloud with Apsara Stack resources. This enables resale pricing based on original Alibaba Cloud bills by applying a configured multiplier.

**How the mappings work**

A resource type of Apsara Stack can be mapped to a group of billable items on Alibaba Cloud. After the mappings are configured, the system synchronizes the original Alibaba Cloud bills every day. Based on the mappings, the system applies the configured multiplier to the billable items on Alibaba Cloud and generates bills that belong to the mapped resource type.

Take note of the following rules when you configure the mappings:

1. In most cases, a resource type is mapped to one or more billable items of a single Alibaba Cloud service (with a specific pipCode value). For example, for the resource type "XX resale resource", you can map all billable items of Alibaba Cloud Function Compute to this resource type.

2. The mappings configured for a resource type consist of multiple mapping rules. Each mapping rule contains three fields: Service Code, Product Code, and Billable Item Code. The smallest granularity is Billable Item Code.

3. Each mapping rule can be configured in one of the following forms:

   - Service Code: AA. Product Code: BB. Billable Item Code: CC.

     This is exact mapping. When an exact mapping rule is applied, the system maps the bills of only specified billable items to the mapped resource type.

   - Service Code: AA. Product Code: \*. Billable Item Code: \*.

     This is fuzzy mapping. When a fuzzy mapping rule is applied, the system maps the bills of all billable items of the Alibaba Cloud service AA to the mapped resource type. Fuzzy mapping simplifies configuration and allows you to efficiently map the bills of an Alibaba Cloud service to a resource type.

**Source of fields for multiplier pricing mappings**

Log in to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console. Go to the **Expenses and Costs** console and choose **Billing** > **Bill Details**. In the bill list, check the Product Code, Commodity Code, and Billable Item Code fields, which can be used for configuring multiplier pricing mappings.

If you want to map all billable items of a specific Alibaba Cloud service to a resource type of Apsara Stack, obtain the value of the Product Code field from the bill details on Alibaba Cloud and specify it as the value of the Service Code field in the billing rule template of the resource type on Apsara Stack. In addition, set both the Product Code and Billable Item Code fields to an asterisk (\*) on Apsara Stack.

> **Note**
>
> If the bills of an Alibaba Cloud service fail to be synchronized, go to the Bill Details page in the Alibaba Cloud Management Console, click **Back to Old Version** in the upper-right corner, and then obtain the value of the Product Code field for configuring multiplier pricing mappings.

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-2-2"></a>

###### 7.2.8.6.2.2. Modify mappings

You can configure mappings between the billing resources of Alibaba Cloud and Apsara Stack resources. After you configure the mappings, you can apply the service multiplier pricing method of Alibaba Cloud to Apsara Stack resources.

**Prerequisites**

- A third-party custom cloud service is hosted on Alibaba Cloud.

- You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

If a cloud service has preset Alibaba Cloud mapping configurations, you cannot modify those mappings.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Rule Template Configuration**.

4. Optional. Configure the **Cloud Services**, **Resource Item**, and **Status** parameters as filter conditions and click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Valid values of the **Status** parameter: **Not Configured**, **Configured**, **Delete Service**, and **Unpublish Service**.

5. Find and click the card for the resource type that you want to manage to go to the **Rule Template** page.

6. On the **Public Cloud Mapping Configuration** tab, click **Modify Mapping**.

7. In the **Public Cloud Mapping Configuration** panel, click **Add**. Enter values in the **Service Code**, **Product Code**, and **Billable Item Code** fields to configure mappings.

   | Para met er | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Serv ice Cod e | The code of the Alibaba Cloud service to map to. Example: ecs. |
   | Prod uct Cod e | The code of the service resource to map to. Examples: \* and snapshot. A value of an asterisk (\*) indicates all resources. |
   | Billa ble Item Cod e | The code of the billable item to map to. Examples: \* and SystemDiskSize. A value of an asterisk (\*) indicates all billable items. |

   Mapping configuration examples:

   > **Important**
   >
   > - Exact and fuzzy mapping rules are mutually exclusive.
   >
   >   - If the billable items of an Alibaba Cloud service are mapped to a resource type of Apsara Stack by using an exact mapping rule, no fuzzy mapping rules can be configured to map the billable items of this Alibaba Cloud service.
   >
   >   - If the billable items of an Alibaba Cloud service are mapped to a resource type of Apsara Stack by using a fuzzy mapping rule, no exact mapping rules can be configured to map the billable items of this Alibaba Cloud service.
   >
   > - The combination of Service Code, Product Code, and Billable Item Code in each exact mapping rule must be unique. If a combination of Service Code, Product Code, and Billable Item Code is configured as an exact mapping rule for a resource type of Apsara Stack, this combination cannot be configured as an exact mapping rule for another resource type of Apsara Stack.
   >
   > - When you configure exact mapping rules, make sure that all billable item codes that exist on the site are covered by the configured mappings.

   - To map all billable items of Alibaba Cloud Elastic Compute Service (ECS) to a resource type of Apsara Stack, enter ecs in the **Service Code** field, \* in the **Product Code** field, and \* in the **Billable Item Code** field. This is fuzzy mapping.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a1578244e9018ae37acb81544da60d70.jpeg)

   - To map the Size billable item of snapshots of Alibaba Cloud ECS to a resource type of Apsara Stack, enter ecs in the **Service Code** field, snapshot in the **Product Code** field, and Size in the **Billable Item Code** field.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e0e4e16160fbc272fff4b04074c6181e.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-2-8-6-2-3"></a>

You can view preset and custom Alibaba Cloud mapping configurations on the Rule Template Configuration page.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator.

**Limits**

For third-party custom cloud services not hosted on Alibaba Cloud, the Public Cloud Mapping Configuration tab is not displayed.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Pricing** > **Rule Template Configuration**.

4. Optional. Configure the **Cloud Services**, **Resource Item**, and **Status** parameters as filter conditions and click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Valid values of the **Status** parameter: **Not Configured**, **Configured**, **Delete Service**, and **Unpublish Service**.

5. Find and click the card for the resource type that you want to manage to go to the **Rule Template** page.

6. On the **Public Cloud Mapping Configuration** tab, view the preset and custom Alibaba Cloud mapping configurations.

   - **Immediately Effective upon Issuance**: Validity is calculated in calendar days. For example, if you set

   **Validity Period**

   immediate effect with 2-day validity and the user claims the coupon at 14:00 on May 21, the coupon is valid from 14:00:00 on May 21 to 23:59:59 on May 22.

   - **Effective after XX days from issuance, valid for XX days**: Both activation and validity are calculated in calendar days. For example, if you set 2-day activation delay and 2-day validity, and the user claims the coupon at 14:00 on May 21, the coupon is valid from 00:00:00 on May 23 to 23:59:59 on May 24.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b048adf177e8f56c87267ac0f21005c2.jpeg)

6. Click OK.

##### 7.2.9.1.10. Coupon redemption rules

This topic describes coupon redemption rules.

> **Note**
>
> - Public Cloud Subscription Billing (Multiplier Pricing): The system redeems coupons based on bills.
>
> - A coupon supports multiple uses. You can apply one coupon per order or bill.
>
> - In CPQ, one coupon can associate with only one service configuration.

**Apply at order confirmation**

When you purchase subscription resources (such as Subscription ECS instances), the system matches available coupons based on product and amount attributes of the order. The system automatically filters and displays applicable coupons on the submission page. You can manually select one coupon for deduction.

- Usage quantity: You can apply one coupon per order. A single coupon can offset multiple orders within its validity period until its balance is exhausted.

- Automatic matching recommendation: If multiple coupons are available, the system recommends or prioritizes usage in the following order:

  <ol type="i">

  <li>

  Prioritize coupons with larger remaining balances.

  </li>

  <li>

  Prioritize coupons with earlier expiration dates.

  </li>

  <li>

  Prioritize coupons issued earlier.

  </li>

  </ol>

- Refund upon exception: The system redeems coupons in successfully created orders. To refund and reuse a coupon, you must first cancel the unsuccessful order. After order cancellation, the coupon returns to the "Available" status.

- Renewal coupon usage: When you manually renew a resource, the renewal payment page displays applicable coupons. You can choose whether to use them. When you enable auto-renewal, the system automatically selects and applies an applicable coupon according to predefined rules.

- Budget deduction: If the order amount remains after all coupons are applied, the system deducts the remaining amount from your budget.

**Automatic deduction after bill generation**

For Pay-As-You-Go resources, the system automatically applies active coupons during Bill Generation.

- Automatic matching: The system prioritizes coupons nearing expiration. If expiration dates are identical, the system prioritizes coupons with larger remaining balances.

- Multi-coupon deduction: If the balance of a single coupon is insufficient to cover the entire bill, the system automatically applies the next available voucher to continue deduction until the bill amount is fully offset or all applicable coupons are exhausted.

- Budget deduction: If the bill amount remains after all coupons are applied, the system deducts the remaining amount from your budget.

<a id="section-7-2-9-2"></a>

#### 7.2.9.2. Coupon details

The coupon details page displays all coupons and allows you to view detailed usage information for each coupon.

**Constraints**

When issuing coupons, you can select only level-1 organizations. Therefore, the coupon details page displays coupons that belong to level-1 organizations.

- Users of a level-1 organization who have the permission to view coupons can view coupons that belong to their level-1 organization on the coupon details page.

- Users of subordinate organizations cannot view available coupons.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-Manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operation** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Coupon** > **Coupon Details**.

4. View existing coupons in the list.

   - Click a coupon ID to expand the **Basic Information** panel.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d16d59f041dee5595a7a5d06845ea93e.jpeg)

   - Click **Usage Details** in the **Actions** column of a coupon to view its detailed usage information.

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3f7bfd735c0a0bbff09a3c9c3d7cf6a7.jpeg)

#### 7.2.9.3. Blacklist management

Manage tenant blacklists. The system supports blacklist control by level-1 organization dimension to restrict permissions for coupon claiming and redemption.

**Prerequisites**

The operating user defaults to the operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Coupon** > **Blacklist Management**.

4. Click **Add to Blacklist**.

5. In the **Add to Blacklist** panel, configure blacklist information.

   | Configuration Item | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Organization | Add a level-1 organization to the blacklist. The system supports single selection only. |
   | Limit Type | Defaults to <strong>Disallow Issuance</strong> and <strong>Disallow Use</strong>. Modification is not supported. |
   | Reason | Enter the reason for adding to the blacklist. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f5c72e097e7572c0a29bf356e3476b84.jpeg)

6. Click **Confirm**.

7. Manage the blacklist.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ce614ee5e1520a73ea0ba8d43f656273.jpeg)

   | Action | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Edit blacklist | i. In the blacklist list, click <strong>Actions</strong> column’s <strong>Edit</strong>.<br>ii. In the <strong>Edit Blacklist</strong> panel, update the reason for adding to the blacklist.<br>iii. Click <strong>Confirm</strong>. |
   | Delete blacklist | i. In the blacklist list, click <strong>Actions</strong> column’s <strong>Delete</strong>.<br>ii. Click <strong>Confirm</strong>. |

##### 7.2.10.3.1. Enable the unified metering standard by credit

After enabling the unified metering standard, the system uses credits as the unified metering unit and converts tokens in quota management based on conversion rules.

**Prerequisites**

The default operator is the operations administrator.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Token Plan Management** > **Token Plan Configuration**.

4. Click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/fc06818e676a06736a59891957a748f7.png" width="32" alt=""> on the right side of the **Unified Metering Standard Credit** card.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f736ed954c9087c76b172d386c3251b2.jpeg)

5. In the dialog box, click **Confirm**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You cannot disable this feature after enabling it. The system converts the corresponding quotas to the credit standard for management.

<a id="section-7-2-10-3-2"></a>

##### 7.2.10.3.2. Edit Token Plan configuration

After you enable Unified Metering Standard by Credit, you can edit the Token Plan Configurations.

**Prerequisites**

- The default user role is Operations Administrator.

- You have enabled Unified Metering Standard by Credit.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top menu bar, choose **Operations** > **Service Operations**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Token Plan Management** > **Token Plan Configurations**.

4. Click **Modify** on the right side of the **Unified Metering Standard by Credit** card.

5. Complete **Credits Conversion Settings**, **Token Plan Configurations**, and **Price Management** in sequence.

   <ol type="i">

   <li>

   **Credits Conversion Settings**: Click **Configure** in the Actions column of a model, set the conversion coefficient, and click **Save**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - If no conversion coefficient is configured for a new model, the system converts credits based on the following default ratios:
   >
   >   - Input Token: 1000 : 0.2
   >
   >   - Output Token: 1000 : 1.2
   >
   >   - Cache Token: 1000 : 0.02
   >
   > - After you update the conversion coefficient, the existing metering data remains unchanged. The new coefficient applies only to metering data generated after the update.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/42f57d1bc46b6825feefddef358e54f2.jpeg)

   </li>

   <li>

   **Token Plan Configurations**: Configure the specifications and benefits for each version of the Token Plan.

   | Action | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Add a version | a. Click <strong>Create Version</strong> above the version list.<br>b. In the dialog box, set <strong>Version Name</strong>, <strong>Credit Quota</strong>, and Custom Description Field.<br>c. Click <strong>Save</strong>. |
   | Enable or disable a version | ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/09f648c4298e419743e61c36d20618af.png)<br>Click or<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c32b3597803a5bfde8668ef08813fb8e.png)<br>in the <strong>Enabling Status</strong> column of a version.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/09f648c4298e419743e61c36d20618af.png)<br>indicates that the version is enabled.<br>![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/c32b3597803a5bfde8668ef08813fb8e.png)<br>indicates that the version is disabled. |
   | Edit a version | a. Click <strong>Modify</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of a version.<br>b. In the <strong>Modify Version</strong> dialog box, update the version information.<br>c. Click <strong>Save</strong>. |
   | Delete a version | a. Click <strong>Delete Version</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of a version.<br>b. In the dialog box, click <strong>Delete Version</strong>. |
   | Configure a shared usage plan | In the Shared Usage Plan section, configure the <strong>Minimum Credits per</strong> <strong>Order</strong>, <strong>Increment Step Size (Credits)</strong>, and <strong>Maximum Credits per</strong> <strong>Order</strong>. |

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5f8ce2673d3eba6034d4ac6074a3ef25.jpeg)

   </li>

   <li>

   **Pricing Management**: Manage the pricing rules for each version and specification. Click **Configure** in the **Actions** column of an associated rule. In the **Pricing Configurations** panel, set the prices.

   </li>

   </ol>

6. Click **OK**.

## 7.3. Data analysis

<a id="section-7-3-1"></a>

### 7.3.1. Custom analysis

<a id="section-7-3-1-1"></a>

#### 7.3.1.1. Data analysis

The Data Analysis page provides platform and organization administrators with platform-based operations data analytics, self-service analytics, and scenario-specific operations report capabilities.

<a id="section-7-3-1-1-1"></a>

##### 7.3.1.1.1. View data table

View detailed information of data tables by product data, organization statistics, and my data table types.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operation** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Custom Analysis** > **Self-service Data Analysis**.

4. Click the **Product Data**/**Organization Statistics**/**My Data Table** tab on the left to switch to the corresponding type of data table.

   | Data table type | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | Product statistics | Displays the corresponding <strong>resource reports</strong> and <strong>quota reports</strong> based on the selected cloud service. |
   |  | Supports <strong>statistical reports</strong>, <strong>resource reports</strong>, <strong>cost reports</strong>, <strong>compute</strong> <strong>resource reports</strong>, <strong>idle analysis</strong>, and <strong>storage resource reports</strong>.<br>• Statistical reports<br>• Number of instances in region (daily)<br>• Number of instances in region (monthly)<br>• Number of instances in region (weekly)<br>• Number of instances under resource (daily)<br>• Number of instances under resource (monthly)<br>• Number of instances under resource (weekly)<br>• Number of instances under tag (daily)<br>• Number of instances under tag (monthly)<br>• Number of instances under tag (weekly) |

   | Organizati on statistics | • Usage statistics report (daily)<br>• Number of instances under region (daily)<br>• Number of instances under region (monthly)<br>• Number of instances under region (weekly)<br>• Resource reports<br>• Full resource instance table<br>• Resource count statistics table<br>• Cost reports<br>• Monthly bill statistics by organization<br>• Monthly service bill statistics by organization<br>• Monthly service bills of organizations by tag<br>• Monthly organization bills by tag<br>• Annual service bill statistics by organization<br>• Monthly bill statistics by service<br>• Annual bill statistics by service<br>• Monthly bill statistics by resource set<br>• Monthly service bill statistics by resource set<br>• Monthly service bills of resource sets by tag<br>• Monthly resource set bills by tag<br>• Compute resource reports<br>• Compute-type product instance table<br>• Compute resource statistics table by organization<br>• Compute resource statistics table by resource set<br>• Idle analysis<br>• Resource health<br>• Organization health<br>• Resource set health<br>• Organization and sub-organization health<br>• Idle resource analysis<br>• Idle resource analysis of organization<br>• Idle resource analysis of resource set<br>• Idle resource analysis of all organizations<br>• Storage resource reports<br>• Storage resource statistics table by organization<br>• Storage resource statistics table by resource set<br>• Storage-type product instance table |
   | --- | --- |
   | My Data Table | Displays tables saved as My Data Table. |

5. Click the corresponding data table on the **Product**/**Organization**/**My Data Table** tab to view detailed information about the data table.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5e1c93da78ce321d45bed5320a03575e.jpeg)

   - Refresh: Click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/afdca51d5c0378936e15932105b07c57.png" width="17" alt=""> above the list to instantly update the data and information in the list.

   - Full screen: Click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/201bd51f6521929918e38c78294060dd.png" width="15" alt=""> above the list to enter full-screen mode.

   - Filter: Click **Filter** above the list, add entries, and set filter conditions to quickly find the

     required data. You can also click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/846f2c0447759a8fa02430ed8e3729ac.png" width="8" alt=""> after a field in the data table column to set filter

     conditions.

     > **Note**
     >
     > The organization and resource set fields support multiple selections.

   - Sort: Click **Sort** above the list, add entries, and set sorting conditions to arrange data in ascending or descending order. Only one field can be sorted at a time. You can also click

     <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f648925c072741975465d0d54c463471.png" width="10" alt=""> after a sortable field in the data table column to sort directly by that field.

   - Show/hide fields: Click **Field** above the list, select or clear fields to show or hide them

     and their data. Drag <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cb3c190e8150c9d25377362f1cbb6b5a.png" width="9" alt=""> before a field to adjust the display order of fields.

   - Scenario analysis: In the data table column, click <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b88dde8205b43197c04dc6f2ae25ca53.png" width="13" alt=""> after a field that supports scenario

     analysis, select a scenario, and you will be redirected to the custom chart page. You can then configure and update chart data statistics based on your business needs. For detailed descriptions of configuration items, see Create a card.

   - Resource analysis: Hover over the serial number column and click the resource analysis

     icon <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d2d1b7ab8b1e4541fb5b6a9b516934fd.png" width="14" alt=""> to go to the resource panoramic insight page and view panoramic insight

     information about resources.

<a id="section-7-3-1-1-2"></a>

##### 7.3.1.1.2. Save data as a custom table

You can save the current query results, filter conditions, or display fields as a custom table for quick access and review in the future.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Custom Analysis** > **Data Analysis**.

4. On the Data Analysis page, click the **Product**, **Organization**, or **My** tab to display the corresponding list of tables.

5. On the **Product**, **Organization**, or **My** tab, click the table that you want to view.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5e1c93da78ce321d45bed5320a03575e.jpeg)

6. Optional. Configure the Filter, Sort, or Field settings based on your business requirements.

7. Click **Save as My Data Table** in the upper-right corner.

8. In the **Save as My Data Table** dialog box, enter a new table name.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b6de4eefab203f9e82f1fc74dbb83070.jpeg)

9. Click **Yes**. After you save a table as your custom table, the table with the new name is displayed on the My tab.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can move the pointer over the name of a custom table and click the
   >
   >   icon
   >
   >   <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/16b4e16a215e126f65b46e2f0d7b4257.png" width="12" alt="">
   >
   >   to delete the custom table.
   >
   > - You can also update a custom table. To do this, perform the following operations: On the Data Analysis page, click the My tab. Click the name of a table, configure the Filter, Sort, and Field settings, and then click **Update Data Table** to update the selected table.

<a id="section-7-3-1-1-3"></a>

##### 7.3.1.1.3. Export the data of a single table

If you want to download the data in a data report to your local machine, you can export the data.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Custom Analysis** > **Data Analysis**.

4. On the Data Analysis page, click the **Product**, **Organization**, or **My** tab to display the corresponding list of tables.

5. On the **Product**, **Organization**, or **My** tab, click the table that you want to view.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5e1c93da78ce321d45bed5320a03575e.jpeg)

6. Optional. Configure the Filter, Sort, or Field settings based on your business requirements.

7. Export all data or selected data. When you export data, the data that meets the filter conditions is exported.

   - **Export selected data**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     In the data list section, select the data that you want to export and click **Export Data** in the upper-right corner.

     </li>

     <li>

     In the **Export Data** dialog box, configure the **Export Scope** and **Task Name** parameters, and click **Yes**.

     > **Note**
     >
     > You can select **All** or **Selected** for the Export Scope parameter based on your business requirements.
     >
     > - If you select **All** for the Export Scope parameter, you are navigated to the **Report Download** page to view the report export task.
     >
     > - If you select **Selected** for the Export Scope parameter, the exported data is directly saved to your local machine in the **.xlsx** format.

     </li>

     </ol>

   - **Export all data**

     <ol type="a">

     <li>

     On the **Data Analysis** page, click **Export Data** above the data list.

     </li>

     <li>

     In the **Export Data** dialog box, configure the **Task Name** parameter, and click **Yes**.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - By default, **All** is selected for the **Export Scope** parameter.
     >
     > - After the data is exported, you are navigated to the **Report Download** page to view the report export task.

     </li>

     </ol>

<a id="section-7-3-1-1-4"></a>

##### 7.3.1.1.4. Export the data of multiple tables

You can select multiple tables at a time for data export.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Custom Analysis** > **Data Analysis**.

4. On the Data Analysis page, click the **Product**, **Organization**, or **My** tab to display the corresponding list of tables.

5. On the **Product**, **Organization**, or **My** tab, click the table that you want to view.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5e1c93da78ce321d45bed5320a03575e.jpeg)

6. Optional. Configure the Filter, Sort, or Field settings based on your business requirements.

7. Click **Export Multiple Tables** in the upper-right corner.

8. In the **Export Multiple Tables** dialog box, configure the **Task Name**, **Report Type**, and **Reports** parameters.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can select multiple reports.
   >
   > - When you download multiple reports, the following filter conditions are retained: organization, resource set, region, creation time, and tag. Other filter conditions do not take effect.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/23a854b738372259f0b9724a6e502334.jpeg)

9. Click **Yes**. After a report export task is created, a dialog box appears. In this dialog box, you can click **Go to Download Report Page** to view the report export task.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/cf1fc3d3eb86fe3afa317545a1cab798.jpeg)

#### 7.3.1.2. My dashboards

The My Dashboard page of the Custom Analysis module provides a comprehensive operational overview to help you optimize resource allocation and page layout. This page also offers an operation entry to improve efficiency and facilitate management.

<a id="section-7-3-1-2-1"></a>

##### 7.3.1.2.1. Create a dashboard

On the My Dashboard page, you can create a dashboard to configure the layout of cards based on your business requirements, and build a visual interface for custom analysis.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator, an organization administrator, a resource set administrator, a resource user, a resource auditor, or an organization resource auditor. If you are assigned a custom role, the custom role must be granted the permissions to access the My Dashboard page of the Custom Analysis module in Data Analysis.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Custom Analysis** > **My Dashboard**.

4. On the **My Dashboard** page, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/40fa60f973df99ec12e64744264e7557.png" width="13" alt=""> icon in the upper-left corner.

5. In the **New Dashboard** dialog box, enter a dashboard name.

6. Click **OK**.

<a id="section-7-3-1-2-2"></a>

   save the new dashboard name.

##### 7.3.1.2.6. Create a card

You can create a custom card to display data based on your business requirements. This topic describes how to create a card.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator, an organization administrator, a resource set administrator, a resource user, a resource auditor, or an organization resource auditor. If you are assigned a custom role, the custom role must be granted the permissions to access the My Dashboard page of the Custom Analysis module in Data Analysis.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Custom Analysis** > **My Dashboard**.

4. On the **My Dashboard** page, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/97f08d25da566547f2a4704b96860dd8.png" width="10" alt=""> icon in the upper-left corner.

5. Select the dashboard to which the card to be created belongs from the drop-down list.

6. Click **New Card** in the upper-right corner.

7. On the **Card Configuration** page, customize the card type and configure data to be displayed on the card based on your business requirements.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9b6528603796dbe91c07a3c556e4db68.jpeg)

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Secti on</td>
       <td>Description</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>1</td>
       <td>Specify a data source.<br>• <strong>Dimensions</strong>: Select <strong>Service</strong>, <strong>Organization</strong>, or <strong>My Data Table</strong> from the Dimensions drop-down list.<br>• <strong>Cloud Service</strong>: Select a cloud service. This parameter is displayed only if you select <strong>Service</strong> from the <strong>Dimensions</strong> drop-down list.<br>• <strong>Table</strong>: Select a data table.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>2</td>
       <td>Select a chart type. The following chart types are supported:<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8541587f0a4c19fbfb01ce2deecdd173.png" width="25" alt="">(column chart),<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f625589ccc93f3de677aa0d581631d2d.png" width="26" alt="">(line<br>chart),<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/95febdc4a6f61c5f7008418230f182cc.png" width="26" alt="">(pie chart),<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/8b6daa2483d3232f3820377df1909cbd.png" width="26" alt="">(metric card),<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/a2af6c4b2c977a492b4b24e55c3fcb16.png" width="25" alt="">(nested pie chart), and<img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/751af2784ef798a6b395b3d20cb87b30.png" width="26" alt="">(table).<br>After data is configured, the data is displayed in the chart of the selected type.<br>Note<br>If you select table as the chart type, only 20 data entries are displayed by default.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>3</td>
       <td>• <strong>Data Configuration</strong>: Configure the data to be displayed on the card based on the chart type.<br>• <strong>Card Configuration</strong>: Configure basic card information and chart information based on the chart type.<br>• Basic information: Specify the title and description of the card.<br>• Chart information: Configure the chart information based on the chart type.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

8. In the upper-right corner of the Card Configuration page, click **Save as My Card** or **Save to Dashboard**.

9. In the **Save as My Card** or **Save to Dashboard** dialog box, specify the title and description of the card.

   > **Note**
   >
   > After the card is saved as a custom card, click **Add Card** on the **Home** page of the console. On the **My Cards** tab of the Add Card panel, select the custom card to add it to the Home page of the console.

   - **Save as My Card**

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/245f8a2323c52c5dd5af0c8a755ff6aa.jpeg)

   - **Save to Dashboard**

     ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e36d8e3c0b140e361aaea245d916fc85.jpeg)

0. Click **OK**.

**Configure data**

**Filter data**

You can click Data Filtering to configure filter conditions. This way, only data that meets the filter conditions is displayed.

1. On the **Data Configuration** tab, click **Data Filtering**.

2. In the **Set Filter Condition** dialog box, add entries and configure filter conditions.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3f26fd9530b59ba7452eaf7b97a4f3bc.jpeg)

   > **Note**
   >
   > - Each entry consists of a filter field, filter condition, and filter value. If the value of a filter field in data is the same as the specified filter value, the data meets the filter condition entry.
   >
   > - You can add multiple entries. Multiple entries can be connected by using the **And** or **Or** operator.
   >
   >   - **And**: Data is displayed only if it meets all the filter conditions.
   >
   >   - **Or**: Data is displayed if it meets one of the filter conditions.

3. Click **OK**.

**Field details**

The **Dimensions** and **Metrics** sections are displayed in the Field Details section of the Data Configuration tab. You can drag a field to the X Axis and Y Axis sections based on your business requirements.

- **Dimensions**: optional data fields for parent dimensions.

- **Metrics**: data fields for metrics. Numeric values are supported.

**Chart types**

**Column chart**

A column chart uses vertical bars to represent the values of categorical data.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/f2b299eae7e7fbdfa25f2787b0de00ab.jpeg)

**Line chart**

A line chart uses lines to display data changes within a period of time.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/2a8691dc4070d7e9b6e1740e4317b264.jpeg)

**Pie chart**

A pie chart is a statistical chart that displays the proportion of categorical data. It uses the area or angle of each sector to represent the proportion of each part to the whole.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/3a3cbb8d866f9948715b55ef7e1d743c.jpeg)

**Metric card**

A metric card is a simple and card-style chart that is used to display metric information.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/78fe956d179f63cd68ac2d695dce14d3.jpeg)

**Nested pie chart**

A nested pie chart displays hierarchical data by nesting one or more smaller pie charts within a main pie chart.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/19d1a378854702eb45b4f3f7d23fd9ed.jpeg)

**Table**

A table is used to display detailed data.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/b096c7a357f258776ca3941a2181fdcc.jpeg)

<a id="section-7-3-1-2-7"></a>

##### 7.3.1.2.7. Modify a card

This topic describes how to modify a card.

**Prerequisites**

You are an operations administrator, an organization administrator, a resource set administrator, a resource user, a resource auditor, or an organization resource auditor. If you are assigned a custom role, the custom role must be granted the permissions to access the My Dashboard page of the Custom Analysis module in Data Analysis.

**Modify a card on a dashboard**

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Custom Analysis** > **My Dashboard**.

4. On the **My Dashboard** page, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/97f08d25da566547f2a4704b96860dd8.png" width="10" alt=""> icon in the upper-left corner.

5. Select the dashboard to which the card to be modified belongs from the drop-down list.

6. On the dashboard, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/aa267bf6a8557a75b5eda2143a15a725.png" width="10" alt=""> icon in the upper-right corner of the card and select **Modify**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/98c30ba9f017936c345bb10d9b61c15b.jpeg)

7. On the Card Configuration page, modify the card configurations and click Save as My Card or Save to Dashboard. For more information about card configurations, see Create a card.

**Modify a custom card**

**Procedure**

1. On the **My Dashboard** page, click **My Cards** in the upper-right corner.

2. In the **My Cards** panel, move the pointer over the card that you want to modify in the card

#### 7.3.1.3. Intelligent analysis

This feature provides intelligent question answering and data insight capabilities under AI-powered intelligent analysis scenarios.

**Prerequisites**

- When you deploy Apsara Copilot, an operations administrator has enabled the display of the intelligent assistant in **Configuration** > **Apsara Copilot** > **Personalized Configuration**.

- By default, authorized users include Operations Administrators, Organization Administrators, Resource Set Administrators, Resource Users, Resource Auditors, and Organization Resource Auditors. Users with custom roles require authorization for the Data Analysis > Custom Analysis > Intelligent Analysis menu.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Custom Analysis** > **Intelligent Analysis**.

4. In the **Intelligent Analysis** dialog box, select a domain.

   > **Note**
   >
   > You can select **All**, **Cost Analysis Domain**, **Cloud Optimization Domain**, or **Resource Analysis Domain** as the domain scope for intelligent analysis.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <td>Domain</td>
       <td>Description</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>All</td>
       <td>This domain integrates operations data across all dimensions and supports comprehensive analysis such as billing management, resource utilization tracking, and security compliance configuration to deliver full-spectrum operational insights.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Cost Analysis Domain</td>
       <td>This domain contains billing-related data and supports cost breakdown and trend analysis across multiple dimensions such as organizational structure, financial unit, and products. It provides month-over-month (MoM) and year-over-year (YoY) analysis capabilities, allowing you to view the cost fluctuation curve over the last 12 months and accurately identify cost change patterns.<br>When you select <strong>Cost Analysis Domain</strong> as the query scope, you can select a billing table at the top of the dialog box. The system then displays the key metrics and aggregation dimensions of the billing table for quick selection.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Cloud Optimizatio n Domain</td>
       <td>This domain contains cloud resource optimization data and diagnoses the health status of the cloud environment based on a health status evaluation system that combines resource utilization and security scores. It supports instance-level performance analysis across organizations, resource sets, and products to precisely identify idle resources and performance bottlenecks. Additionally, it evaluates security compliance by identifying configuration defects through a security scoring mechanism, thereby strengthening your cloud security posture.<br>When you select <strong>Cloud Optimization Domain</strong> as the query scope, you can select the health status, idle resource analysis, or bottleneck analysis table at the top of the dialog box. The system then displays the key metrics and aggregation dimensions of the selected table for quick selection.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Resource Analysis Domain</td>
       <td>This domain contains cloud resource data and provides statistics on total instance counts and instance type distribution. It supports in-depth analysis of core metrics such as CPU load, memory usage, and disk usage by instance type to provide robust data support for resource inventory and efficiency evaluation.<br>When you select <strong>Resource Analysis Domain</strong> as the query scope, you can select a resource data table at the top of the dialog box. The system then displays the key metrics and aggregation dimensions of the resource table for quick selection.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

<a id="section-7-3-2-1"></a>

#### 7.3.2.1. View health analysis data

The health analysis feature allows you to analyze the health status of cloud resources based on core metrics such as resource usage efficiency and security. This helps you understand the health status of resources, continuously improve overall resource governance, and optimize resource allocation policies.

**Background information**

- The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console displays health analysis data by organization, resource set, and resource.

  - Health analysis on organizations: collects the health status of all resource sets of each organization. By default, the health status of subordinate organizations is not included. You can select Aggregate Sub-organizations to calculate the average health score of an organization and its subordinate organizations.

  - Health analysis on resource sets: collects the health status of all resources of each resource set and displays the scoring details of all resources in each resource set.

  - Health analysis on resources: collects the data metrics that are related to the utilization and security of each resource and displays the scoring details of each resource.

- Different health scores indicate different health status.

  - If a health score is greater than or equal to 90, the health status is excellent.

  - If a health score is greater than or equal to 70 but less than 90, the health status is good.

  - If a health score is greater than or equal to 50 but less than 70, the health status is fair.

  - If a health score is less than 50, the health status is poor.

- You can view the health details based on metrics such as the usage rate score and security score. You can also view the algorithm rules, scoring reasons, and optimization suggestions.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Cloud Resource Optimization** > **Overall Health Score**.

4. View the health scores, health score trends, health analysis data of organizations, resource sets, and resources. For more information, see the View the health analysis data of organizations, View the health analysis data of resource sets, and View the health analysis data of resources sections of this topic.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/2f8698c6df1e9908cb3b67fdc09dd3a0.jpeg)

**View the health analysis data of organizations**

On the **Organization** tab of the **Overall Health Score** page, view the health analysis data of organizations.

**Top 10 organizations with the highest health scores and top 10 organizations with the lowest health scores**

- **Top 10 High Health Scores**: displays the top 10 organizations with the highest health scores and their scores.

- **Top 10 Low Health Scores**: displays the top 10 organizations with the lowest health scores and their scores.

  display order of resources.

#### 7.3.2.2. View analysis data of idle resources

You can use the idle resource analysis feature to analyze the resource usage efficiency based on the CPU and memory metrics. This helps you understand resource utilization, improve overall resource governance, and optimize resource allocation policies.

**Limits**

The idle resource analysis feature is supported only by Elastic Compute Service (ECS), ApsaraDB RDS, Tair (Redis OSS-compatible), and ApsaraDB for MongoDB.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Cloud Resource Optimization** > **Idle Resource Analysis**.

4. View the idle resource rates, idle instance trends, and idle resource analysis data of organizations and resource sets, and analysis data of idle resources. For more information, see the View the idle resource analysis data of organizations, View the idle resource analysis data of resource sets, and View the analysis data of idle resources sections of this topic.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/065a48569f9ccf72315f3af1ae6bdb1c.jpeg)

**View the idle resource analysis data of organizations**

On the **Organization** tab of the **Idle Resource Analysis** page, view the idle resource analysis data of organizations.

**Idle resource rankings**

The Idle Resource Rankings section displays idle resource rankings by organization.

- Switch between the resource tabs to view the idle resource analysis data of different resources in organizations.

- Idle resource overview: displays the **Idle Instances/Total Instances**, **Idle/Total CPU Cores**, **Saved CPU Cores**, **Idle/Total Memory**, **Saved Memory**, **Maximum Cost Saving (Days)**, and **Average Cost Saving (Days)** sections.

- **Idle Resource Rankings**: displays idle resource rankings by organization based on idle CPU and memory resources.

**Idle instance change trends**

The Idle Instance Change Trends section displays the idle instance change trends by organization.

<a id="section-7-3-2-4"></a>

#### 7.3.2.4. View security compliance analysis data

The security compliance analysis feature allows you to analyze the overall resource security based on resource security metrics, This helps you identify potential security risks and non-compliant configurations.

**Background information**

- The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console displays security compliance data by organization, resource set, and resource.

  - Security compliance analysis on organizations: collects the security compliance data of all resource sets of each organization. By default, the security compliance data of sub-organizations is not included. You can select Aggregate Sub-organizations to calculate the average security scores of an organization and its sub-organizations.

  - Security compliance analysis on resource sets: collects the security compliance data of all resources of each resource set and displays the scoring details of all resources in each resource set.

  - Security compliance analysis on resources: collects the data metrics that are related to the security of each resource and displays the scoring details of each resource.

- Different security scores indicate different security status.

  - If a security score is greater than or equal to 90, the security status is excellent.

  - If a security score is greater than or equal to 70 but less than 90, the security status is good.

  - If a security score is greater than or equal to 50 but less than 70, the security status is fair.

  - If a security score is less than 50, the security status is poor.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Cloud Resource Optimization** > **Security Compliance Analytics**.

4. View the security score overview, security score trends, and security compliance analysis data of organizations, resource sets, and resources. For more information, see the View the security compliance analysis data of organizations, View the security compliance analysis data of resource sets, and View the security compliance analysis data of resources sections of this topic.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9ffe4c3a03d9f011c306b17047e22063.jpeg)

**View the security compliance analysis data of organizations**

On the **Organization** tab of the **Security Compliance Analytics** page, view the security compliance analysis data of organizations.

**Top 10 organizations with the highest security scores and top 10 organizations with the lowest security scores**

- **10 Organization with the Highest Security Scores**: displays the top 10 organizations with the highest security scores and their scores.

- **10 Organizations with the Lowest Security Scores**: displays the top 10 organizations with the lowest security scores and their scores.

In the **Organization Security Score Distribution** section, you can view the distribution of organizations with different security scores by day, week, or month. You can move the pointer over a column in the chart to view the number of organizations with different security scores.

<a id="section-7-3-2-5"></a>

#### 7.3.2.5. Resource optimization settings

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console provides the rule configuration feature for health analysis, idle resource and bottleneck analysis, and security compliance analysis of cloud resources, and allows you to flexibly modify rules and parameters based on your business requirements.

<a id="section-7-3-2-5-1"></a>

##### 7.3.2.5.1. Default rule

The default rule is built in the system and applies to all organizations by default. The default rule cannot be modified or deleted and has the lowest priority. You can create custom rules. For more information, see Create and manage custom rules.

**Supported cloud services and rule details**

> **Note**
>
> - By default, rule weights are evenly configured based on the number of displayed rules.
>
> - Rules of undeployed services are not displayed.
>
> - The system executes rules at 05:00 every day.

**Computing ECS**

<table>
  <tr>
    <th>Rule name</th>
    <th>Type</th>
    <th>Risk level</th>
    <th>Description</th>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>ECS high disk utilization check</td>
    <td rowspan="4">Utilizatio n</td>
    <td rowspan="10">Medium</td>
    <td>The average storage utilization is higher than 95% for seven consecutive days.</td>
  </tr>

<a id="section-7-3-2-5-2"></a>

##### 7.3.2.5.2. Create and manage custom rules

If the default rule built in the system fails to meet your business requirements, you can create a custom rule based on your business requirements.

**Prerequisites**

You are assigned the operations administrator role.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Cloud Resource Optimization** > **Resource Optimization Settings**.

4. On the Resource Optimization Settings page, click **Create Policy**.

5. On the **Create Rule** page, configure the parameters in the **Basic Information** and **Select Rule** steps.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The system executes rules at 05:00 every day.

   <ol type="i">

   <li>

   Configure parameters in the Basic Information step.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <th colspan="2">Section and parameter</th>
       <th>Description</th>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="2">Basic Informati on</td>
       <td>Rule Name</td>
       <td>The name of the custom rule.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Descriptio n</td>
       <td>The description of the custom rule.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="2">Applicable Scope</td>
       <td>Organizati on</td>
       <td>The organization to which the custom rule applies. You can select only one organization. If a rule is already applied to the selected organization, you cannot apply the custom rule to the organization.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Region</td>
       <td>The region to which the custom rule applies. If you do not select a region, the custom rule applies to all regions.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   </li>

   <li>

   Configure parameters in the Select Rule step.

   </li>

   </ol>

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/78f29eb1e180c962d3bf72e1e42a81ab.jpeg)

   <ol type="a">

   <li>

   In the left-side section, click the name of a cloud resource to quickly locate its rules.

   </li>

   <li>

   In the right-side section, select one or more rules of the cloud resource.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can select **Default** from the Select a template drop-down list to select all rules of the Security & Compliance type.
   >
   > - You can enter a keyword in the search box to search for a rule in fuzzy search mode.
   >
   > - You can click **Select All** in the upper part of the right-side section to select all cloud resource rules.
   >
   > - You can click **Clear** in the upper part of the right-side section to clear the selected rules.
   >
   > - You can select **Show Selected Actions Only** in the upper part of the right-side section to display only the selected rules.

   </li>

   </ol>

   <ol type="i" start="100">

   <li>

   Enter the weight of each rule in the **Weight** column.

   > **Note**
   >
   > After rules are selected, the system automatically assigns equal weight to each rule. You can modify the weight of each rule based on your business requirements.

   </li>

   <li value="500">

   Optional. Find a rule of the **Utilization** type and click **Rule Configuration** in the **Weight** column. In the Rule Configuration panel, modify the parameters of the rule.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The rule parameters vary based on cloud resources.

   <table>
     <tr>
       <th colspan="2">Section and parameter</th>
       <th>Description</th>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="3">Basic Informatio n</td>
       <td>Name</td>
       <td>The name of the resource optimization setting. You cannot modify the parameter.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Description</td>
       <td>The description of the resource optimization setting. The description must be 1 to 300 characters in length.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Resource Type</td>
       <td>The cloud service to which the resource belongs. You cannot modify the parameter.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Time Range</td>
       <td>Duration</td>
       <td>The duration of the resource optimization. Valid values: <strong>1</strong> <strong>Day</strong>, <strong>1 Week</strong>, <strong>2 Weeks</strong>, and <strong>30 Days</strong>.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td rowspan="2">Valid Values</td>
       <td>Hourly Usage</td>
       <td>The hourly usage of the cloud service. Valid values: <strong>Average</strong>, <strong>Maximum Value</strong>, and <strong>Minimum Value</strong>.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Daily Usage</td>
       <td>The daily usage of the cloud service. Valid values: <strong>All</strong> and <strong>Duration</strong>.<br>Note<br>If you select <strong>Duration</strong>, you must add new entries to configure the <strong>Time Range</strong> and <strong>Weight</strong> parameters.You can add multiple entries.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Set Threshold</td>
       <td>Idle Rules</td>
       <td>Configure a threshold for the idle rules of the resource optimization setting.</td>
     </tr>
     <tr>
       <td>Recommen ded Solution</td>
       <td>Recommende d Solution</td>
       <td>The suggestions for fixing the resource optimization setting.The suggestions must be 0 to 300 characters in length.</td>
     </tr>
   </table>

   </li>

   </ol>

6. View the custom rule. By default, a custom rule takes effect after it is created. On the Resource Optimization Settings page, you can view the created custom rule by configuring the **Status** and **Rule Name** parameters.

   > **Note**
   >
   > - You can select **Effective** or **Paused** from the Status drop-down list.
   >
   > - In the Rule Name search box, you can enter a keyword to search for a rule in fuzzy search mode.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/e8d750d45523eeb92672b86da076b5d9.jpeg)

7. Perform other operations on the custom rule based on your business requirements. The following table describes the supported operations.

   | Operation | Description |
   | --- | --- |
   | View the details of a rule | Click <strong>Details</strong> on the card of the rule to go to the Rule Details page. |
   | Disable a rule | i. Click <strong>Disable</strong> on the card of the rule in the <strong>Effective</strong> state.<br>ii. In the Disable Rule message, click <strong>OK</strong>. After the rule is disabled, the state of the rule changes to Paused. |
   | Enable a rule | i. Click <strong>Enabled</strong> on the card of the rule in the <strong>Paused</strong> state.<br>ii. In the Enable Rule message, click <strong>OK</strong>. After the rule is enabled, the state of the rule changes to Effective. |

<a id="section-7-3-3"></a>

### 7.3.3. Download and delivery

<a id="section-7-3-3-1"></a>

#### 7.3.3.1. Report download

You can create a download task to download multiple data records. After the task is created, data is asynchronously exported in the background. After the data is exported, you can download the report.

<a id="section-7-3-3-1-1"></a>

##### 7.3.3.1.1. Report results

On the report results tab, create a download task. After you successfully create the task, export and download the report.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Download and Deliver** > **Report Download**.

4. On the **Report Results** tab, click **Create Download Task**.

5. In the **Create Download Task** dialog box, configure the report download information. For more information, see Report types.

6. Click **OK**.

7. Expand **Advanced Filtering**, set conditions for **Report Name**, **Report Type**, **Cloud Service**, **Report Generation Status**, and **Time Range**, then click **Search** to quickly locate reports.

8. On the **Report Results** tab, perform the following operations.

   | Task | Procedure |
   | --- | --- |
   | Download a report | Click <strong>Download Report</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of the target report.<br>Note<br>If the report status is <strong>Failed</strong> or <strong>Canceled</strong>, click <strong>Retry</strong> to retry the task. When the report status changes to <strong>Completed</strong>, you can click <strong>Download Report</strong> to download it. |
   | Delete a report | • Delete one report<br>a. Click <strong>Delete</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of the report.<br>b. In the <strong>Delete Task</strong> dialog box, click <strong>OK</strong>.<br>• Delete multiple reports<br>a. Select the check boxes before the report names.<br>b. At the bottom of the list, click <strong>Delete</strong>, then click <strong>OK</strong>. |

**Report types**

The following report types are currently supported: **Metering Report**, **Second-level Metering Report**, **Resource Report**, **Quota Report**, **Organization report**, **Resource set report**, **Access policy report**, **User report**, **User group report**, **Role report**, **Detailed Billing Report**, **Monthly Billing Report of Service**, **Monthly Billing Report of Resource Set**, **Monthly Billing Report of Organization**, and **Monthly Billing Report of Cost Unit**.

> **Note**
>
> - For billing reports, the billing period and start/end times refer to the time zone of the server deployment location. The time zone varies based on the deployment location and follows this format: Billing Period (UTC±HH:MM), Start/End Time (UTC±HH:MM). For example: Billing Period (UTC+08:00), Start/End Time (UTC+08:00), Start/End Time (UTC+04:00).
>
> - Billing reports support online download only.
>
> - The **Email** delivery method appears only when you enable the email feature switch. To use this delivery method, ensure that an email gateway is configured in the Message Gateway.

##### 7.3.3.1.2. Scheduled job

On the Scheduled Job tab, create a scheduled job. After you create the job successfully, the system pushes the report periodically according to the configured time period.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Download and Deliver** > **Report Download**.

4. On the **Scheduled Tasks** tab, click **Create Scheduled Task**.

5. In the **Create Scheduled Task** dialog box, configure the scheduled task. For more information, see Report types.

6. Click **OK**.

7. Expand **Advanced Filtering**, set conditions for **Task Name**, **Report Type**, and **Push Cycle**, then click **Search** to quickly find scheduled tasks.

8. On the **Scheduled Tasks** tab, perform related operations.

   | Task operation | Procedure |
   | --- | --- |
   | View a task | i. Click <strong>View</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of the task.<br>ii. In the <strong>View Scheduled Tasks</strong> dialog box, view the configuration of the scheduled task. |
   | Edit a task | i. Click <strong>Edit</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of the task.<br>ii. In the <strong>Modify Scheduled Task</strong> dialog box, update the scheduled task configuration.<br>iii. Click <strong>OK</strong>. |
   | Delete a task | i. Click <strong>Delete</strong> in the <strong>Actions</strong> column of the task.<br>ii. In the dialog box, click <strong>OK</strong>. |

**Report types**

The following report types are supported: **Metering Report**, **Second-level Metering Report**, **Resource Report**, **Quota Report**, **Organization report**, **Resource set report**, **Access policy report**, **User report**, **User group report**, and **Role report**.

> **Note**
>
> The **Email** delivery method appears only when you enable the email sending feature. To use this delivery method, ensure that you have configured an email gateway in the message gateway.

<a id="section-7-3-3-2"></a>

#### 7.3.3.2. Manage the push rules of daily operations reports

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console provides the report subscription feature that allows you to configure the push rules of daily operations reports. You can specify the scheduled time to send reports and the desired content of reports. The system automatically generates operations reports and sends them to your email address based on the rules that you configure. This helps you keep track of the resource usage and facilitates monitoring and alerting.

**Background information**

You can configure up to 10 push rules for each of your role. The system generates report files in the .xlsx format based on the content settings that you configure in a rule and sends the report files to your email address based on the scheduled time that you specify. The reports contain enterprise, operations, and cloud service statistics, which can be accessed by the role corresponding to the rule.

**Create a push rule of daily operations reports**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Operations** > **Data Analysis**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Download and Deliver** > **Daily Operations Report Delivery**.

4. On the **Daily Operations Report Delivery** page, click **Create Rule**.

   **Paramete**

   **Step**

   **Description**

   **r**

   The name of the rule. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in

   **Rule**

   length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores

   **Name**

   (_).

   **Rule Descriptio**

   The description of the rule.

   **n**

   **Report**

   The name of the generated reports, which are attached in the

   **Basic**

   **Name**

   emails sent to your email address.

   **Settings**

   The interval at which reports are generated and sent. Valid values:

   **Push At**

   **Every Day** and **Every Week**.

   The point in time at which reports are generated and sent.

   > **Note**

   **Scheduled Time**

   > If you set the Push At parameter to Every Week, you must configure the **Days** parameter to specify the days of the week on which reports are generated and sent.

   In this step, you can specify the following content of the reports:

   - Enterprise statistics: the numbers of and changes in users, roles, organizations, and resource sets.

   - Operations statistics: the usage and alerts of quotas.

   - Cloud service statistics: the changes in the numbers of resources

   **Content Settings**

   and alerts.

   > **Note**
   >
   > The reports contain only the statistics of the resources that can be accessed by the current role.

   In this step, you can preview a demo report. The report is generated

   **Push Preview**

   based on the content settings that you configure in the previous step.

5. Preview the report and click **Create**. The system sends reports to your email address based on the scheduled time that you specify.

6. Optional. After you create a push rule of daily operations reports, you can manage the rule on the Daily Operations Report Delivery page.

   - Click **Details** in the Actions column to view the details and push history of the rule. You can also modify the report content settings on the rule details page.

     > **Note**
     >
     > - On the rule details page, click **Edit** in the Rule Content section to modify the report content settings.
     >
     > - On the rule details page, find the push task that you want to download in the Push History section and click **Download** in the Actions column to save the report pushed by the push task as an **.xlsx** file to your local machine.

   - Click **Modify Attributes** in the Actions column to modify the configurations of the rule, such as the rule name, rule description, report name, push cycle, and scheduled time. You can modify the report content settings only on the rule details page.

   - Click **Enabled** or **Disabled** in the Actions column to enable or disable the rule. If the rule is disabled, no push task is triggered.

     > **Note**
     >
     > A disabled rule is still counted as one rule. If the number of rules created for a role reaches 10, you cannot create more rules for the role.

   - Move the pointer over the More icon in the Actions column and select **Push History** to view the push tasks that were triggered by the rule. You can also download historical reports.

   - Move the pointer over the More icon in the Actions column and select **Delete** to delete the push rule. If the number of existing push rules reaches the upper limit, you can delete the rules that you no longer need.

<a id="section-7-4"></a>

## 7.4. Portal management

<a id="section-7-4-1"></a>

### 7.4.1. Site management

You can manage all sites on the Sites page, including creating sites, configuring site navigations, publishing or unpublishing sites, and viewing all pages of sites.

**Background information**

A site is an independent web portal. An operations administrator can build an independent service portal by using the portal management feature to provide users with an all-in-one web portal to manage cloud services. A site displays multi-aspect information including column navigation and page content. This way, the internal and external organization service information can be managed and published in a centralized manner, the users of a cloud platform can experience the service capabilities and view the operations information about the cloud platform, and the efficiency of information communication is improved.

**Procedure**

1. Create a site: Configure the domain name and navigation settings of a site when you create the site. This ensures that a page can be directly associated with a site navigation when you create the page.

2. Build pages: Create pages, associate the pages with site navigations, configure the components and uploaded materials and data to complete the page building, and then publish the pages.

3. Publish the site: Check whether the site navigations are associated with pages on the Sites page, preview the display effects of the site, and then publish the site. After the site is published, check the display effects of the site to ensure that the site works as expected.

<a id="section-7-4-1-1"></a>

#### 7.4.1.1. Create a site

Create a new site and configure its basic information. This ensures you can directly associate the site when creating a page.

**Prerequisites**

The operating user is an operations administrator by default.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Operations Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, select **Operations** > **Portal Management**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, select **Sites**.

4. On the **Sites** page, click **Create Site**.

5. In the **Create Site** dialog box, configure Basic information, Theme color configuration, Brand configuration, Footer configuration, and Navigation configuration.

6. Click **OK**.

**Basic information**

| ID | Enter an ID. The ID must be 1 to 30 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a lowercase letter and cannot be the same as the ID of an existing site. You cannot modify the ID after the site is created. |
| Description | Enter the description of the site. The description must be 1 to 200 characters in length. |
| URL Token | You can enable or disable this feature.<br>Important<br>After you disable URL token, tokens are not displayed in page URLs. This may cause page leakage. Proceed with caution. |
