## 17.6. What do I do if an error is reported to indicate that a custom role does not have the required permissions?

This topic describes how to troubleshoot the issue that a custom role does not have the required permissions in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

**Problem description**

An error is reported in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, which indicates that a custom role does not have the required permissions. For example, a custom role does not have the permissions to view DataHub projects.

![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5e7a31d71e539aefbc2ed826bddc1dca.jpeg)

**Solution**

The following example shows how to grant the permissions to view DataHub projects:

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an administrator.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Permissions** > **Role Permissions**.

4. On the **Role Permissions** page, find the custom role that is assigned to the user that you want to manage.

5. Click the name of the custom role to go to the role details page.

6. On the role details page, click the **Application Permissions** tab. Find DataHub and select **View** in the Data bus DataHub section.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/0c3521617e69f1b523a4d3c16ed3fcec.jpeg)

7. Click **Update**.

## 17.7. What do I do if an error is reported when I delete an organization in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console?

This topic describes how to troubleshoot an error that occurs when you delete an organization in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

**Problem description**

An error occurs when you delete an organization in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and the organization fails to be deleted.

**Cause**

- The organization contains cloud resources.

- The organization has sub-organizations.

- The organization contains users.

- The organization contains user groups.

- The organization contains visible Resource Access Management (RAM) policies and RAM roles.

- The organization contains visible logon policies.

**Solution**

**Delete cloud resources from the organization**

Delete the cloud resources based on the error message.

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Resource Sets**.

4. On the Resource Sets page, find the resource set that you want to manage and click its ID to go to the Resource Set Details page.

5. On the Resource Set Details page, click the **Resources** tab. On the Resources tab, find the resources that you want to delete and click the number before the resources to go to the console of the service to which the resources belong.

6. Delete the resources in the service console.

**Delete sub-organizations from the organization**

Delete the sub-organizations based on the error message.

1. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Organizations**.

2. In the navigation tree, find the sub-organization that you want to delete and click **Delete** in the Basic Information section of the sub-organization on the right side of the Organizations page.

**Delete users from the organization**

Delete the users based on the error message.

1. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users** > **Users**.

2. On the Users page, click the **System Users** tab. On the System Users tab, click Username and select Organization from the drop-down list. Then, enter an organization name in the Organization field to display users in the organization.

3. Find the user that you want to delete, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ab7556ad06bb5ce7a97e8d0289663571.png" width="13" alt=""> icon in the Actions column, and then

   select **Delete**.

4. In the dialog box that appears, view the information about the associated AccessKey pair, select the check box before **I have known the risks and confirmed this delete operation**, and then click **Delete**.

**Delete user groups from the organization**

Delete the user groups based on the error message.

1. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Users** > **User Groups**.

2. On the User Groups page, click User Group Name and select Organization from the drop-down list. Enter an organization name in the Organization filed to display user groups in the organization.

3. Find the user group that you want to delete, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ab7556ad06bb5ce7a97e8d0289663571.png" width="13" alt=""> icon in the Actions column, and

   then select **Delete**.

4. In the message that appears, click **OK**.

**Delete RAM policies and RAM roles from the organization**

Delete the RAM policies and RAM roles based on the error message.

1. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Permissions** > **Role Permissions**.

2. On the Role Permissions page, find and delete a RAM policy or RAM role.

   - To delete a RAM policy, perform the following operations: Go to the details page of a RAM role-based batch authorization role or RAM-based batch authorization role, and find the policy list. In the policy list, find and delete the policy.

   - To delete a RAM role, perform the following operations: In the role list, find the role, click the <img src="en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ab7556ad06bb5ce7a97e8d0289663571.png" width="13" alt=""> icon in the Actions column, and then select **Delete**. In the message that appears,

     click **OK**.

**Delete logon policies from the organization**

Delete the logon policies based on the error message.

1. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Permissions** > **Access Control**.

2. On the Access Control page, find the logon policy that you want to delete.

3. Click **Delete** in the Actions column.

4. In the Confirm message, click **OK**.

## 17.8. How do I attach disks to an instance across resource sets of different organizations?

This topic describes how to attach disks to an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance across resource sets of different organizations.

**Solution**

Add the ECS instance to the resource set of the organization to which the disks to be attached belong and then attach the disks to the instance.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an operations administrator or organization administrator.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Changes**.

4. In the left-side organization tree of the Changes page, find the resource set of the organization to which the ECS instance belongs.

5. On the right side of the page, set the **Product Type** parameter to **Elastic Compute Service**.

6. Set the **Resource Type** parameter to **ECS**.

7. In the instances list, find the ECS instance whose resource set you want to change and click **Change Ownership** in the **Actions** column.

8. In the **Change Resource Set** dialog box, select a resource set of an organization to which the disks belong from the **Change Resource Set To** drop-down list. Change the resource set of the ECS instance to that of the organization to which the disks belong, and then attach the disks to the ECS instance.

   > **Important**
   >
   > You can change the resource set of a resource only in the same level-1 organization.

## 17.9. How do I view the AccessKey pairs of an organization and a user?

This topic describes how to view the AccessKey pairs of an organization and a user in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

**View the AccessKey pairs of an organization**

> **Note**
>
> Up to two AccessKey pairs can be created for each level-1 organization. By default, only operations administrators and level-1 organization administrators have permissions to view the AccessKey pairs of organizations.
>
> - An operations administrator can view the AccessKey pairs of all level-1 organizations.
>
> - A level-1 organization administrator can view only the AccessKey pairs of the organization to which the level-1 organization administrator belongs.

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an operations administrator or a level-1 organization administrator.

2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.

3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources** > **Organizations**.

4. On the Organizations page, find the level-1 organization whose AccessKey pairs you want to view and click the organization name in the left-side organization tree.

5. In the Basic Information section on the right side of the page, click **Management Accesskey**.

6. In the Management AccessKey dialog box, view the AccessKey IDs and AccessKey secrets of the organization.

**View the AccessKey pairs of a user**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the upper-right corner of the page, click the profile picture of the user.

3. Select **User Information**.

4. On the page that appears, view the AccessKey IDs and AccessKey secrets in the AccessKey Pair section.

## 17.10. How do I grant RBAC permissions on resources in an ACK cluster in hybrid cloud scenarios?

This topic describes how to grant role-based access control (RBAC) permissions on a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster to a Resource Access Management (RAM) role in hybrid cloud scenarios.

**RBAC permissions**

RBAC regulates access to resources based on the roles of users. You can use Roles and ClusterRoles to specify resource objects that can be managed. You can use RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding to bind roles to specific users. This way, different users can have different permissions on resources in ACK clusters.

After you grant RAM permissions to a RAM role, you must also grant RBAC permissions on resources in an ACK cluster to the RAM role before the RAM role can perform operations on the resources, such as creating Deployments and Services.

**Usage notes**

**Roles and permissions**

ACK provides the following predefined RBAC roles: Administrator, O&M Engineer, Developer, and Restricted User. You can use these roles to regulate access to the ACK console in most scenarios.

- Administrator: has the read and write permissions on resources in all namespaces of an ACK cluster, and the read and write permissions on nodes, volumes, namespaces, and quotas of the ACK cluster.

- O&M Engineer: has the read and write permissions on resources that are visible in all namespaces of an ACK cluster in the ACK console and the read-only permissions on nodes, volumes, namespaces, and quotas of the ACK cluster.

- Developer: has the read and write permissions on resources that are visible in all namespaces or the specified namespaces of an ACK cluster in the ACK console.

- Restricted User: has the read-only permissions on resources that are visible in all namespaces or the specified namespaces of an ACK cluster in the ACK console.

**Authorization requirements**

To use an account to grant RBAC permissions on an ACK cluster to a RAM role, make sure that the account meets the following requirements:

- The account is used to create the ACK cluster. By default, the account has the Administrator permissions to manage the ACK cluster.

- The account is assigned a RAM role of the administrator of the ACK cluster.

- The account is an Alibaba Cloud account.

**Authorization rules**

The following authorization rules apply in hybrid cloud scenarios:

- The operations administrator role has the administrator permissions on the ACK cluster that is created by the operations administrator role.

- If you want to grant permissions on an ACK cluster to users that are not assigned the operation administrator role, you must contact the administrator of the ACK cluster for authorization.

**Grant permissions on an ACK cluster created by an operations administrator**

**Prerequisites**

You are the operations administrator who creates the ACK cluster or is authorized to manage the ACK cluster.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Products** > **Computing** > **Container Service** > **Container Service for Kubernetes**.

3. In the top navigation bar, switch to the ACK console in the Alibaba Cloud public cloud. For example, the admin-test cluster in the cluster list is created by the operations administrator.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9a6efa5c1dd2b47fa5411e51acadd498.jpeg)

4. In the left-side navigation pane, click **Authorizations**.

5. On the **Authorizations** page, click the **RAM Roles** tab. On the RAM Roles tab, find the RAM role to which you want to grant permissions and click **Modify Permissions** in the **Actions** column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/d3c1ddb09c2014b4acddb556d556ff1f.jpeg)

6. In the **Manage Permissions** dialog box, click **Add Permissions**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/ab0c6dc33b99641cf162f1f3d7b2f627.jpeg)

7. In the **RAM User** section, select the cluster created by the operations administrator from the Cluster drop-down list. In this example, admin-test is selected. Select Administrator, O&M Engineer, Developer, or Restricted User in the Permission section.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/6f6858751e13056ddc900951c9fed0e8.jpeg)

8. Click **OK**. A message appears, which indicates that the permissions are granted to the RAM role.

**Grant permissions on an ACK cluster that is synchronized from the public cloud**

**Prerequisites**

You use an Alibaba Cloud account or assume a RAM role that has the administrator permissions on the ACK cluster.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the **ACK console** in the Alibaba Cloud public cloud.

2. In the left-side navigation pane, click **Authorizations**.

3. On the **Authorizations** page, click the **RAM Roles** tab.

4. On the **RAM Roles** tab, select the RAM role to which you want to grant permissions from the **RAM Role Name** drop-down list. Then, click **Modify Permissions**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/4ea050e1ebfb117b1631a832421448ea.jpeg)

5. In the **Permission Management** panel, click **Add Permissions**. In the Add Permission section, select the cluster and namespace that you want to authorize the RAM role to manage and the specific permissions that you want to grant to the RAM role.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/038afd723ce0ad43dd88356c62489375.jpeg)

6. Click **Submit**. A message appears, which indicates that the permissions are granted to the RAM role.

## 17.11. How do I turn off the switch that enforces attribution of interaction between instance resources?

This topic describes how to turn off the switch that enforces attribution of interaction between instance resources.

**Interactions between resources and the display rule**

**Strong isolation**

Isolation between Apsara Stack tenant accounts. Strong isolation applies to Apsara Stack resources between Apsara Stack tenant accounts. Apsara Stack tenant accounts correspond to level-1 organizations of Apsara Stack. That is, the resources of level-1 organizations are strongly isolated by default.

**Weak isolation**

Isolation between resource sets in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. For GUI-based operations in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, interactions between resources are confined to within a single resource set. This prevents unauthorized cross-resource access when you perform GUI-based operations in Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. For example, if Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances are associated with a security group, only the ECS instances on which the user has permissions are displayed, rather than displaying all the ECS instances bound to the security group. If all ECS instances are displayed in this case, unauthorized access may occur.

**Resource sharing**

For resources such as virtual private clouds (VPCs) and ECS security groups that have strong cross-resource interaction requirements, the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console provides resource sharing capabilities to support resource sharing within the current organization and between the current organization and subordinate organizations, which meets the requirements of resource interactions among different resource sets. For example, if an ECS security group is configured to be shared within the current-level organization, the ECS security group can be associated with ECS instances that have different resource sets in the current-level organization.

**Procedure**

1. Log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Operations Console by using the opsadmin account.

2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Platform Operation** > **Management and control service operation and maintenance** > **UniConsole**. The Products page is displayed by default.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/dee7f3590528ccb839de863146e7fa0c.jpeg)

3. On the **Products** page, enter the service whose information you want to change and click **Search**.

   > **Note**
   >
   > Currently, vpc and slb are supported. vpc is used in this example.

4. Find the desired service and click **Switch List** in the Actions column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/dcdb5f1c9660339cfbae292f4981b4e0.jpeg)

5. Search for  `strictOwnership`  in the switch list and check whether the Current Value switch is turned on. If this switch is turned on, click **Change Switch Status** in the Actions column.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/5225d1adcf8acd48d126b2f7470748c3.jpeg)

6. In the dialog box that appears, turn off the **Current Value** switch and then click **OK**.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/9e2b8edeb430b3ff5475989af457bf7a.jpeg)

7. After the modification is successful, the page is automatically refreshed to show whether the modification is successful.

   ![](en-apsara-uni-manager-user-guide-v3.18.6-2607-20260902.assets/33115cb0307cc817420f0af4ddfc28e4.jpeg)

8. Wait about 10 minutes and log in to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console again.
